title: Myyntilupakoordinaattori
description:
Myyntiluvat-vastuualueen Regulatoriset prosessit -yksikössä koordinoidaan kansallisia ja kansainvälisiä lääkevalmisteiden myyntilupahakemuksia ja niiden muutoksia.

Myyntilupakoordinaattorin pääasiallisena tehtävänä on keskitetyn menettelyn myyntilupahakemusten käsittelyyn liittyvät hallinnolliset tehtävät ja myyntilupahakemuksiin liittyvistä prosesseista vastaaminen moniammatillisen tiimin jäsenenä.

Tehtävät koostuvat monipuolisista vastuutehtävistä kuten hakemuskäsittelyn koordinointi, hakemustilanteen raportointi sekä yhteydenpito Euroopan lääkevirastoon ja muihin EU:n lääkeviranomaisiin.

Tästä hausta voidaan täyttää myös mahdollisia määräaikaisia myyntilupakoordinaattorin virkasuhteita.

Toteutamme rekrytoinnin anonyymisti edistääksemme yhdenmukaista ja tasa-arvoista rekrytointia. Valitsemme hakijat haastatteluun ilman tietoa hakijan nimestä, iästä, sukupuolesta, paikkakunnasta (kaikki yhteystiedot), äidinkielestä, kansallisuudesta tai hakijan ulkonäöstä. Anonyymin rekrytoinnin vuoksi toivomme hakemukset ensisijaisesti sähköisessä muodossa valtiolle.fi kautta. Vältäthän myös henkilötietojesi kirjaamista hakemuksen avoimissa tekstikentissä. Mikäli kysyt puhelimitse lisätietoja tehtävästä, vältäthän kertomasta itsestäsi tietoja, jotka vaarantavat anonyymiyden. Emme vastaanota liitetiedostoja.

title: Country HR Manager
description:
_Walki transforms materials for a circular future and towards a sustainable society by extending products' life cycle and embracing resource efficiency. We are an industry leading advanced materials conversion specialist delivering transformative, sustainable solutions to solve the most demanding challenges in packaging and the built environment. Walki is a growing international group organized in three business areas: Consumer Packaging, Packaging Materials and Engineered Materials, with operations in eleven different countries, both in Europe and Asia. In 2025, the Group's annual turnover was approx. 599 million euros employing around 1600 people._

**We are looking for an experienced Country HR Manager for Walki!**

**Your role**

In this comprehensive role, you will be responsible for the entire HR function in Finland, harmonizing processes and implementing global guidelines locally. You will lead a team of HR specialists and oversee HR operations across Walki's Finnish sites, ensuring high-quality support for managers and employees while continuously developing HR practices. Beyond strategic vision, the role also calls for a pragmatic and hands-on approach supporting the business and driving HR initiatives into practice. The position can be based in Valkeakoski, Säkylä, or Pietarsaari. Walki's sites are located along the Pietarsaari-Espoo axis.

You bring strong expertise in managing the full employee lifecycle and HR processes in an industrial or manufacturing environment. You will serve as a trusted partner to site and business leaders and help supervisors succeed in their roles. Working closely with Finance and other Group functions, you will contribute to workforce planning, payroll budgeting, and people-related decision-making. In addition, you will ensure that local compensation, benefits, payroll, and HR administration practices support both compliance requirements and business objectives.

The ideal candidate is down-to-earth, collaborative, and flexible. You lead by example and act as a role model in teamwork, interaction, and communication. Safety is a core part of Walki's culture and production environment. While Walki has a separate safety organization, HR plays an important role in supporting and driving the safety culture through example. You are able to see the bigger picture while breaking it down into practical steps, building functional processes and ways of working, and putting them into practice.

**What we offer**

At Walki, you will join a highly skilled HR team. At Walki, you will work in an international organisation with a collaborative, low-hierarchy culture where people are approachable, business-focused, and committed to continuous improvement. This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in developing HR practices and supporting leaders in a growing international organisation. Walki offers a hybrid work model with up to 50 % remote work, as well as a culture benefit.

**We hope our future Country HR Manager has the following qualities and skills:**

- At least five years of experience in HR Manager-level roles in an industrial environment

- Borad experience in managing HR processes across the employee lifecycle and driving continuous improvement initiatives.

- Strong knowledge of collective agreements (experience with the paper or chemical industry collective agreements is considered a particular advantage)

- Experience implementing and harmonizing HR practices in a multi-site or international organisation. Experience and understanding of how, for example, M&A and integration processes affect HR's scope of work is considered an asset.

- Solid knowledge of employment legislation, statutory documentation, and local negotiations, along with a track record in co-operation procedures

- Ability to navigate a complex stakeholder environment involving multiple sites, collective agreements, and cross-functional collaboration within a group structure. You understand the demands of a matrix organization and corporate group structure.

- Excellent leadership and people management skills

- Fluent Finnish and English. Swedish language skills are an advantage.

- Compensation & benefits expertise is considered an advantage


While we are looking for an experienced HR professional, we also value curiosity, continuous learning, and a willingness to challenge established ways of working when opportunities for improvement exist. What matters is recognizing what you don't yet know and knowing how to find the right answers.

**Recruitment process**

We'd love to hear from you next! Please submit your application and CV through our recruitment system. The application period closes on 30 September 2026, but applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The recruitment process is managed by Jasmiina Inkinen at Valiant HR Oy (tel. 050 557 4696), who is happy to answer any questions. You can also reach Jasmiina by email at jasmiina@valianthr.fi.

First-round interviews are tentatively scheduled for weeks 40–41, with follow-up interviews in weeks 41–42. The first interview round will take place on Teams.

This recruitment is carried out in partnership with Valiant HR Oy. The successful candidate will be employed directly by Walki.

_About Valiant HR Oy:_

_Valiant HR Oy is a recruitment partner that understands both business and people. We specialize in recruitment and executive search for office, manager, and executive-level roles. Delivering a positive experience for both clients and candidates is at the heart of what we do. Learn more about us and how we work: www.valianthr.fi_

_Facebook: @valianthroy_

title: Talotekniikan asiantuntija etähallintakeskukseemme
description:
ISS Operations Performance -yksikkö tukee vahvasti ISS:n strategian toteutusta ja liiketoiminnallista suorituskykyä eli vie meitä yrityksenä kohti tulevaisuuden kannattavaa kasvua. Operations Performancella on neljä keskeistä tehtävää: se kehittää yhtiömme tuottavuutta, tuotteiden kilpailukykyä ja toimintamme hintakilpailukykyä sekä vastaa muutosjohtamisesta merkittävissä projekteissa. Jälkimmäiseen kuuluu myös asiakaslupauksen mukaisten haltuunottojen varmistaminen. Operations Performance on keskeinen elementti OneISS-strategiassa: se osaltaan tekee meistä vahvemman, selkeämmän ja tiiviimmän yrityksen.



Haemme nyt asiakaspalveluhenkistä TALOTEKNIIKAN ASIANTUNTIJAA, ISS Remote Engineering Centre-etähallintakeskukseemme Kuopioon. Kyseessä on kokopäiväinen, toistaiseksi voimassa oleva tehtävä, jossa työtä tehdään katkeamattomana vuorotyönä arkisin ja viikonloppuisin 12h vuoroissa. Etähallintakeskus toimii asiakkaidemme tukena 24/7 eli ympärivuorokautisesti, vuoden jokaisena päivänä.
Talotekniikan asiantuntijana vastaat kiinteistöjen taloteknisiin järjestelmiin, rakennusautomaatioon ja muihin etähallittaviin järjestelmiin liittyvistä monipuolisista työtehtävistä sekä raportoinnista. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä kriittisissä ympäristöissä toimivien asiakkaidemme kanssa sekä sähköpostitse ja puhelimitse. Toimit asiakkaiden asiantuntevana kumppanina löytäen heidän liiketoimintaansa tukevia ratkaisuja eri kiinteistöpalveluistamme. Vastaat asiakkaiden prosessien toiminnasta sekä kiinteistöjen energia- ja olosuhdehallinnasta.
Odotamme sinulta aiempaa kokemusta kiinteistöautomaation- sekä talotekniikan parista. Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto tekniikan alalta, kuten talo-, sähkö-, energia- tai automaatiotekniikan tutkinto. Voit olla opintojesi loppuvaiheessa oleva tulevaisuuden kyky tai jo kokemusta omaava ammattilainen. Tehtävässä menestymisen edellytyksenä on motivaatio ja aito halu toimia rohkeasti asiakasrajapinnassa. Arvostamme automaatiojärjestelmien syvällistä tuntemusta sekä ymmärrystä kiinteistöjen olosuhteista ja energiankulutuksesta. Työssäsi tarvitset oma-aloitteisuutta, vahvaa palveluasennetta sekä paineensietokykyä. Viestit sujuvasti ja selkeästi, niin suullisesti kuin kirjallisesti, suomen kielellä. Lisäksi sinulla on hyvä englannin kielen taito ja IT-taitosi ovat ajan tasalla. Teetämme valitulle henkilölle turvallisuusselvityksen, joka on hyväksyttynä edellytys työsopimukselle.
Tarjoamme sinulle perehdytyksen itsenäiseen, mielenkiintoiseen ja haastavaan työhön asiantuntijayksikössämme. Tule mukaan osaavaan ja kannustavaan tiimiimme! Tarjoamme myös mahdollisuuksia kehittyä ja kasvaa. Tule kanssamme luomaan tiloja, joissa on hyvä olla!
Mikäli olet etsimämme henkilö, jätä meille hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 27.9.2026. Liitäthän hakemukseesi mukaan myös CV:si. Olemme sinuun pian yhteydessä!


ISS työllistää Suomessa lähes 1000 teknistä ammattilaista asentajista erilaisiin kiinteistötekniikan asiantuntijoihin ja päälliköihin. ISS:llä tekniset osaajat pitävät huolta siitä, että kriittiset tilat toimivat – datakeskuksista tehtaisiin ja sairaaloihin. Tärkeissä paikoissa tarvitaan taitavimmat tekijät, jotka haluavat ratkoa haasteita aidosti monipuolisessa ympäristössä. Tarjoamme tilaa itsenäisyydelle, vastuuta, monipuolisia urapolkuja ja ammattitaitoisen tiimin tuen. Tutustu teknisiin ammattilaisiimme täällä: ISS työpaikat - Työ teknisissä palveluissa

title: Huoltoneuvoja / Työnjohtaja
description:

· asiakkaiden vastaanotto ja asiakaspalvelu

Tarjoamme sinulle:

Meillä pääset työskentelemään yrityksessä, jossa henkilöstön ammattitaitoa arvostetaan ja onnistumisia tehdään yhdessä.

title: Koirasafariopas Leville
description:
KOKENEITA KOIRASAFARIOPPAITA LEVILLE!

Etsimme kahta kokenutta koirasafariopasta osaksi vauhdikasta ja hyvähenkistä talvisesonkia Levillä!

Jos tunnet olosi kotoisaksi sekä koirien että ihmisten seurassa, viihdyt Lapin luonnossa ja sinulla on kokemusta safarien vetämisestä, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö.


MITÄ TYÖ PITÄÄ SISÄLLÄÄN?

Koirasafarioppaana vastaat asiakkaiden turvallisesta ja onnistuneesta safari-elämyksestä sekä koirien hyvinvoinnista. Työhön kuuluu muun muassa:

* koirasafareiden itsenäinen vetäminen

* koirien päivittäinen huolto ja hyvinvoinnista huolehtiminen

* päivärutiinien ja aikataulujen hallinta

* asiakkaiden ohjaaminen ja opastaminen

* turvallisuusohjeiden tarkka noudattaminen

* luonnossa ja talvisissa olosuhteissa liikkuminen

* yhteistyö muun työyhteisön kanssa


MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

Etsimme kokenutta ja luotettavaa opasta, jolla on:

* aikaisempaa kokemusta koirasafareiden vetämisestä

* hyvä ymmärrys päivittäisistä rutiineista ja aikatauluista safarioppaana

* suomen tai englannin kielen taito

* muiden kielten osaaminen katsotaan eduksi

* rauhallinen ja vastuullinen ote safarien ohjaamiseen

* tarkkuutta turvallisuusohjeiden noudattamisessa

* joustavuutta ja positiivista asennetta

* hyvä fyysinen toimintakyky ja luonteva tapa liikkua luonnossa

Ennen kaikkea toivomme, että tulet hyvin toimeen koirien ja ihmisten kanssa. Arvostamme opasta, joka osaa pitää tilanteet rauhallisina, huomioi asiakkaat ja koirat, sekä nauttit Lapin luonnosta.


MITÄ TARJOAMME?

* Työt voidaan aloittaa heti

* Työsuhde kestää sesongin loppuun

* Tarjolla on täydet työtunnit, mutta myös pienemmät tuntitakuut ovat mahdollisia

* Majoitus voidaan järjestää läheltä työpaikkaa

* Palkkaus ohjelmapalvelualan TES** mukaan tai osaamisen ja kokemuksen perusteella**

* Mahdollisuus tehdä työtä, jossa Lapin luonto, koirat ja ihmiset kohtaavat joka päivä


KIINNOSTUITKO?

Jos olet kokenut koirasafariopas ja haluat viettää loppusesongin Lapissa koirien, asiakkaiden ja upeiden maisemien parissa, laita meille viestiä ja kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi sekä aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi.

Paikkoja avoinna: 2

Levi, Kittilä
Koirasafariopas
Aloitus: heti
Kesto: sesongin loppuun



Hakuprosessi

Toivottavasti kiinnostuit tehtävästä! Jätä hakemus järjestelmämme kautta helposti parissa minuutissa. Huomioithan, että ainoastaan sähköisen hakujärjestelmämme kautta saapuneet hakemukset käsitellään. Emme käsittele sähköpostitse tai muun kanavan kautta toimitettuja työhakemuksia. Henkilöstöliiga on Etelä-Suomen vahvimpia henkilöstöpalvelualan yrityksiä. Satojen työntekijöidemme joukosta löytyy teollisuuden, logistiikan-, kiinteistö- ja ravintola-alan osaajia, sekä toimistotyön ja palvelualan työntekijöitä. Olemme aktiivinen asiantuntijayritys ja tavoitteenamme on saada työntekijämme viihtymään. Henkilöstöliiga on Henkilöstöala HELAn jäsen. Henkilöstömme on vakuutettu LähiTapiolassa tapaturmien varalta ja työterveyshuolto on järjestetty Mehiläisessä.

description: Kaipaamme osaavaa autoasentajaa Tampereen toimipisteeseemme! Olemme asiakaspalveluhenkinen autohuolto Tampereen Sarankulmassa. Teemme huoltoja ja korjauksia kaikille automerkeille. Käytämme huolloissamme moderneja vianhaku- ja diagnostiikkalaitteita ja täytämme huollot sähköiseen huoltokirjaan, mikäli sellainen on autossa käytössä.Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme sekä kannustavan työympäristön että palkkauksen. title: Manufacturing Data Engineer, Bluefors Oy
description:
Do you want to help develop product data management and change management processes in one of the world's leading quantum technology companies?

We are looking for a Manufacturing Data Engineer to join our client Bluefors Oy's Manufacturing Engineering team. In this role, you will work at the interface of engineering, production, and product data management, ensuring that product structures, revisions, and technical data are maintained accurately and released to production in a controlled manner.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with technical data, systems, and processes while collaborating closely with engineering and manufacturing teams in a growing high-tech environment.

Job Description

As a Manufacturing Data Engineer, you will be responsible for maintaining and managing product data while supporting change management processes across the organization.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Creating, maintaining, and managing Bills of Materials (BOMs)
- Maintaining product data in ERP and PLM systems
- Supporting and coordinating engineering change processes (ECO/ECM)
- Managing the release and scheduling of revisions and engineering changes
- Ensuring data consistency between ERP and PLM systems
- Collaborating closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Change Management teams
- Supporting product data quality and continuous process improvement
- Assisting the Manufacturing Engineering team with product data management related activities

We Expect You To Have

- A relevant technical degree
- A few years of relevant work experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment
- Experience working with ERP and PLM/PDM systems (Experience with Lean ERP is considered an advantage)
- Experience managing and maintaining Bills of Materials (BOMs)
- Understanding of engineering change management processes (ECO/ECM) and product lifecycle management
- Strong English communication skills, as English is the primary working language
- A structured, detail-oriented, and proactive way of working
- Good collaboration and communication skills

We Offer

- An opportunity to work for a global leader in quantum technology
- A key role at the intersection of Manufacturing Engineering and Product Data Management
- A supportive and highly skilled team environment
- A thorough onboarding process
- Opportunities to grow your responsibilities and develop professionally
- Flexible working hours
- Partial remote work possibilities depending on business needs
- A modern and international working environment

At Bluefors, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of scalable processes in a rapidly growing organization while building expertise in product lifecycle and manufacturing data management.

Interested?

Submit your application as soon as possible, as interviews will be conducted during the application period and the position will be filled once a suitable candidate is found.

Please note that, for security reasons, we cannot process applications submitted via email.

title: Ajoneuvoasentaja
description:
Meillä on Herttoniemessä toimiva monimerkkikorjaamo, haemme kokenutta automekaanikkoa, joka pystyy ottamaan vianhaut ja korjaukset itsenäisesti työn alle. Työsi pääpaino on autojen korjaamisessa. Toivomme kuitenkin, että pystyt tarvittaessa toimimaan myös muissa korjaamon päivittäisissä rutiineissa.

- henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjaustyöt

- järjestelmällinen vianhaku ja diagnostiikka

- sähkövikojen selvittäminen

- moottori-, voimansiirto-, jarru- ja alustatyöt

- töiden itsenäinen suunnittelu ja toteutus

- korjaamo rutiineihin osallistuminen


**Tämä tehtävä sopii sinulle jos**

- sinulla on vahva käytännön kokemus autojen korjaamisesta

- osaat selvittää vian mittaamalla ja tutkimalla etkä pelkästään vaihtamalla osia

- käytät diagnostiikkalaitteita sujuvasti

- pystyt viemään työn itsenäisesti diagnoosista valmiiseen korjaukseen

- tunnet oman osaamisesi rajat ja huolehdit työn laadusta

**Mitä tarjoamme**

- vakituinen kokoaikainen työ Herttoniemessä

- mahdollisuus erikseen sovittavaan tulospalkkioon

- teknisesti tärkeä rooli ilman tarpeetonta hallinnollista vastuuta

title: Commissioning Engineer (smelting)
description:
On behalf of our customer, we are now looking for a Commissioning Engineer with previous work experience related to smelting plants. Headquartered in Espoo, Finland, our customer is providing sustainable technology, equipment, and services for the aggregates, minerals processing, and metals refining industries This position offers a vantage point in the company's deliveries within metals refining and opportunity for you to travel the world. You will take part in the construction, installation and start-up of a new scrap copper smelting plant in Gujarat, India. This is a long-term international assignment, expected to last at least one year, with the possibility of periodic trips home during the assignment. Accommodation and local transportation will, in most cases, be arranged by the customer.


Your responsibilities will include:

- Supervise and coordinate installation and commissioning activities.

- Work closely with the customer, employees, subcontractors and other stakeholders.

- Monitor progress, quality and site activities.

- Support problem-solving during installation and start-up.

- Ensure that work is carried out safely and according to project requirements.

- Coordinate activities between different disciplines when required.

- Report progress and identify potential issues to the project management team.

- Participate in commissioning, testing and start-up activities.

- Act as a practical link between the project team and the site.

What we expect from you:

The technical requirements are relatively broad. The most important qualification is practical experience from a smelting or metallurgical plant environment.

Your background may be in e.g.:

- Mechanical installation and maintenance

- Electrical systems and installation

- Automation and instrumentation

- Production operations

- Maintenance

- Site supervision or commissioning

You do not necessarily need to have a specific engineering background. Relevant hands-on experience in a smelting environment and the ability to take responsibility on site are the key requirements.

- Previous experience in a smelting / metallurgical plant environment is essential.

- Experience in at least one of the following areas: mechanical, electrical, automation, production or maintenance.

- Practical, hands-on approach and ability to work independently.

- Good communication and coordination skills.

- Experience working with customers, employees and subcontractors is an advantage.

- Good command of spoken and written English.

- Willingness to work on an international assignment in India for an extended period.

- Ability to adapt to a multicultural and international working environment.

- An international, English-speaking candidate is preferred, as the role involves close cooperation with an international project organization and customer.


We offer you:

- a great opportunity and vantage point to participating in the ongoing delivery of world-leading technology supplier.

- an opportunity to leave your own mark as member of the site commissioning team while adding a strong reference in your competence portfolio.

- an exciting role contributing to latest smelting technology and sustainability.

- a competitive and encouraging salary closely mirroring your performance.

- opportunity to travel and experience the world in additon to working.

- an opportunity to meet and work with people globally.

The job will start as soon as the right candidate have been selected. Duration is a fixed 12 months. The assignment is also suitable for freelance entrepreneurs part of our supplier network.

Interested? Please submit your application and CV ASAP as we are interviewing candidates as they come in!


ECHO Engineering

Echo Engineering Oy (www.echoengineering.fi) was established in 2019 to respond to the fluctuating demand for assignment-based technical professionals in the technology industry. For our parent company, Kaiku HR, this direction is a natural step towards offering a more comprehensive skill palette for the clients. To chosen clients we not only offer local technical consulting services, but also flexible remote design capacity out of India or bring technical experts to Finland for long-term assignments. Combining our capabilities, we can offer services that correspond to the high Finnish quality standards in a competitive price range. Our key personnel have over 20 years of experience in the field: Mats Lindholms expertise lies in selling services of local hour based freelance engineers, recruiting, and acting as an agent. Anil Talwani has a strong portfolio of selling, organizing, and executing remote design services between Finland and India.

Our parent company Kaiku HR (www.kaikuhr.fi) is a company specialized in recruitment and staffing, connecting the right people with the right jobs. A motivated and enthusiastic employee is key to ensuring the satisfaction of our client companies. Operations are based on a people-focused approach, mutual respect, a straightforward, no-nonsense way of working, and a strong commitment to keeping our promises. In 2025, group revenue was approximately €21.4 million. Over the years, we have successfully recruited thousands of professionals both in Finland and internationally. title: Design Manager, Granlund
description:
**Looking for a role where you can take ownership of design management in large-scale data center projects? We are now looking for a Design Manager to join Granlund!**

_Granlund is a rapidly growing expert organization in the real estate and construction sector. Together with our clients and stakeholders, we are building a sustainable and intelligent future. Our more than 1,600 professionals serve across 30 locations throughout Finland._

**Would you be our new Design Manager?**

As a Design Manager, you will take overall responsibility for leading and coordinating design management in large-scale and demanding data center projects. In this role, you ensure that design activities progress according to agreed schedules, budgets, quality standards, and project requirements.

You will lead the design process from start to finish and serve as the key contact for all design-related matters. Working closely with clients, project management, design leads, and other stakeholders, you will drive collaboration, support decision-making, manage design changes, and keep the project moving forward.

You will coordinate a multidisciplinary design team of approximately 15–20 professionals across architecture, structural engineering, HVAC, electrical engineering, and automation. Your focus is on aligning the different disciplines, ensuring smooth communication, and creating the conditions for successful project delivery.

The position is a full-time and permanent role, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The role offers a highly flexible working model, allowing you to work remotely from anywhere in Finland or from any Granlund office. Occasional travel to project sites within Finland is expected.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for an experienced design management professional with a strong track record of leading complex projects, multidisciplinary teams, or large-scale design work. Experience in data center, industrial, or other technically demanding project environments will support your success in this role.

To succeed in this role, you have a solid technical understanding of the design process and preferably an engineering degree. Experience with Autodesk Construction Cloud, Dalux, or Solibri, as well as BIM workflows, CAD environments, and 3D modelling, is considered an advantage.

As our projects are highly international, fluent English skills are essential. Finnish language skills are seen as a strong asset.

As a person, you are organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of complex project entities. You know how to build effective relationships with clients, consultants, and project teams, while adapting your communication style to different stakeholders. You are confident in decision-making, able to navigate challenges constructively, and committed to driving projects toward successful outcomes.

**Why join us?**

At Granlund, you will work in a company that has been a pioneer in Finnish building services engineering for decades. You will contribute to demanding and large-scale projects such as data centers and commercial environments, where your work truly matters. As one of the leading data center design and consulting companies in the Nordics, we offer long-term career opportunities in a rapidly growing field, where projects are becoming increasingly significant in scale and impact. You will have strong opportunities to grow and develop your expertise, with career paths that can be shaped around your strengths and interests.

We place real emphasis on employee well-being, continuous learning, and a supportive, professional work environment. You will be part of a collaborative and ambitious team where people take ownership, share knowledge, and work together toward common goals.

**Are you interested?**

Could you be our new colleague? Please submit your application via the link either in English or Finnish as soon as possible, but no later than 28.9.2026. We will begin interviews during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information, please contact Biisonis Recruitment Consultant Nea Repo (**nea.repo@biisoni.fi**).

title: Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner
description:
We are looking for a Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner to shape St1's CRM approach and deliver the Salesforce-based solutions that support our sales, customer service, and business operations. This role sits where business needs meet technical delivery: you make sure what we build is scalable, secure, and actually adopted by the people who use it.

A big part of the role is partnering with business teams who are actively developing their digital ways of working. You act as a trusted advisor, drawing on experience from multiple Salesforce implementations to guide teams, introduce best practices, and drive real process change and adoption, not just deliver features.

You work closely with business stakeholders, architects, developers, and administrators, translating requirements into a prioritized backlog and actionable solutions. This is a hands-on role: it combines business analysis with real configuration work in Salesforce, so you are as comfortable writing a user story as you are building in the platform.

How youll help drive the change

Joining St1, youll be part of running and developing a profitable business that invests in long-term energy solutions. Together we achieve the extraordinary through everyday work. As a Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner, youll play a key role in

Product Strategy & Vision

Define and communicate the roadmap for Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud capabilities.

Align platform initiatives with business objectives and customer experience goals.

Continuously evaluate new Salesforce features and innovations for business value.

Backlog & Requirements Management

Own and maintain the Sales & Service product backlog.

Gather, analyze, and prioritize business and technical requirements.

Translate business needs into clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and keep backlog items well-defined and ready for development.

Technical Leadership

Provide technical guidance on Salesforce architecture, integrations, and configurations.

Partner with architects and developers to design scalable, secure solutions, and review designs against best practices and enterprise standards.

Configure Salesforce Sales and Service Cloud hands-on where needed.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Act as the primary liaison between business users, Business Technology, and external vendor teams.

Design and facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and process improvements that help business teams build confidence and capability.

Manage expectations and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies.

Partner with business leads to drive user adoption: coaching teams through change, addressing resistance, and building long-term ownership of new ways of working.

Share insights and best practices from prior implementations to help the business make informed decisions and avoid common pitfalls.

Platform Governance & Quality

Ensure compliance with security, data, and governance standards.

Promote best practices for development, documentation, and deployment.

What you bring to the team

Were looking for a colleague with the drive to challenge, collaborate and grow. To thrive in this role, you likely have:

5+ years of experience working with Salesforce platforms, including 3+ years in a Product Owner, Business Systems Analyst, or Technical Lead role.

Proven hands-on experience configuring Salesforce Sales and Service Cloud.

Strong understanding of CRM, sales operations, and customer service processes.

Demonstrated experience driving organizational change and process adoption in environments with varying levels of digital maturity.

Track record of delivering Salesforce implementations across multiple organizations, with the ability to bring cross-industry best practices to new contexts.

A bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Knowledge of Finnish or Swedish as a native speaker, and fluent written and spoken knowledge of English. Other Nordic languages are a plus.

Nice to have: Salesforce certifications (e.g. Administrator, Platform Developer, Sales/Service Cloud Consultant), experience with Einstein or Agentforce, and experience in large-scale, highly integrated environments.

Who are we looking for

We are looking for your passion, skills and drive. We're looking for those who recognize the St1 Spirit in themselves: Curious, Commercial, Committed and Caring. We value people who are curious, commercial, committed and caring, and who thrive in collaborative, fast-changing environments.

Why Join St1?

- Shape St1s CRM vision and create tangible impact across sales and customer service.
- Blend business insight with hands-on design and delivery.
- Influence how teams adopt modern digital ways of working.
- Develop into Salesforce architecture, AI-powered CRM, or product leadership.
- Helsinki or Stockholm base, with excellent social benefits.
- Work in a high-performing Nordic tech organisation built on trust and responsibility.

How we support your journey

At St1, your safety and wellbeing come first. We offer an open and inclusive workplace where youre respected and trusted to take initiative. In a hands-on, informal culture - and a business that never stands still - theres room to explore ideas and take on new challenges. We support your journey through learning and opportunities to grow across teams and countries.

Youll have real ownership of St1's CRM platform and how it's used, working with a wide range of teams; backed by competitive pay, a bonus scheme and genuine opportunities to grow your career.

If youd like to explore more about our culture, visit our career site.

What to expect after you apply

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive and equitable recruitment process.

Interested? Send us your CV and cover letter via the Barona Career site ASAP. For more information, please reach out to Sr Consultant Arja Martikainen arja.martikainen@barona.fi.

Lets challenge the ordinary!

title: Laboratory Sales Manager to GC Nordic
description:
GC Corporation was founded in 1921 in Japan and has developed itself into one of the most prominent companies in the development, production and distribution of a very wide range of dental products. GC Europe (Leuven, Belgium) supports and leads our different sales offices and dealers in EMEA territory. Our Nordic Team is currently looking for a

Laboratory Sales Manager, NordicPurpose of the job

As a Laboratory Sales Manager you will drive sales growth and business development for our laboratory and CAD/CAM product portfolio across the Nordic region. The ideal candidate brings strong commercial experience within the dental laboratory sector and a solid understanding of digital CAD/CAM workflows used in laboratories and dental clinics.

Your Role

    

Lead and develop our business in laboratory and CAD/CAM segment: Drive sales and business development activities across Nordic, ensuring achievement of sales targets and growth objectives. Geographically main focus is on Sweden, Norway and Denmark.

    

Account management: Build and maintain strong relationships with dental laboratories, digitally focused distributors, and key opinion leaders.

    

Product trainings and presentations: Conduct product demonstrations and training sessions that showcase customer-focused solutions, drive sales growth, and clearly demonstrate the value of the GC portfolio.

    

Market insights: Stay up-to-date with market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to identify opportunities and mitigate challenges.

    

Team collaboration: Support and work closely with the broader GC Nordic team to ensure alignment and knowledge-sharing across markets.

What You Bring?

    

Proven experience (minimum 4 years) within the dental laboratory industry, including CAD/CAM workflows, ideally gained in a sales role.

    

Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills.

    

Results-oriented and proactive person who enjoys working independently in a fast-paced environment where multiple priorities need to be managed simultaneously.

    

Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English.

    

Willingness to travel on weekly basis, being 60%-80% of the working time in the field.

    

Resident of Sweden (working remote).

Why Join GC Nordic?

• An opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping our growth journey in the Nordic region.

• A vibrant company culture rooted in mutual respect, camaraderie, and a shared drive for success.

• A supportive team environment that values joy and celebrates collective and individual achievements.

• Chance to enjoy autonomy in your role, with the freedom to innovate and inspire across our various territories.

• An opportunity to contribute to a better, healthier world in collaboration with colleagues who are passionate about what they do.

🚀 Take your next career step✅ Apply without CV today, and supplement with an updated CV in English later.

📅 Application deadline: 2026-09-22

This recruitment is handled by GC Nordic and Odonti. Odonti handles the initial application and the first selection process and GC handles the second selections, interviews and hiring process.

If you have any questions please contact

Jashar Samadi at Odonti (hej@odonti.se) or Jyrki Kurokallio at GC (jyrki.kurokallio@gc.dental)

Odonti is a recruitment and staffing company in the dental industry. We recruit for permanent positions, and hire out consultants for time-limited assignments, based entirely on the consultants' availability and wishes.

Over 10,000 dental professionals in Sweden have connected and are in our candidate database and network. Feel free to connect with us at 👉🏼 Odonti.se

title: Strategic Project Manager
description:
Drive Strategy. Lead Growth. Make an Impact.

Instabee is changing the way last-mile deliveries work in Europe. We make online shopping faster, smarter, and more convenient. In Finland, we’ve scaled quickly—but we’re just getting started. Now, we need a strategic powerhouse to help shape our expansion, drive high-impact projects, and turn opportunities into growth.

If you’re an analytical problem solver who thrives on tackling complex business challenges, working cross-functionally, and translating strategy into execution, let’s talk.

What You’ll Do 📈 Shape the Strategy – Assess market opportunities, identify challenges, and help define the roadmap for Instabee Finland’s growth.

🔍 Lead High-Impact Projects – Take ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives that drive business performance and scale our operations.

🤝 Work with Leadership – Collaborate closely with the Country Manager and senior team to set targets and implement strategic plans.

📊 Use Data to Drive Decisions – Monitor performance, track key business metrics, and adjust strategies based on insights.

⚡ Remove Roadblocks – Identify challenges, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure our strategic initiatives run smoothly.

🚀 Think Big, Plan for the Future – We’re looking for someone with the ambition and potential to grow into a larger leadership role over time.

Who You Are

✅ A Strategic Thinker with a Commercial Edge – You have experience in strategy, management consulting, investment banking, or business development. Start-up/scale-up experience is a bonus.

✅ A Problem-Solver Who Gets Things Done – You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership, and know how to move projects forward.

✅ A Data-Driven Decision Maker – You use insights, analytics, and performance tracking to sharpen your approach and drive measurable impact.

✅ An Effective Communicator – You can turn complex ideas into clear, actionable plans and collaborate across teams.

✅ Experience Matters Most, but Education Helps – you have probably Master’s degree in business, economics, engineering, or a related field

✅ Fluent in English (Finnish is a bonus) – You can communicate clearly and persuasively in a fast-moving, international environment.

Why Instabee?

🌍 Join a Fast-Growing Company – Be part of a team that’s reshaping e-commerce logistics in Europe.

🚀 Advance Your Career – This role is built for growth, with a path toward broader leadership.

🏢 Work Flexibly – Hybrid setup with a modern Helsinki office centrally located in Kluuvi.

💡 Work with Cutting-Edge Tech – Shape the future of logistics with smart, data-driven solutions.

🎉 A Culture That Values Action – We move fast, make decisions quickly, and focus on what works.

Ready to Make an Impact? We’re looking for someone who’s ready to own projects, drive strategy, and shape the future of Instabee in Finland. If that’s you, apply today.

About Instabee

Instabee was founded in 2022 after combining Budbee and Instabox — two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox and Porterbuddy. Instabee is present in six countries, serving thousands of online merchants, including ASOS, Zalando, Inditex and H&M and is on track to become the most admired European e-commerce enabler.

In Finland, Budbee has been a key player since 2018 — and we’re moving fast.

title: Technical Expert
description:
Are you passionate about automation, embedded control systems, and solving complex technical challenges? Would you like to become a global expert supporting some of the world's most advanced marine and energy installations?

We are looking for aTechnical Expertto strengthen the Technical Services Automation team.The preferred location for the role isVaasa or Turku, Finland, but also other locations in Finland can be considered for the right candidate.In accordance withour local hybrid work model, you will be able to work partially remotely.This role also includestravelingapproximately 25% of the time.

In this role, you will become a key expert in embedded engine controls and automation systems, supporting customers and productsoperatingworldwide.This is a unique opportunity to combine hands-on troubleshooting, software configuration, field support, testing, and product development while working alongside experts across the global Wärtsilä network.

AtWärtsiläTechnical Services, you will join a highly specialized international team and gain in-depthexpertisein control systems for 4-stroke engines used in both marine and power plant applications.



Your role and responsibilities

As aTechnical Expert, you will play a key role in supporting and developing automation solutions forWärtsilä4-stroke enginesoperatingin marine and power plant applications worldwide.



Your responsibilities will include:

Providing high-level technical support to both internal and external customers remotely and on-site.


Investigating, troubleshooting, and resolving complex automation and control system issues.


Conducting site surveys, commissioning support, and field investigations around the world.


Simulating andanalyzingfield issues in our advanced automation laboratory using physical and virtual test environments.


Performing root cause analyses and supporting product reliability improvements.


Managing engine automation software configurations, upgrades, backups, and system modifications.


Collecting andanalyzingfield feedback, failure statistics, and operational data toidentifyimprovement opportunities.


Preparing technical documentation including service bulletins, manuals, investigation reports, and survey reports.


Initiating, leading, and supporting product and process development projects.


Collaborating with R&D and other technical departments to solve challenging technical problems and enhance product performance.


Supporting product introductions, validation, and testing activities for next-generation automation platforms.


Acting as a technical reference point for product and field-relatedexpertiseacross the organization.




Requirements for the position:

B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, Control Systems, or a related field.


Experience in technical troubleshooting and problem-solving.


Experience with embedded control or automation systems.


Strong analytical mindset and systematic approach to technical investigations.


Good communicationskills andproficiencyin English.


Willingness to travel approximately 25% of the time.




It would be great if you also have:

Experience with engine control systems, power generation, marine automation, or industrial automation.


Knowledge of generators, propulsion systems, or energy-related applications.


Experience with software configuration and diagnostics of embedded systems.


Interestin root cause analysis, testing, validation, and product development.


A collaborative mindset combined with curiosity and eagerness to learn.







Contact & next steps

We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout. Welcometo join us in shaping thedecarbonisationof marine and energy!

title: Business Development Representative
description:
**Your mission**

Do you thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and get excited about identifying new opportunities and initiating conversations with customers? **Business Development Representative (m/f/d)** In this role, youll be liaising with potential Finnish customers alongside our marketing team and Account Executives. Your main tasks will be to qualify leads generated by the marketing team (Marketing Qualified Leads, (MQL)) and incoming enquiries, and to ensure that potential customers are ready to move on to the next stage of the sales process. In addition, you will reach out to targeted potential client companies, thereby generating new sales opportunities. This role offers an excellent opportunity for a sales professional who enjoys building customer relationships and is motivated by tangible results. You can take on this role on a full-time or part-time basis.

**What you will be doing**

- You will respond quickly to leads generated by marketing and incoming enquiries, and contact potential customers when their interest is at its peak.

- You will identify potential customers needs, challenges and purchasing process, and assess their suitability as clients.

- You will arrange high-quality sales meetings and ensure that leads are seamlessly handed over to the appropriate Account Executive.

- You will carry out targeted outbound prospecting with pre-agreed specific client companies. And you will generate new sales opportunities.

- You will build trust with decision-makers and drive discussions forward with determination.

- You will handle objections professionally and identify the clients real challenges without resorting to a pre-written script.

- You will carefully log all activities, conversations and sales opportunities in the HubSpot CRM system.

- You will work closely with marketing and sales to improve the quality of leads and maximise their conversion rate.

- You work in a goal-oriented manner and consistently achieve your targets relating to the pipeline, meetings and lead qualification.


**Your profile**

- You have **2–4 years work experience as a Tele Sales Representative or Sales Development Representative (SDR) at a B2B SaaS company**.

- You have a proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding targets relating to the sales pipeline and the number of appointments, and you can demonstrate your results using concrete metrics.

- You are highly proficient at making outbound calls and know how to steer the conversation, ask insightful questions and handle objections with confidence.

- You are energetic and positive, and genuinely enjoy working with and talking to people.

- You are a native speaker of Finnish and can communicate well in English.

- You are self-motivated, receptive to feedback and tenacious. You actively seek feedback, learn quickly and remain motivated even after rejections and negative responses.

title: Automekaanikko, Pispalan Autot Oy (Tampere)

title: Safariopas, Simo

title: Haemme liikenteenohjaajia datakeskushankkeelle Vaasaan!
description:
**Haemme liikenteenohjaajia datakeskushankkeelle Vaasaan!**

**Työt alkavat heti, käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana**

**Keitä olemme?**

Ramudden luo kokonaisvaltaisia työturvallisuusratkaisuja tietöihin, rakennuksiin, tiloihin, rautateille ja erilaisiin infrastruktuurin projekteihin. Teemme työmme turvallisesti ja välittäen!

Tavoitteenamme on varmistaa se, että sinä ja kaikki muut liikenteessä liikkujat pääsevät turvallisesti töihin tai kouluun sekä takaisin kotiin. Minne sitten olettekin matkalla, turvaamme matkasi!

Liikenteenohjaajan työhön datakeskuksella kuuluu varmistaa työmaan läpikulkevan liikenteen turvallinen kulku ja eteneminen. Pidämme huolta myös kollegoistamme.

Työtä tehdään kahdessa vuorossa arkisin 06-21 välisenä aikana sekä lauantaisin 6-21. Työtä voi tehdä kokoaikaisesti tai osa-aikaisesti. Työajoista on mahdollista sopia joustavasti.

Sinun tulee olla täysi-ikäinen

Sinulla tulee olla normaalit aistit: näkö, kuulo ja reaktiokyky

Odotamme liikenteenohjaajiltamme myös hyvää liikennetuntemusta.

Tieturva 1-koulutus

Liikenteenohjaajan pätevyys

Turvallisen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön

Erilaisia työsuhde-etuja

title: Ammattitaitoinen mekaanikko – moottoriremonttien tai autosähkön osaaja
description:
**Ammattitaitoinen mekaanikko – moottoriremonttien tai autosähkön osaaja**

Etsimme joukkoomme **ammattitaitoista ja itsenäiseen työhön kykenevää mekaanikkoa**, jolla on vahvaa osaamista erityisesti **isommista moottoriremonteista TAI ajoneuvojen sähkö- ja vianmääritystöistä**. Vahva kokemus molemmista lasketaan suureksi eduksi.

Tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten ajoneuvojen parissa ja ratkaisemaan vaativiakin teknisiä ongelmia. Arvostamme tekijää, joka tuntee ajoneuvotekniikan perusteellisesti, tarttuu rohkeasti haastaviin töihin ja haluaa tehdä työnsä laadukkaasti alusta loppuun.

**Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat esimerkiksi**

- Isot moottoriremontit ja moottorien kunnostukset

- Moottorien purku-, kasaus- ja mittaustyöt

- Moottorin vianmääritys ja teknisten ongelmien ratkaiseminen

- Muu monipuolinen ajoneuvojen huolto- ja korjaustyö


**Tai**

- Ajoneuvojen sähkö- ja elektroniikkatyöt

- Sähkövikojen diagnosointi ja korjaaminen

- Vikakoodien luku ja järjestelmien vianmääritys

- Muu monipuolinen ajoneuvojen huolto- ja korjaustyö


**Odotamme sinulta**

- Vankkaa kokemusta automekaanikon tehtävistä

- Erityisesti vahvaa osaamista moottoriremonteista tai hyvää ajoneuvojen sähkötekniikan ja vianmäärityksen tuntemusta

- Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja ongelmanratkaisuun

- Huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta

- Alan koulutusta ja/tai vahvaa käytännön kokemusta


**Tarjoamme**

- Monipuolisen ja teknisesti haastavan työn

- Asiantuntevan työyhteisön ja hyvät työskentelyolosuhteet

- Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan

- Mahdollisuuden päästä tekemään vaativia töitä, joissa ammattitaidolla on oikeasti merkitystä


**Jos moottoriremontit eivät pelota tai autosähkö on sinulle tuttua hommaa, saatat olla etsimämme tekijä.**

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro lyhyesti kokemuksestasi, osaamisestasi sekä siitä, millaisten ajoneuvojen ja remonttien parissa olet työskennellyt.

**Paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.**

title: Sähkö-/kunnossapitoasentaja, Sähkö-Team Oy (Helsinki)
description:
Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme Sähkö-Team Oy:lle sähkömoottoreiden huoltoon ja korjaukseen keskittyvää asentajaa Helsingin Roihupellossa sijaitsevalle korjaamolle.

Sähkö-Team Oy on vuonna 1977 perustettu sähköalan yritys, jonka ydinosaamista ovat sähkökoneiden ja sähkömoottoreiden huolto ja korjaus. Yrityksen korjaamolla huolletaan ja korjataan monenlaisia sähkömoottoreita ja sähkökoneita eri käyttötarkoituksiin. Työhön kuuluu muun muassa sähköisiä ja mekaanisia korjauksia, moottoreiden vianmääritystä, huoltoja sekä tarvittaessa käämintätöitä. Sähkö-Team toimii monimerkkikorjaamona ja palvelee asiakkaita pääasiassa pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta sähkömoottoreita saapuu huoltoon myös muualta Suomesta.

Toimenkuva:

Etsimme käytännönläheistä ja teknisesti osaavaa henkilöä osaksi Sähkö-Teamin korjaamotiimiä. Työ on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen ja työtä tehdään arkisin klo 07.30 – 16.00. Tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan asiakasyrityksemme kirjoille.

Työ painottuu sähkömoottoreiden huoltoon, vianmääritykseen ja korjaukseen. Tehtävässä pääset käsittelemään erilaisia sähkömoottoreita ja sähkökoneita aina vian selvittämisestä moottorin purkamiseen, korjaamiseen, kokoonpanoon ja testaukseen asti.

Työskentely tapahtuu pääsääntöisesti korjaamolla, mutta työhön kuuluu tarvittaessa asiakaskohteissa tehtävät vianmääritys- ja mittaustyöt. Joskus isoja sähkömoottoreita huolletaan myös paikan päällä asiakkaan tiloissa, jolloin työskennellään työryhmässä yhdessä muiden Sähkö-Teamin asentajien kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi voi kuulua esimerkiksi:

\- sähkömoottoreiden huolto, korjaus ja testaus

\- moottoreiden purku, tarkastus ja kokoonpano

\- sähköisten vikojen vianmääritys, mittaukset ja kunnon arviointi

\- mekaaniset huolto- ja asennustyöt, kuten laakereiden ja tiivisteiden vaihdot

\- asiakaskohteissa tehtävät vianmääritys- ja kuntokartoituskäynnit

Työnhakijalta odotamme:

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on sähköalan koulutus ja käytännön ymmärrys sähkömoottoreista sekä sähkö- ja mekaniikkatöistä. Sinulla voi olla esimerkiksi taustaa teollisuuden kunnossapidosta, sähköasennuksista, koneiden huollosta tai muista tehtävistä, joissa sähköinen ja mekaaninen osaaminen yhdistyvät.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää erityisesti:

\- sähköalan koulutusta

\- ymmärrystä sähkömoottoreiden toiminnasta ja rakenteesta

\- sähköalan perusteiden ja sähkötöiden hallintaa

\- mekaanista asennusosaamista

\- kykyä tehdä vianmääritystä ja tulkita mittaustuloksia

\- käytännönläheistä ja itsenäistä työotetta

\- B-luokan ajokorttia

\- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

Tarjoamme sinulle kokoaikaisen ja vakituisen työn vakavaraisessa yrityksessä. Sähkö-Teamilla on vuosikymmenten kokemus sähköalalta ja sähkökoneiden korjaamisesta, joten sinulla on mahdollisuus hyödyntää omaa ammattitaitoa monipuolisesti ja samalla oppia lisää sähkömoottoreista, sähkökoneista ja niiden korjaamisesta.

Palkkaus määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä? Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten täytä hakemus pikimmiten ohessa olevan linkin kautta. Kerro hakemuksessa osaamisestasi ja aikaisemmasta työkokemuksesta. Vaihtoehtoisesti voit myös lähettää hakemuksen sekä ansioluettelosi sähköpostitse Clickin rekrytointikonsultti Matias Venemiehelle. Yhteydenotot ja lisätiedot tehtävästä arkisin klo 09:00 - 16:00, Matias Venemies - Click Henkilöstöpalvelut Oy, puh. 050 411 0416

title: Underhållsmontör - Rani Plast Oy
description:
**Vi söker underhållsmontörer till Rani Plast Oy i Terjärv!**

Vill du bidra till att säkerställa en välfungerande och modern produktionsmiljö? Hos Rani Plast får du möjlighet att vara med och utveckla underhållsverksamheten i ett stabilt, familjeägt och internationellt verksamt tillväxtföretag.

Som **underhållsmontör** ansvarar du för underhålls- och installationsarbeten kopplade till maskiner, utrustning och fastigheten.

Arbetet omfattar både förebyggande underhåll samt felsökning och reparationer vid driftstörningar. I rollen ingår även installationer, utvecklingsarbete och rapportering av utförda arbetsuppgifter i underhållssystemet.

**Vi söker dig som:**

- Har lämplig yrkesutbildning eller tidigare erfarenhet av liknande arbetsuppgifter

- Är initiativrik, ansvarstagande och noggrann

- Har god samarbetsförmåga samt vilja att lära dig nytt och utveckla din kompetens


**Vi erbjuder:**

- En tillsvidareanställning, samt dagarbete i ett internationellt tillväxtföretag.

- Möjlighet att aktivt utveckla både din egen kompetens och underhållsverksamheten

- Trevliga kollegor och ett kunnigt, engagerat team

- Omfattande personalförmåner (t.ex. Epassi och cykelförmån)


**Är du intresserad?**

Skicka in din ansökan redan idag, eller senast 4.10.2026. Vi intervjuar kandidater fortlöpande.

Rekryteringsprocessen hanteras av Agentor Oy. Ytterligare information fås av Agentor Oy:s Rekryteringskonsult Alexander Nyman, tel. 044 766 1848, **alexander.nyman@agentor.fi**.

**Rani Plast Oy**

_Familjeföretaget Rani Plast är en av Nordens ledande leverantörer av hållbara förpackningslösningar. Våra rötter finns starkt förankrade i Terjärv och våra produkter exporteras till över 50 länder. Vi har cirka 400 anställda i Finland och nio fabriker i fem olika länder, och vår omsättning uppgår till cirka 300 miljoner euro._

_Företaget grundades 1955 av Nils Ahlbäck i Terjärv, Finland. Runar Svartsjö och Alf, Nils och Ingmar Ahlbäck kombinerade sina första initialer för att skapa företagets namn RANI. Nils barn Mikael och Ulrika Ahlbäck äger företaget idag. Företaget avser att förbli ett familjeföretag._

Katsomme eduksi

We give you responsibility, but you won't be alone. Our work community is diverse and fair - we get things done right the first time. title: Area IT Manager Finland and Europe
description:
Ruukki Construction aims to drive the construction industry towards carbon neutrality with its products. Our 1,350 employees in 10 European countries and 14 specialized manufacturing sites provide steel-based building products and services for roofs and walls in sustainable buildings. We serve our customers locally under our main brands Ruukki and Plannja. Our net sales in 2024 were approximately EUR 481 million. We are of Nordic origin and share our values and long experience in the steel and construction industry with our parent company SSAB.

Do you want to be part of building a more sustainable future and be part of a professional and successful team in an international company? Maybe this is your new challenge!

We are looking fora strategic minded and hands-on Area IT Manager to manage local IT development and support activities in Finland and to oversee our regional IT operations across Ruukki locations in Central Eastern Europe. This role combines leadership, operational responsibility, and strategic execution in a dynamic international environment.

We are looking for a strategic minded and hands-on Area IT Manager to manage local IT development and support activities in Finland and to oversee our regional IT operations across Ruukki locations in Central Eastern Europe. This role combines leadership, operational responsibility, and strategic execution in a dynamic international environment.

The role has two main managerial responsibility areas; Firstly, oversee local IT development and support activities in Finland, ensuring business continuity from the IT perspective. And in this context act as line manager for the area IT team: manage performance, recruitment, budgeting, and other HR responsibilities. Secondly, you will lead a team of regional IT managers in Central and Eastern Europe: you will set goals, monitor progress, optimize resource allocation and ensure that best practices are evaluated and implemented as part of the knowledge sharing process.

All in all, you will contribute to the implementation of Ruukkis IT and business strategies and roadmaps. And when fit for purpose act as project manager for selected initiatives, such as IT and production capability development, acquisitions, and carve-outs.

The preferred location is Alajärvi, or any of our location in South Ostrobothnia, Finland.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure day-to-day IT support and development activities are aligned with Ruukki and SSAB IT policies (executed by internal teams and external vendors).

Lead the development of the Area Europe IT roadmap and resource planning.

Manage team-level IT costs, including annual budgeting and development proposals.

Oversee contracts and vendor management, including invoicing.

Collaborate with SSAB common IT on infrastructure and application development.

Define and implement collaboration models with business stakeholders across Europe.

Act as a general point of contact for infrastructure-related topics within Ruukki Construction IT management.

What we are looking for

· Strong knowledge of business applications and IT infrastructure (including security).

· Experience in strategy and roadmap execution.

· Solid understanding of business process development.

· Strong project management skills.

· Familiarity with agile methodologies and service delivery frameworks (e.g., ITIL).

· Proven vendor management skills.

· Strong leadership and team management capabilities.

· Has excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.

· The ideal candidate communicates fluently in Finnish and in English both written and oral.

We Offer

Our workplace fosters collaboration and personal growth, and everything we do is guided by our commitment to sustainability. Safety, innovation and reliability are at the heart of our business and ensure that everyone in our community thrives. Great colleagues and a supportive work community. Healthy work-life-balance and flexibility (hybrid working model). Lunch and wellbeing benefits. Occupational health services and much more!

Location

Your home base will be Ruukki Alajärvi (South Ostrobothnia) Finland. Some domestic and international travel is required.

How to Apply

Our recruitment partner Barona IT Talent will handle the application process and candidate communication. Please submit your application no later than 4th of October, 2026.

For more information, please contact:

Arja Martikainen, +358 40 7621564 (best reached Tue-Thu between 1-3 PM) or via emailat arja.martikainen(at)barona.fi

Please note: Background check may be a part of the recruitment process.

We decline contacts from recruitment agencies and ad sellers regarding this advertisement. Equally due to GDPR, please do not submit your application directly to recruiter email.

Position details

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

What happens to the value and purpose of creative work when people create alongside AI? This project studies how AI agents, AI-mediated processes and platform algorithms reshape co-creation and moral questions in creative industries. It follows employees, freelancers and studios as they negotiate changes to their work and business models. Through ethnographic fieldwork you will research what practitioners value within the activity of making creative work, and how that changes across human, hybrid and automated practices. The project aims to develop a practice-based account of co-creation and offer guidance for organisations and policymakers seeking equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.

Your work

- Study how AI agents and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, moral questions and business models in creative industries.
- Conduct ethnographic fieldwork with employees, freelancers and studios.
- Examine what practitioners value in creative work across human, hybrid and automated practices.
- Develop a practice-based account and guidance for equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Mikko Vesa (mikko.vesa@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Professor Mikko Vesa (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. The doctoral programme at Hanken is designed as a four-year full-time education, consisting of coursework, thesis work and teaching. Hanken provides comprehensive support throughout the doctoral journey, including supervision, study administration, performance monitoring, and assistance with funding. There is also support for applying for postdoctoral research funding.

Who we are looking for

Applicants should hold, or be close to completing by the start date, a relevant master's degree or equivalent and demonstrate the potential to undertake independent doctoral research. Research, policy or industry experience relevant to the project is advantageous.

Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

As AI becomes embedded in everyday work, employees increasingly interact with AI agents, but also encounter AI-mediated contributions from colleagues. Messages may be written, filtered or delivered with AI, while autonomous agents increasingly participate in work processes and collaboration.

This doctoral project examines how these developments shape relational aspects of work, (which may include authenticity, trust, social connection, and experiences of loneliness), as people negotiate emerging norms around AI use, disclosure, and appropriate forms of interaction. Through ethnographic research in AI-intensive settings, you will follow relational practices as they evolve over time and identify the mechanisms behind change.

The project will develop evidence-based guidance that supports transparency, social connection and responsible AI use in organisational life. Practitioner outputs include AI- aware communication norms, guidance on disclosure and authenticity in AI-assisted exchanges, and leadership practices that protect social connection and prevent relational deterioration. In addition, the doctoral project is expected to advance scientific knowledge in relation to the doctoral topic.

Your work

- Examine how interactions among people, AI agents and AI-mediated communication shape workplace relationships and collaboration.
- Conduct ethnographic research on how employees make sense of and negotiate AI use in workplace interactions, including norms of disclosure and transparency, and how these processes shape relational aspects of work.
- Identify the mechanisms through which AI-mediated contributions and autonomous agents reshape relational dynamics, and develop evidence-based guidance for responsible and socially sustainable AI use.
- Develop AI-aware communication norms and leadership guidance that protect social connection at work.

title: Process Engineer (Surface Treatment)
description:
Type: permanent, full-time

Location: Perniö, Turku, Tampere, Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Oulu, remote

Application deadline: 28.9.2026

Want to develop surface treatment processes in an international environment and impact production quality and efficiency? Wipro is looking for a Process Engineer!

**What will you be doing?**

We are looking for a Process Engineer to join Wipro Infrastructure Engineering as a technical expert in surface treatment. You will develop and evaluate new and existing surface treatment methods at Wipros manufacturing sites and support production, R&D, and other teams in technical matters. Your work will focus especially on industrial painting and pretreatment processes, corrosion testing, and improving process quality and efficiency.

Your projects may include reducing paint and energy use, improving cycle times, and finding more environmentally friendly solutions. You will also support equipment investments by defining technical requirements and taking part in testing and commissioning. In addition, you will help investigate production issues, support the technical handling of customer complaints, and work with customers, suppliers, and Wipro teams at the manufacturing sites in Perniö, Sweden, and Romania.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You have a strong practical and technical understanding of industrial surface treatment processes and experience in developing them. You understand not only individual process steps but also the whole process and how different changes can affect quality, costs, efficiency, and production. You are interested in improving processes and finding better technical solutions.

This is an independent and international role, so we value an accurate, organized, and proactive way of working as well as good communication and negotiation skills. Working with different teams, suppliers, and customers comes naturally to you, and you can adapt to changing situations. A practical and cost-conscious approach will help you succeed in this role.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant technical degree, for example in chemical, materials, process, production, or mechanical engineering

- Several years of relevant experience in industrial surface treatment and process development

- Strong knowledge of industrial painting and pretreatment processes, as well as electrolytic surface treatment methods

- Experience with AutoCAD and/or other technical design tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, or similar software

- Good English skills and willingness to travel to Wipros sites within Europe


**Additionally valued:**

- Experience with different surface treatment methods, such as nitrocarburizing or chromium processes

- Experience with equipment investments, commissioning, or technical development projects

- Knowledge of surface treatment testing, process requirements, or quality development


**Wipro offers you:**

- The freedom to develop surface treatment processes and make a real impact on quality, efficiency, and sustainability

- An international environment where you work across manufacturing sites and develop your technical skills

- The opportunity to develop new solutions and help shape the future of surface treatment at Wipro

- A varied expert role combining technical development, projects, and practical problem-solving

- The flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in Finland


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy. We hope you are available to start as soon as possible, depending on your notice period.

You can work either at Wipros Perniö site or remotely from anywhere in Finland. The position includes approximately 50–60 travel days per year, mainly to Wipros sites in Finland, Sweden, and Romania. Salary in this position is 4500-5500 €/month (gross), depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**How to apply?**

Please submit your CV and application in PDF format in English by Monday 28th of September via aTalents application system: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/382498/create/ .

Remember to use the application system as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure an equal recruitment process for all applicants and will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can learn more about Wipro Infrastructure Engineering here: https://hydraulics.wiproinfra.com/.

For more information about the position and recruitment process, please contact aTalents Recruitment Consultant Säde Juntunen (+358 44 901 2283, sade.juntunen@atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as possible.

**Company description**

_Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy develops, manufactures, and markets high-quality hydraulic cylinders and hydraulic components under the Nummi trademark. The company is also a well-known OEM manufacturer of double-acting hydraulic cylinders. Wipro operates internationally, and about 70% of its turnover comes from exports. In addition to Finland, its main markets are Scandinavia, Poland, the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, and Switzerland._

_Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy is a subsidiary of the Indian company Wipro Enterprises. Its parent company, Wipro Ltd, is an international multi-business corporation listed on the New York and Mumbai stock exchanges. The company is headquartered in Bangalore, India. Wipro Infrastructure Engineering has manufacturing facilities in Finland (Perniö), Sweden, Romania, Brazil, India, Canada, and the United States._

Työssä tarvitaan oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta. Kilometrikorvaukset maksamme verohallinnon ohjeiden mukaisesti. Edellytämme myös, että sinulla on lääkeluvat kunnossa. Katsomme eduksi aiemman kokemuksen työskentelystä lasten parissa.

Palkkauksessa käytämme yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, kuitenkin toiveena olisi, että mahdollisimman pian. Tarjoamme sinulle innovatiivisen ja kehityskykyisen työyhteisön, jossa on vireä TYHY-toiminta ja pääset itse vaikuttamaan myös työvuorojärjestelyihin.

Mikäli kiinnostuit meistä, niin kysy lisää Jennyltä tai laita suoraan hakemuksesi tulemaan sähköpostilla osoitteeseen jenny.juvani@kodinunna.fi. Hakuaikaa on 30.9.2026 saakka, mutta täytämme tehtävän heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten ethän aikaile, vaan pistä hakemuksesi tulemaan jo tänään.

Tule joukkoomme, odotamme jo sinua. Olemme Oulussa uusi toimija, joten olet avainpaikalla, pystyt vaikuttamaan työyhteisöön, palveluihimme sekä kehittyvään työn sisältöön. Olemme nopeasti kasvava yritys ja tuotamme monipuolisia kotihoitopalveluita kotisiivouksesta hoivapalveluun sekä lapsiperheiden palveluihin. Lue meistä lisää www.kodinunna.fi

title: Myyjä, S-market Levi, Osuuskauppa Arina
description:
Primary location:
KITTILÄ

MYYJÄS-market Levi
Tule meille myyjäksi Levin S-markettiin. Työsuhde on vakituinen, 25 h/vko tuntisopimuksella ja alkaa mahdollisimman pian sopivan tekijän löydyttyä, viimeistään marraskuun alussa 2026. Pääset työskentelemään uudessa S-market Levissä, joka on valmistunut keväällä 2026. Levillä me tehdään ihan tavallisia töitä poikkeuksellisen upeissa maisemissa – keskellä Lapin luontoa, ja kansainvälistä tunnelmaa.

S-market-myyjän työ Levillä on monipuolista, vauhdikasta ja vaihtelevaa. Päiviisi kuuluu muun muassa tuotteiden hyllytystä ja esillepanoa, kuorman purkua, asiakaspalvelua ja rahankäsittelyä sekä hävikin- ja saatavuudenhallintaa. Tärkeintä työssäsi on asiakkaiden huomioiminen ja lämminhenkinen palvelu - päivittäistavarakaupan arjessa pääset toteuttamaan sydämellistä palvelua myös kansainvälisille asiakkaille, joten asiakaslähtöinen asenne ja kielitaito ovat työssäsi tärkeitä. Eduksesi katsomme aiemman kaupanalan tai asiakaspalvelukokemuksen. Työvuorot vaihtelevat kaupan aukioloaikojen mukaan, ja halutessasi työhön voi sisältyä myös kuorman purkua, joka tapahtuu sesongissa yöaikaan.

Tässä työssä pärjäät, kun sinulta löytyy
Valmiutta työskennellä S-market Levin kaikissa työvuoroissa, katso S-market Levi aukioloajat
Joustavuutta ja kykyä toimia reippaasti kiireen keskellä positiivisella asenteella
Täysi-ikäisyyttä
Suomen ja englannin kielitaitoa – muu kielitaito on ehdottomasti plussaa

Ihan tavallisia töitä – epätavallisen hyvät edut
Kansainvälinen työympäristö, huiput työkaverit ja kokemuksia, jotka jäävät mieleen vielä pitkäksi aikaa
Kokeneen esihenkilön, joka on aidosti läsnä arjessa, helposti lähestyttävä ja tiiminsä tukena päivittäisessä työssä.
