title: Can you combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations?
description:
Bergen Engines is entering an important phase of factory development and production ramp-up. To support this, we are strengthening the Special Projects team with one to two Project Managers who can lead cross-functional initiatives and help turn our operational ambitions into practical, executable projects. Reporting to the Head of Special Projects, you will work closely with Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, HSE, Facilities and Finance. The project portfolio is expected to include assembly-capacity and ramp-up initiatives, factory layout and material-flow improvements, tooling and facility investments, CAPEX projects and other operational-improvement activities required to increase manufacturing capability towards 2028.     Your key responsibilities
  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables and success criteria.
  • Develop and maintain credible project plans covering milestones, resources, costs and dependencies.
  • Coordinate cross-functional project teams and ensure clear ownership of actions.
  • Identify and manage project risks, issues, changes and key decisions.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts and escalate constraints or decisions early.
  • Support business cases, investment requests and CAPEX governance where applicable.
  • Work directly with factory teams to understand constraints and implement practical solutions.
  • Drive projects relating to capacity, throughput, assembly flow, material readiness, layout, tooling and process improvement.
  • Provide concise and transparent progress reporting to project sponsors and relevant governance forums.
  • Ensure that projects are delivered safely, on time, within approved cost and with measurable operational benefits.
  • Coordinate effective handover of completed projects into the responsible operational organisation.
Who are we looking for?  We are looking for people who combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations. You may already work as a Project Manager, or you may have led substantial projects or workstreams within Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Facilities or another relevant area.   Your qualifications: 
  • Education within technical fields and knowledge of manufacturing. If you have particularly long and relevant experience the education requirement may be disregarded. 
  • 8-10 years of experience from related role.
  • Experience from planning and delivering cross-functional projects or significant work packages.
  • A good understanding of complex engineering or manufacturing environments.
  • The ability to convert broad objectives into clear actions, milestones and accountabilities.
  • A practical and visible approach, including working directly with teams on the factory floor.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of project costs, benefits and priorities.
  • A strong commitment to safety, quality and sustainable operational improvement.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Fluent skills in both writing and orally in English and preferably also in Norwegian.
Knowledge of Bergen Engines’ products, manufacturing processes, assembly operations and internal systems will be an advantage. A formal project-management or relevant technical qualification is beneficial, but a demonstrated record of successful delivery is equally important.   Your personal characteristics
  • Ability to work independently towards goals. 
  • A good team player. 
  • Good cooperative and communicative skills. 
  • Structured and analytical. 
  • Curious and outgoing, not afraid to ask questions and suggest improvements. 
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, resolve obstacles and escalate decisions when necessary.
  • Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills.
 

Why choose Bergen Engines?

For more than 80 years, Bergen Engines has delivered world-class power and propulsion systems to customers around the globe. Today, we're playing a key role in the maritime industry through innovative and efficient engine technology.

From our headquarters in Bergen, Norway, we work closely with customers worldwide, combining Norwegian engineering expertise with international reach. As part of the Langley Holdings Power Solutions Division, we're investing in growth, new markets, and the people who will help drive our future success.

These positions offer an opportunity to:
  • Contribute directly to Bergen Engines’ future manufacturing capability.
  • Lead visible projects with tangible operational impact.
  • Work across multiple functions and broaden your business experience.
  • Help shape how strategic factory projects are planned, governed and delivered.
  • Develop further within project management and operational leadership.

 

What we offer:

  • At Bergen Engines, you'll have the opportunity to work with advanced technology, international customers and colleagues who are passionate about what they do.
  • Meaningful work that contributes to a more sustainable future.
  • An international environment with exciting growth opportunities.
  • Professional and personal development in a technology-driven company.
  • Competitive salary and company-wide bonus scheme.
  • Flexible working hours and strong work-life balance.
  • Excellent pension and insurance arrangements.
  • Company cabin at Kvamskogen and employee discount programs.
  • Active sports clubs and social activities.
  • Occupational health services.
  • A highly skilled team that supports and challenges each other.

 

Are you ready to join our team?

At Bergen Engines, you'll join one of Norway's leading industrial technology companies and help deliver the power solutions that keep the world moving.

Work location is our headquarters and production facility at Hordvikneset, approximately 20 km north of Bergen city centre.

The position reports to Head of Special Projects- Nanda Kishore. 

For questions please contact: Nanda per mobile +4748286461 or e-mail nanda.kishore@bergenengines.com

Application deadline: 20.09.2026. Applications will be reviewed continuously.


Bergen Engines bygger og utvikler medium speed-motorer til landbaserte anlegg og til applikasjoner i den maritime næringen. Våre motorer er kjent for kvalitet og pålitelighet, og har en ingeniørtradisjon som strekker seg tilbake til 1855 da Bergen Mekaniske Verksted (BMV) ble etablert. Bedriften bygde sin første dieselmotor i 1946, og siden den gang har over 7500 motorer blitt levert der over halvparten fortsatt er i drift i dag. Tidligere kjent som Rolls-Royce Bergen Engines, ble bedriften en del av det britiske, privateide ingeniørselskapet Langley Holdings plc. 31. desember 2021.

title: Research Fellow – gene editing and cell-based therapy
description:
About the position 

We invite applications for a 6‑month position in our project on cell-based therapy for inherited bleeding disorders. 

The position is part of an ongoing project funded by the Norwegian Research Council and affiliated with the Institute of Clinical Medicine, Division of Cancer Medicine, University of Oslo, with daily work based at Oslo University Hospital, Rikshospitalet. 

The research group has long-standing expertise in basic, translational and clinical research on blood coagulation factors and their role in disease. 


More about the position 

The project focuses on inherited factor VII (FVII) deficiency, a rare but serious bleeding disorder caused by mutations in the F7 gene, leading to markedly reduced FVII activity, and applies advanced technologies such as  CRISPR-based gene editing, induced pluripotent stem cells and liver organoids to rescue the FVII expression in patient-derived cells.

The position will support continued experimental work and data analysis within in vivo pre-clinical studies, which form an important foundation for future cell-based therapies in patients with FVII deficiency. 

The research fellow is expected to contribute actively to experimental design, execution and troubleshooting, as well as to the interpretation and reporting of results. 


Qualifications 

Qualification requirements

  • MSc (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline (e.g. medicine, molecular biology, cell biology, biotechnology or similar). 
  • Demonstrated ability to design, plan and execute in vitro and in vivo experiments. 
  • Formal accreditation for work with animal models (e.g. FELASA C or equivalent) AND experience with mouse surgery and xenotransplant. 
  • Experience with stem cell work and stem cell-derived 3D hepatic organoid differentiation. 
  • Proficiency in English, both written and oral. 

Persoonal skills

  • We are looking for a candidate who is: 
  • Highly motivated and enthusiastic about translational research 
  • Organized, structured and able to work independently 
  • Flexible 
  • A team player with excellent communication and collaboration skills 

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

title: Head of Technology Development
description:
About reTyre

At reTyre, we're not just another tyre company; we're revolutionising the industry. With our groundbreaking machines that can produce tyres from any material, we're setting new standards for what's possible. Imagine tyres that are biodegradable, luminescent, reflective, and more. This is not in the future; this is happening now. But that's not all; our new production technology opens up previously unimaginable opportunities.

We want you to be a part of this exciting journey. We're looking for an experienced leader with excellent talent in Project and People management. These qualities combined with R&D experience will contribute to driving our technologies and developments to the next level.


The Role

As Head of Technology Development at reTyre, you'll be at the forefront of leading the development team in innovative projects, meaning that you will own overall responsibilities of coordination, strategic planning, risk management, and ensure that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the expected quality standards, always pushing the boundaries of what's possible in tyre technology.

But that's just the beginning.

Your role will extend beyond your team. You'll have the unique opportunity to work across departments, collaborating with our Commercial, Material and Manufacturing teams to take part in shaping the brand's next steps to meet and create new market demands and segments.

You'll also collaborate with technology teams from leading international brands, offering a global perspective to your teams’ work. Your involvement will span the entire development cycle—from the fuzzy front-end of ideation, through testing, designing manufacturing tools, overseeing trial production, and finally, to commercialization.

In essence, no two days will be the same. The team, will under your pristine management, pioneer new and sustainable tyre products, transforming not just how tyres look, but how the world views them. Your team’s work will be the future of the tyre industry.


Responsibilities

  • Oversee and drive the team towards successful execution of development projects according to company milestones.

  • Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation as well as provide progress updates, gather feedback, and make necessary project adjustments.

  • Assign tasks and responsibilities, ensuring team members have the resources needed for success.

  • Ensure projects adhere to relevant regulations, standards, and best practices, as well as implement quality control measures to ensure outputs meet required specifications and standards.

  • Lead the way! We are looking for an experienced people manager with a high focus on team building as well as being attentive to the individual, bringing out the best in both.

  • Leading with a culture of continuous improvement and innovation, that fosters a collaborative environment.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Project management, Engineering, Science, or a related field.

  • Proven experience in project management, with a track record of successful project delivery.

  • Strong leadership and people management skills and experience.

  • Proficient in project management tools and software.

  • Background from R&D


Personal Characteristics

  • Forward-thinking, engaged and a natural leader.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Strategic and operative thinker with the ability to manage multiple complex projects at the same time, and lead a team to achieve innovative outcomes.


Why Join reTyre?

Be a Pioneer: This is an unparalleled opportunity to be the driving force of technologies that have never been seen before.

Influence: Your leadership will drive innovation and progress in our technology to set the new industry standard, impacting how tyres are made and used globally.

Career Growth: As a fast-growing company, we offer tremendous opportunities for career advancement.

Competitive Salary and Benefits: We offer a competitive package.

Dynamic Team: Work with a team as forward-thinking and innovative as you are.


How to Apply

If you're ready to take on the challenge of a lifetime and make a global impact, send us your application, including your CV and other relevant documentation, demonstrating your relevant experience.

Applications are continuously evaluated, so apply today and redefine the future with us at reTyre.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We are an award-winning tyre manufacturer focusing on innovation and sustainability and the first company in the world capable of mass-producing pneumatic tyres without the use of rubber. As pioneers in tyre manufacturing, we’re spearheading an ambitious production method that integrates cutting-edge technologies from multiple industries. As a result, our tyres have significantly lower emissions compared to conventional tyres. reTyre wants to make the lives of various vehicle users easier by sustainable tyre solutions. Above anything else, reTyre values an innovative and fearless entrepreneurial mindset. JOIN THE REVOLUTION Make A Real Difference If you have been dreaming of being part of something great – now’s your time. We’re not just another tyre company. We’re building a state-of-the-art factory with groundbreaking machines, pushing the boundaries of innovation. Our mission? Leading the charge in sustainability and innovation. We have multiple positions open in all departments of our company and we are always looking for talented people who want to be a part of our exciting growth journey and make a real difference.

title: Senior Embedded Software Developer
description:
About us

Sensio is the leading provider of care technology in the Nordics, solving today's and tomorrow's care challenges for the benefit of service recipients, healthcare professionals, and society. We create sensors, systems, and platforms that radically improve the quality and efficiency of health care – leading the sector to embrace technology and provide #MoreTimeForCare.

We are on an exciting journey from being the leading tech company in Scandinavia in the elderly care space to becoming a trusted transformation partner across Europe. With the backing of Nordic Capital, one of Europe’s top private equity firms, we’re ready to take our flagship product, RoomMate, to the world.

RoomMate is a revolutionary safety sensor that detects and reduces falls using advanced algorithms. In addition, the sensor can be used for digital supervision and passive notification in case of dangerous situations. Both hardware and software are developed in-house by the RoomMate team.


About the role

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Software Developer who is product-driven, takes ownership, thinks big, and makes a real impact. You’ll be at the core of our product development, working on embedded software that powers the RoomMate sensor. In addition, you’ll have the freedom to take the lead and drive innovation forward.

The position is based across two locations: RoomMate’s Sandvika office and Sensio’s central Oslo headquarters.


What you'll be doing 
  • Developing embedded software in C++.
  • Collaborating with a world-class team of engineers, designers, and product managers to define and shape RoomMate’s evolution. 
  • Mentoring and supporting others by fostering an environment of knowledge-sharing and continuous learning within the team.
  • Taking ownership of complex problems, driving solutions with autonomy.
  • Contributing to product discovery, ensuring we build the right solutions for real-world healthcare challenges.


What we're looking for 
  • Expertise in C++ with a solid background in embedded software development on Linux.
  • Ownership mindset- You anticipate challenges, take initiative, and drive solutions forward.
  • A team player- You thrive in a team environment, sharing knowledge and growing together.
  • A product-oriented thinker- You think beyond code and understand how technology impacts the end user.
  • Fluent in English (Norwegian is a plus, or a willingness to learn). 


In addition, it's nice if you have one of the following 
  • Experience with Embedded Linux (Yocto).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and testing.
  • Experience in signal processing, ML, or AI.
  • Understanding of hardware development.
  • Knowledge of communication technologies such as TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, mobile, or Bluetooth.


What we offer 
  • Meaningful work with purpose – making a difference for health care personnel, patients, and next-of-kin.
  • The opportunity to be part of a Norwegian tech company with ambitions of becoming a global leader.
  • Having a big impact on the development of Sensio’s flagship product.
  • To be part of an innovative culture focused on collaboration and user-centric development.
  • Great opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Sensio, we’re on a mission to accelerate the digital transformation of care. With roots in the Nordic start-up scene, we’ve grown into a fast-scaling caretech company backed by Nordic Capital, with more than 230 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK – and now expanding into Germany. Our technology is already installed in thousands of care homes and hospitals, helping staff prevent falls, save lives, and free up time for what really matters: people. We build everything from advanced safety sensors and cloud platforms to apps and data tools – all developed in-house by our 80+ product and tech specialists. What makes Sensio unique? - Impact with scale – our solutions improve everyday life for tens of thousands of residents and caregivers, and we’re just getting started. - A true growth journey – from Nordic frontrunner to European scale-up, we’re building the leading caretech platform of tomorrow. - Innovation at heart – our R&D teams shape the future of care technology with cutting-edge hardware, AI, and software. - People-first culture – we believe the best products come from teams that feel at home, have freedom to experiment, and share knowledge across borders. If you want to be part of a meaningful growth story – where tech meets one of society’s biggest challenges – join us. Let’s create more time for care.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Glint Solar is an Oslo-based startup accelerating the solar energy revolution. We streamline the process of finding optimal solar project locations using GIS and climate data, making renewable energy development faster and simpler.


Our Team

We are a diverse, fun-loving team with varied interests, from astrophysics to frisbee golf to DJing on the weekend. What unites us is our support for each other, a passion for solving complex problems, and a commitment to driving positive change through technology.


The Role

We seek experienced software engineers that are skilled in their craft and always keeps the big picture in mind. Software engineers are involved early from understanding the problems customers face, prioritization and how to best solve them, together with design and product. We don't have separate front-end, back-end or infrastructure teams, everyone is "full-stack", but it's ok to have a preference. Day to day you will be working with React, Node and Python. We use AWS as our infrastructure provider. Our product is heavily centered around maps, and we use Mapbox as our map provider.

Our product team is on-site in Oslo so for this role we expect you to come in to the office as a rule. That said, we offer flexibility around working remotely when needed.


What we offer

  • A committed team of ambitious and motivated colleagues.

  • Opportunity to join a fast-growing startup with global reach.

  • Participation in our option scheme.

  • Lots of laughter.


Location: Oslo, Norway  For more information about working at Glint Solar, you can have a look at our website: https://www.glintsolar.com/careers

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Glint Solar is accelerating the adoption of solar energy by building the world's leading solar screening and analysis software. One of the main headaches for the development of large scale solar is identifying where to build and understanding the specific site conditions - we're tackling this! The world needs to build more renewable energy to combat climate change. We in Glint Solar believe that technology is the solution. We are therefore working effortlessly on building technology for developers of solar energy parks. We started with the very exciting floating solar market as this is one of the fastest growing energy sectors in the world and have since expanded into land based solar as well. We're backed by leading Norwegian and international VCs and private equity. Our HQ is at Mesh Nationaltheatret in Oslo where our international team works from, but we serve our global customer base with a focus on Europe. Some of our interesting customers include TotalEnergies, Alight and Statkraft. We have the culture of a startup with a flat hierarchy, where the idea matters, not who had it. We encourage trying new things, even if it fails. At Glint Solar you will have the freedom to do your best work – and focus your efforts on what *you* are good at. We believe in adapting to our people and their strengths – not the other way around. We back each other up, make sure obstacles are out of the way, and then we GO! And sometimes, quite often, actually, we go do something fun together, like cabin trips, company trips and social events. All with lots of laughter. We consider ourselves very privileged to have smart, curious, and caring colleagues who are working together towards our mission. We are comprised of 23 different people with nine different nationalities and a wide range of diversity of thought. Amongst us you’ll find coffee connoisseurs, map nerds, Mandarin speakers, yoga enthusiasts, foodies, cross-country skiiers, olive farmers, frisbee golfers, colleagues who DJ on the weekend and everything in between – because we value exactly who YOU are. Regardless of what you enjoy and value outside of work, there’s a place for you in Glint Solar.

title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description:
Nofence is a Norwegian scale up who has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we aim to revolutionise livestock management we will need top-notch competence in our Engineering team, and we are now looking for a Senior Project Manager. Elevate your career with us and be at the forefront of innovation in agricultural technology! Your role

Our Product & Engineering team design and develop the mechanics of our physical product and the electronics that goes into it. We develop the firmware that runs on the device and the cloud service it communicates with. We design and develop the mobile and web apps that our customers use. In short, there’s a lot of exciting work to be done, and by joining us you will be one of our keys to success!

We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Project Manager to join our Product & Engineering team to drive project management excellence. We also believe, and are sure you agree, that presence with our customers and observing the animals are important to further develop the product in use. In the field you will gather much information and use that input to make our product even better.


Your responsibilities

  • Drive execution of cross-functional initiatives, ensuring projects are delivered on time, with high quality, and in alignment with Nofence’s strategic goals.

  • Define project plans, timelines, and milestones, while proactively managing risks, dependencies, and resources.

  • Serve as the main point of coordination between product, engineering, design, operations, and other stakeholders to maintain alignment and transparency.

  • Lead task forces during critical incidents, ensuring rapid coordination across teams to mitigate short- and long-term impacts.

  • Run daily stand-ups or incident response meetings to ensure swift communication and decision-making.

  • Ensure corrective and preventative actions are identified, implemented, and tracked to avoid recurrence of similar issues.

  • Manage new hardware projects end-to-end, from concept through to mass-volume production.

  • Coordinate across disciplines such as mechanical engineering, electronics, firmware, UX, manufacturing, and sourcing to ensure successful integration and delivery.

  • Oversee prototype builds, testing cycles, and validation activities, ensuring issues are tracked, prioritised, and resolved.

  • Partner with manufacturing and supply chain teams to ensure scalability and readiness for production ramp-up.

  • Advocate for data-driven decision-making and consistent use of project management tools and metrics.

  • Act as the primary point of contact between management, technical teams, and other stakeholders. Provide regular updates on project progress and challenges.

  • You will rely on the hardware product owner to drive the product and market requirements, while the project manager will be responsible for making sure the project is executed according to the right cost, time and quality, and fulfils those requirements set forward by the product owner.


Qualifications

The right candidate is preferred to have the following qualifications:

  • Minimum 3 years of project management experience, ideally in electro-mechanical or IoT product development.

  • Bachelor's or Masters degree in relevant field.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Excellent planning, coordination, and multi-tasking abilities.

  • Proactive approach to identifying and resolving project challenges.

  • Driven and result oriented, always exploring ways to improve the timeline, cost and quality of any given project.

  • Fluent English oral and written communication skills. Our working language is English.


About Nofence 

Managing livestock has always been a challenge. Humanity has tried everything from herding with dogs to walling the animals in with barbed wire, electric, and wooden fences, but these are costly and time-consuming solutions and often in conflict with the local wildlife. It has also left vast areas of potential pasture overgrown and underutilized.

Until now.

Enter virtual fences. What started as a small group of farmers and engineers with a big idea has become Nofence – the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. Curious about how it works? Find out more here.


About Us

As a company still in our early stages, our way of working is continuously evolving, and you will have the opportunity to make an impact on how we do things. We are passionate about product development, animal welfare, farmer welfare and sustainable agriculture. We genuinely believe our grazing technology is the biggest technological change in agriculture since the tractor!

So far, our clients have used Nofence in a range of creative ways, including regenerative cattle farming, conservation grazing with goats, regenerative grazing with sheep, and even government work! Yet we have only just scratched the surface, and already have 700 million hours of operation on animals with recorded behaviour data to explore.

Still curious? Visit our website.

The Product and Engineering team is currently a team of 35 employees working across our three Norwegian offices. We are open for candidates that can work from either Molde, Trondheim or Oslo. We believe in cooperation, adaptiveness, and a fun and relaxed working environment.   


What we bring to the table

At Nofence, we're not your typical 9-to-5 gig. We're a dynamic scale-up, creating a work atmosphere that's anything but ordinary. It's a place where dedication and innovation are the norm, offering great opportunities for your personal and professional growth.

If you're the right fit, you'll be part of a tight-knit team, supporting each other to make a real impact on the agricultural industry. With offices in Oslo and Trondheim for the city strollers and our Molde office surrounded by nature for the outdoor enthusiasts, we've got the best of both worlds.

We believe in seeing results fast. As an engineer with us, your work won't be lost in the bureaucratic shuffle. You'll witness the immediate impact of your contributions in real-time, influencing the evolution of our cutting-edge virtual fencing solution for livestock.

Join us, where ambition meets reality, and let's keep pushing the boundaries in the world of agri-tech!


About the Application

Are you ready to change pasture? After all, the grass is sometimes greener on the other side. Also, just like the soil needs a balanced diversity of nutrients to thrive, a company needs a diversity of hearts and minds. We are an equal opportunity employer! We will evaluate candidates continuously. If you have any questions about Nofence or regarding the application, please reach out to our CPTO, Egil Anonsen at below email.

Vår beiteteknologi skal bidra til at mer av verdens arealressurser kan utnyttes til bærekraftig matproduksjon.En stor andel beitedyr lever mesteparten av livet innendørs og spiser mye kraftfor. Målsettingen til Nofence er å få beitedyra ut på beite, på en trygg og god måte, slik at de kan ha det godt og selv finne den maten de er skapt for å spise.Vi vil at beitedyr skal få muligheten til å ta i bruk sitt naturlige miljø. Det er god dyrevelferd og det vil frigjøre store arealer som kan brukes til å dyrke menneskemat i stedet for soya i kraftforproduksjon.Vår teknologi gir dyra denne muligheten.

You will be part of a small but growing team where your work has a direct impact. Developers at Sensio help shape not only the code, but also the product itself.

The position is based at Sensio’s central Oslo headquarters.

  • Collaborate with product managers and business stakeholders to evaluate ideas

  • Strong understanding of Clean Architecture, SOLID principles and Data Structures

  • Experience building scalable distributed systems

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • At least five years of relevant experience (but skills and mindset matter most)

What we offer

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About Sensio

Sensio is a Nordic leader in the health care technology sector and is solving the elderly care challenges of today – and building the solutions of tomorrow for the benefit of residents, patients, healthcare personnel, and society. We create sensors, systems, and platforms that radically improve the quality and efficiency of health care – leading the sector to embrace technology and provide #MoreTimeForCare.

Sensio is on a journey from being the leading tech company in Scandinavia in the elderly care space to becoming a trusted transformation partner across Europe. We were acquired by Nordic Capital in 2024, one of Europe’s top private equity companies. Sensio has one of the leading in-house product development organizations in Norway, with about 80 product people. In total, we are a team of 220 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK, and Germany.

Read more about Sensio and our products here.


About the role

Sensio is on an exciting growth journey, transforming how we manage and deliver our SaaS offerings in healthcare and welfare technology. We are now looking for two experienced DevOps Engineers to join our Infrastructure & DevOps team.

You will be part of the group responsible for scaling, maintaining, and modernising the infrastructure behind Sensio’s S365 SaaS platform, including Unity, Vista, Insight, and our Dataplatform. We are moving from traditional infrastructure management to Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and Configuration-as-Code (CaC), using tools like Terraform, PowerShell, and Azure Graph. This enables us to automate, scale efficiently, and build highly reliable systems that empower our customers and internal teams.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will have an immediate impact by supporting our rapid customer growth, enhancing platform reliability, and driving the delivery of new functionality. You will also play a key role in enabling new ways of working across Sensio as we continue to scale. 


Where you’ll work

You will be part of our Infrastructure & DevOps team, currently consisting of a Team Lead and three engineers. With your addition, the team will grow to five, with further expansion planned. We collaborate closely within the team and across various development teams to ensure our infrastructure supports Sensio’s ambitious product goals.

Location: Sensio HQ - Møllergata 4, Oslo (with flexibility for hybrid work). 


What you will do

  • Build and operate cloud-native infrastructure on Azure and on-prem environments.

  • Manage Kubernetes clusters, SQL/Postgres databases, Redis, and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps and GitHub Enterprise).

  • Migrate existing services to IaC and CaC using Terraform, PowerShell, and automation frameworks. 

  • Implement and maintain robust observability solutions (monitoring, logging, alerting) to ensure high reliability and proactive operations.

  • Support and improve our CI/CD pipelines to enable smooth and reliable deployments.

  • Collaborate with product teams to ensure infrastructure meets current and future scalability needs.

  • Maintain high operational standards, ensuring platform reliability, security, and compliance.

  • Facilitate new teams and ways of working to enable delivery of new functionality as we grow.


Who you are

We believe you are a skilled engineer who takes ownership, thrives in a collaborative environment, and enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges.


We’re looking for someone with:

  • Deep expertise in at least one core area: Kubernetes, IaC with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud operations.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure and hybrid cloud environments.

  • Outstanding communication and collaboration skills.

  • Strong sense of ownership and responsibility.

  • Comfortable working as an individual contributor focused on delivering results. 

  • Fluency in English. Norwegian is a plus. 


What we offer

  • The opportunity to work on products that improve thousands of lives.

  • A chance to shape Sensio’s infrastructure and platform capabilities during a period of major transformation.

  • The opportunity to take ownership of specific areas, becoming a domain expert and trusted advisor.

  • Daily collaboration with diverse engineering teams.

  • A role where your approach and values will help define how we collaborate, learn, and support each other within the team. 

  • Hybrid work options and a culture built on trust and flexibility.

At Sensio, we’re on a mission to accelerate the digital transformation of care. With roots in the Nordic start-up scene, we’ve grown into a fast-scaling caretech company backed by Nordic Capital, with more than 230 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK – and now expanding into Germany. Our technology is already installed in thousands of care homes and hospitals, helping staff prevent falls, save lives, and free up time for what really matters: people. We build everything from advanced safety sensors and cloud platforms to apps and data tools – all developed in-house by our 80+ product and tech specialists. title: UX/UI Designer
description:
Full-Time UX/UI Designer Opportunity

Remote · Global Team · Start: Beginning-Mid of October

Klingit is looking for a Mid–Senior UX/UI Designer to join our global creative team full-time. This role goes beyond designing interfaces, you will shape digital experiences that deliver measurable impact. If you thrive on creating user-centered, conversion-focused products while leveraging design systems, research, and AI-powered workflows, we want to hear from you.


About Klingit

We are building the most efficient marketing team in the world. We work with ambitious brands and use smart workflows, talented people, and the latest tools to deliver better and faster creative solutions. This is your opportunity to be part of a company reshaping how brand and marketing services are delivered.


Key Responsibilities

Creative Strategy & Design Excellence

  • Design responsive, user-centered interfaces following UX/UI best practices and accessibility standards.

  • Build wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that communicate user flows and interactions.

  • Create and maintain design systems, component libraries, and style guides.

  • Conduct user research and apply insights to improve digital experiences.

  • Translate business objectives into compelling visual solutions.

Design Systems & Component Management

  • Build scalable design systems used across multiple projects.

  • Create reusable Figma libraries to streamline developer handoffs.

  • Document design specifications, patterns, and interaction guidelines.

  • Ensure consistency and brand alignment across all digital touchpoints.

Collaboration & Project Delivery

  • Work closely with developers to ensure accurate implementation of design intent.

  • Participate in design reviews, client presentations, and feedback sessions.

  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.

  • Provide accurate time estimates and identify design challenges early in the process.

  • Maintain organised project documentation to enable smooth collaboration.

AI-Enhanced Design Workflow

  • Use AI tools to accelerate ideation and iteration.

  • Integrate emerging AI design tools into workflows and share best practices.


What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years of experience designing digital products, with a portfolio showcasing B2B web design projects.

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects).

  • Proven experience creating and managing design systems and component libraries.

  • Prior work with high-growth B2B companies or global brands.

  • Strong foundation in UX research, user flows, and information architecture.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, accessibility standards (WCAG), and developer collaboration.

  • Strong visual design skills, including typography, colour theory, and layout.

  • Ability to create engaging micro-interactions and motion-enhanced user experiences.


Why Join Klingit

At Klingit, we believe that creative excellence combined with smart workflows delivers real results. If you want to collaborate with an international team and see your work directly impact ambitious brands, this is the right environment for you.


Recruitment Process

Interested candidates should apply with both a CV and portfolio. The process includes:

  1. Initial screening call

  2. Two interviews (experience/cultural fit and technical skills)

  3. Short technical test

  4. Reference check


We move quickly, so please submit your application today.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The All-in-One Solution for Brand and Marketing Needs Unlike traditional agencies, we have built our offering as a plug-and-play solution for all brand and marketing needs. We promise fast turnarounds, transparent prices without surprises, and top-talent creatives that will boost your brand. Klingit acquired Norwegian startup Graphiq in july 2024 and all services are merged under the Klingit name.

Tworzymy wyjątkowe miejsce dla naszych Gości dzięki wspólnej pasji do nowoczesnego designu i wysokiej jakości obsługi.

Już ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast.

Czy posiadasz wyjątkową osobowość oraz doskonałe umiejętności z zakresu gościnności?

title: Data Platform Engineer m/w/d (Data Scientist)
description:
At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent)Portugal
Expires at: 2027-05-12
Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.

description:
Dansktalende Kundeservicerådgiver for Audi - Opstart den 1. oktober - Vi tilbyder firmabolig.

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger tekniske supportere til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som Kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for firmabolig i Braga

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

  • Attraktiv skattepolitik for udlændinge – For internationale medarbejdere findes der skattefordele, der kan gøre det økonomisk fordelagtigt at arbejde i Portugal.

  • Voksende erhvervsliv og økonomi – Portugal har en blomstrende erhvervssektor, hvor flere internationale virksomheder etablerer sig, hvilket skaber gode jobmuligheder og karriereveje.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

description:
Topógrafo - É o trabalhador que concebe, prepara, estuda, orienta e executa todos os trabalhos topográficos necessários à elaboração de planos, cartas, mapas, perfis longitudinais e transversais com apoio nas redes geodésicas existentes e ou nas redes de triangulação locais, por meio de figuras geométricas com compensação expedita (triangulação-quadriláteros) ou por interseção inversa (analítica ou gráfica), recorte ou por irradiação
direta ou inversa ou ainda por poligonação (fechada e compensada), como base de todos os demais trabalhos de levantamentos, quer clássicos quer fotogramétricos ou ainda hidrográficos, cadastrais ou de prospeção geológica. Determina rigorosamente a posição relativa de quaisquer pontos notáveis de determinada zona da  superfície terrestre, cujas coordenadas obtém por processos de triangulação, poligonação, trilateração ou outra.
Executa nivelamento de grande precisão. Implanta no terreno linhas gerais de apoio e todos os projetos de engenharia e arquitetura, bem como toda a piquetagem de pormenor. Fiscaliza, orienta e apoia a execução de obras públicas e de engenharia civil, na área da topografia aplicada, procedendo à verificação de implantações ou de montagem, com tolerâncias muito apertadas, a partir desta rede de apoio. Realiza todos os trabalhos
tendentes à avaliação de quantidades de obra efetuadas, a partir de elementos levantados por si ou a partir de desenhos de projeto e sempre também com base em elementos elaborados por si. Pode executar trabalhos cartográficos e de cadastro. Executa os trabalhos referidos e outros ligados às especialidades topográficas, com grande autonomia funcional.

description:

We are working with a leading Outsourcing/BPO consultancy to recruit Italian-speaking Content Moderators for an on-site TikTok project in Lisbon.

Empathetic, professional, and resilient under pressure
Team player with a proactive and adaptable attitude

The Offer
Full-time, on-site position in Lisbon
Flights to Lisbon covered
Option to live in one of Teleperformance’s fully equipped, shared apartments, located 20–60 minutes from the workplace
Guidance and support throughout the relocation process
Paid professional training and structured onboarding
Health insurance and meal allowances from day one
Career growth and development opportunities in an international, multicultural environment

title: Finance Head (f/m/d) - Discrete Projects Industrial Logistics (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
description:
We're seeking a Finance Head (f/m/d) for Industrial Logistics within Digital Industries Automation Discrete Projects (DI AUT DP). In this role, you'll lead global financial management for our Industrial Logistics (IL) project business across Europe and Americas – as part of the global Finance function under our new ONE Tech Company structure.
This is your chance to shape financial operations throughout the complete project lifecycle – from bid calculations to project closure – while ensuring IFRS 15 compliance, financial performance analysis, and effective risk management. You’ll drive profitable growth, sustainable margin improvement, stable cash generation, and financial resilience through disciplined risk control across multiple countries. You'll work in a transformation environment with a clear focus on business growth, where your financial expertise directly contributes to our goals of speed, scale, and efficiency.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.
You’ll make an impact by - Financial Leadership & Strategy: You lead global financial management and controlling for the Industrial Logistics project business, reporting to the Head of Finance of DI AUT DP. You drive growth and productivity initiatives to strengthen its competitive position. You govern the adoption of finance and controlling policies and guidelines based on the overall FIN strategy while ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations (external and internal).- Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Reporting: You coordinate budget planning and forecasting for the entire IL project business, ensuring IFRS-compliant accounting and timely preparation of financial closings as well as accurate books and records (monthly, quarterly, annual).- Performance Monitoring: You monitor and comment on financial performance (current development and outlook) incl. KPI analyses and performance reporting. You analyze, approve, review and forecast project revenues and costs, and ensure accurate profitability throughout the project lifecycle, as well as initiate early warnings to stakeholders when needed.- Project Finance & Risk Management: You identify and manage financial risks associated with the execution of projects, including currency, credit, and operational risks, ensuring proper risk assessment and provisioning in calculations and financial statements.- Operational Improvement & Innovation: You identify operational improvement potentials in controlling and financial processes, propose solutions and remedial measures, and drive productivity improvements through automation and innovation initiatives.- Collaboration & Transformation: You work with IL management, operational leadership, and central finance functions while supporting organizational transformation by challenging the current processes and collaborating across all stakeholder groups (e.g., FIN, P&O, EHS, GBS, SCM).- Team Leadership & Development: Finally, you manage and develop Finance and Controlling teams supporting the global IL project business. Traveling to its locations and project sites is necessary.

Your success is grounded in- Education: University degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field - Experience and Skills:- Minimum 8-10 years in Finance, Controlling, and FP&A, preferably in international project business- Minimum 5 years leadership experience leading finance teams across multiple locations and building collaborative relationships - Proven expertise in IFRS 15 revenue recognition for long-term project contracts and commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations. Familiarity with project business models in automotive or comparable industrial environments is a strong differentiator.- Demonstrated hands-on experience in commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations, covering pricing structures, risk allocation, liability caps, and penalty/malus clauses. Ability to engage with customer purchasing teams and to represent Finance as a value-creating business partner in complex commercial discussions.- Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and controlling- Deep understanding of risk management, internal controls, compliance and audit requirements- Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP preferred) and advanced MS Office skills- Experience with organizational transformation and implementation of new business operations is beneficial

- Ways of Working:- Strategic vision meets financial excellence – combining big-picture thinking with process optimization and attention to detail- Collaborative influencer who builds trust across cultures and translates complex financial insights into clear, actionable messages- Proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in evolving business environments - High integrity with commitment to Siemens Business Conduct Guidelines and compliance requirements
- Languages: Business proficiency in English; German language skills are a plus. Additional languages are highly welcome and beneficial for international collaboration.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us. We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

title: Italian-Speaking Technical Support Specialist (m,f) : Drone (Callcenteragent/in)
description:
Start: 03.08. or 01.09.26

We are partnering with a global technology company to recruit Italian-speaking Technical Support Specialists for a new project based in Italy.

In this role, you will provide professional technical assistance and customer support to users of cutting-edge camera drones. You will guide customers through troubleshooting, product usage, and problem resolution while ensuring an excellent overall experience. This is a great opportunity to work in a fast-paced, international environment with the latest technology.

Your Role
Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, and chat in Italian.
Troubleshoot and resolve product-related issues with camera drones.
Assist customers with setup, functionality, and maintenance guidance.
Educate users on features, firmware updates, and common usage issues.
Log and manage cases accurately in internal systems.
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to escalate complex technical problems.
Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction through timely and professional communication.

Your Qualifications
Native or fluent Italian (C1 level)
Basic knowledge of English for internal communication
Previous experience in technical support, IT, or electronics is preferred
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Excellent communication and customer service skills
Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced, international environment
Interest or experience in drones, consumer electronics, or related technology is a plus

The Offer
Full-time position with a structured onboarding and paid training
Hybrid working model (office + remote) depending on operational needs
Competitive compensation and benefits package
Career development opportunities within an international tech company
Work in a collaborative, international team and gain exposure to cutting-edge technology

title: Finance Head (f/m/d) - Discrete Projects Industrial Logistics (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
description:
We're seeking a Finance Head (f/m/d) for Industrial Logistics within Digital Industries Automation Discrete Projects (DI AUT DP). In this role, you'll lead global financial management for our Industrial Logistics (IL) project business across Europe and Americas – as part of the global Finance function under our new ONE Tech Company structure.
This is your chance to shape financial operations throughout the complete project lifecycle – from bid calculations to project closure – while ensuring IFRS 15 compliance, financial performance analysis, and effective risk management. You’ll drive profitable growth, sustainable margin improvement, stable cash generation, and financial resilience through disciplined risk control across multiple countries. You'll work in a transformation environment with a clear focus on business growth, where your financial expertise directly contributes to our goals of speed, scale, and efficiency.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.
You’ll make an impact by - Financial Leadership & Strategy: You lead global financial management and controlling for the Industrial Logistics project business, reporting to the Head of Finance of DI AUT DP. You drive growth and productivity initiatives to strengthen its competitive position. You govern the adoption of finance and controlling policies and guidelines based on the overall FIN strategy while ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations (external and internal).- Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Reporting: You coordinate budget planning and forecasting for the entire IL project business, ensuring IFRS-compliant accounting and timely preparation of financial closings as well as accurate books and records (monthly, quarterly, annual).- Performance Monitoring: You monitor and comment on financial performance (current development and outlook) incl. KPI analyses and performance reporting. You analyze, approve, review and forecast project revenues and costs, and ensure accurate profitability throughout the project lifecycle, as well as initiate early warnings to stakeholders when needed.- Project Finance & Risk Management: You identify and manage financial risks associated with the execution of projects, including currency, credit, and operational risks, ensuring proper risk assessment and provisioning in calculations and financial statements.- Operational Improvement & Innovation: You identify operational improvement potentials in controlling and financial processes, propose solutions and remedial measures, and drive productivity improvements through automation and innovation initiatives.- Collaboration & Transformation: You work with IL management, operational leadership, and central finance functions while supporting organizational transformation by challenging the current processes and collaborating across all stakeholder groups (e.g., FIN, P&O, EHS, GBS, SCM).- Team Leadership & Development: Finally, you manage and develop Finance and Controlling teams supporting the global IL project business. Traveling to its locations and project sites is necessary.

Your success is grounded in- Education: University degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field - Experience and Skills:- Minimum 8-10 years in Finance, Controlling, and FP&A, preferably in international project business- Minimum 5 years leadership experience leading finance teams across multiple locations and building collaborative relationships - Proven expertise in IFRS 15 revenue recognition for long-term project contracts and commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations. Familiarity with project business models in automotive or comparable industrial environments is a strong differentiator.- Demonstrated hands-on experience in commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations, covering pricing structures, risk allocation, liability caps, and penalty/malus clauses. Ability to engage with customer purchasing teams and to represent Finance as a value-creating business partner in complex commercial discussions.- Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and controlling- Deep understanding of risk management, internal controls, compliance and audit requirements- Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP preferred) and advanced MS Office skills- Experience with organizational transformation and implementation of new business operations is beneficial

- Ways of Working:- Strategic vision meets financial excellence – combining big-picture thinking with process optimization and attention to detail- Collaborative influencer who builds trust across cultures and translates complex financial insights into clear, actionable messages- Proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in evolving business environments - High integrity with commitment to Siemens Business Conduct Guidelines and compliance requirements
- Languages: Business proficiency in English; German language skills are a plus. Additional languages are highly welcome and beneficial for international collaboration.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us. As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.
About us.
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti predaja (okrem informačných a komunikačných technológií)
description:
Hľadáme ambiciózneho predajcu/predajkyňu, ktorý/á sa chce stať súčasťou nášho tímu. Ak Vás baví práca v automotive a komunikácia s ľuďmi, ste na správnom mieste. Vaše pracovné povinnosti budú: Aktívna komunikácia so zákazníkom smerujúca k uzatvoreniu obchodu. Zisťovanie potrieb zákazníkov, vykonávanie prezentácie nových automobilov. Vykonávanie administratívnych činností a vedenie obchodnej agendy spojenej s predajom automobilu. Vypracovanie cenových ponúk a návrhy riešenia potrieb podľa zákazníkov v oblasti financovania a poistenia nových vozidiel. Aktívna komunikácia a ponuka príslušenstva. Práca s informačným systémom. Zodpovednosť za splnenie plánu predaja automobilov. Starostlivosť o uskladnené nové vozidlá. Účasť na firemných eventoch a podujatiach.
Výhody:Mesačná mzda: 1300 € - 3000 €. Mzda sa skladá zo základnej zložky 1300 € z produktovej zložky, ktorú si ovplyvňuje predajca sám na základe dosiahnutých výsledkov z predaja. Z každého predaja predajca získava obratovú províziu, množstevný bonus, kvalitatívny bonus a kvartálny bonus závislý od objemu predaja. - možnosť osobného rastu - zamestnanecké ceny na produkty a služby - odborné certifikované produktové školenia - firemné akcie, teambuilding aktivity - individuálne ohodnotenie na základe dosiahnutých výsledkov

title: Všeobecní administratívni pracovníci
description:
Hlavnou náplňou práce je agenda nadriadeného, organizácia stretnutí, vybavovanie služobných ciest, administratívna podpora – email manažment, telefonáty, bežná dokumentácia. Podpora predaja vozidiel v showroome. Plní okrem vyššie uvedenej agendy aj náročnejšie a častokrát aj vybrané odborné činnosti a úlohy v rámci vedenia firmy, ako HR, PR a marketing, finančný reporting, plánovanie. Pracovná doba typická pre pozíciu Asistent/ka na predajni nových vozidiel je 8 hodín denne, v pracovných dňoch od pondelka do piatku a v sobotu do 13:00 hod ( s možnosťou dohody ).
Výhody:- Možnosť kariérneho a platového rastu, kde Tvoje úsilie a výsledky budú ocenené. - Získanie služobného vozidla na základe odvedených výkonov, ktoré Ti umožní flexibilné cestovanie a rýchle presuny po meste. - Firemný notebook a telefón, ktoré Ti uľahčia komunikáciu a prácu na diaľku. - Príjemná pracovná atmosféra, kde sa budeš cítiť ako súčasť tímu a budeš mať podporu od skúsených kolegov. - Možnosť získať zaujímavé skúsenosti a pracovať s modernými vozidlami, ktoré Ti umožnia byť v kontakte s najnovšími trendy v automobilovom priemysle.

Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, opportunity tracking, and sales-pipeline management.

A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

title: Správcovia objektov

Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.

Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE
