title: Senior Group Accountant
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

As a Senior Group Accountant, you will strengthen a group accounting team with a clear focus on accurate, timely, and high-quality consolidated reporting. You will work in an international environment with listed-company reporting requirements, close collaboration across subsidiaries, and a strong link between accounting, analysis, and external reporting. This is a hands-on role where you will contribute to closings, consolidation, reporting quality, and continuous improvement across processes and systems. It is a great opportunity if you enjoy combining detail-oriented finance work with broader influence on how group reporting is developed.

Job Description

    You will support monthly, quarterly, and annual group closing processes, including preparation and validation of consolidation entries.
    You will collaborate with subsidiaries and internal stakeholders to secure timely and accurate financial submissions.
    You will perform financial analysis and prepare supporting documentation for internal and external reporting.
    You will contribute to external IFRS financial reporting, including notes and disclosures for quarterly and annual filings.
    You will maintain data in the consolidation system and help ensure consistency and accuracy across group entities.
    You will support the development and documentation of group accounting policies, processes, and controls.
    You will take part in projects related to reporting improvements and system enhancements.
    You will coordinate with auditors and support the audit process with evidence and explanations.
    You will identify opportunities to improve group accounting procedures and ways of working.

Requirements

    You have 5–7 years of experience in finance, preferably within a global corporate accounting function or from an audit firm, of which 2-3 years of specific Group accounting experience with Financial reporting.
    You have experience with compliance and reporting for listed companies.
    You have a university degree in Business Administration, with a major in finance or accounting, or equivalent.
    You have a solid understanding of IFRS accounting standards and familiarity with group consolidation principles.
    You have experience preparing financial reports and working with month-end and year-end closing processes.
    You are proficient in Excel for financial analysis and reporting tasks.
    You have experience working with consolidation systems.
    You are fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
    You work in a self-motivated, proactive, and solution-oriented way, and you communicate effectively with multiple stakeholders.

Nice to have

    Experience with SOX compliance and reporting requirements for U.S.-listed companies.
    Experience with AARO.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Erfaren Inredningsarkitekt sökes till AFRY Architects Stockholm
description:
Företagsbeskrivning

AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, arkitektur och design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle.  

Jobbeskrivning

Vill du vara med och skapa miljöer där människor trivs, utvecklas, möts och inspireras?

På AFRY Architects söker vi nu en erfaren och engagerad inredningsarkitekt som vill bli en del av vårt team i Stockholm. Hos oss får du arbeta med varierande projekt, stort eget ansvar och kollegor som delar din passion för arkitektur, design och hållbar utveckling.

Om rollen

Du blir en viktig del av vårt inredningsteam och arbetar genom hela processen, från tidiga idéer och koncept till projektering, upphandling och genomförande.

Arbetsplatsprojekt utgör idag en stor del av vår verksamhet, men vår projektportfölj är bred och omfattar allt från attraktiva arbetsplatser och kontorsmiljöer till hotell, restauranger, bostäder och offentliga miljöer.

Du kommer att arbeta i nära samarbete med kunder, arkitekter, inredningsarkitekter, ljusdesigners och övriga specialister, både i Sverige och i internationella projekt.

Vi söker dig som drivs av att förstå människors behov och omsätta dem i genomtänkta, hållbara och inspirerande miljöer. Du är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och trivs i nära samarbete med både kunder och kollegor från olika discipliner. Du har ett starkt intresse för gestaltning och design och drivs av att skapa miljöer med hög kvalitet, tydlig identitet och långsiktigt värde.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har:

    

Examen som inredningsarkitekt eller motsvarande relevant utbildning.

    

Minst fem års arbetslivserfarenhet som inredningsarkitekt.

    

Dokumenterad erfarenhet av kontorsprojekt och arbetsplatsutveckling.

    

Goda kunskaper i CAD-program, exempelvis AutoCAD och Revit.

    

Erfarenhet av projektering och framtagande av förfrågningsunderlag.

    

God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.

    

Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och samtidigt vara en lagspelare.

Meriterande

    

Erfarenhet av förändringsledning, arbetsplatsstrategi eller verksamhetsutveckling.

    

Mycket goda kunskaper i Revit.

    

Erfarenhet av visualisering i t.ex. Adobe Creative Suite eller Enscape.

    

Vana att leda kunddialoger och workshops.

Ytterligare information

Vi erbjuder

Hos AFRY Architects blir du en del av ett engagerat team med drygt 60 arkitekter, inredningsarkitekter och ljusdesigners i centrala Stockholm. Vi arbetar i en kreativ, prestigelös och utvecklande miljö där idéer uppmuntras och samarbete står i centrum.  

Du får möjlighet att arbeta med varierande projekt, fortsätta utvecklas i din profession och vara med och skapa miljöer som gör verklig skillnad för människor och verksamheter.

Hos AFRY Architects kombinerar vi det mindre teamets närhet och kreativitet med styrkan i en internationell organisation. Det ger dig möjlighet att arbeta med både lokala och globala projekt tillsammans med några av branschens främsta specialister.

Vi tror att god arkitektur och väl gestaltad inredning bidrar till bättre verksamheter, starkare upplevelser och ett mer hållbart samhälle. Om du delar den övertygelsen vill vi gärna höra från dig.

Ansökan

Skicka in CV, portfolio och personligt brev. Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande och ser fram emot att lära känna dig.

Placeringsort: Stockholm
Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning

Välkommen med din ansökan till AFRY Architects!

Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-10-18. Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

För samtliga rekryteringar på AFRY genomförs som grund alltid en ID-kontroll, referenstagning samt verifiering av utbildning.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan. Vi ber dig att inkludera både CV och portfolio (arbetsprover) som en del av din ansökan. Har du några frågor om tjänsten eller om hur det är att jobba hos oss är du varmt välkommen att höra av dig.

Kontaktperson för frågor:

Jon Söberg Grape, rekryterande chef

jon.soberg@afry.com

eller

Jan Mattsson, rekryterande chef

jan.mattsson@afry.com

Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande  team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen

title: Servicetekniker / Installationstekniker – Sollentuna
description:
Om tjänsten


Vi på Cleverex Bemanning söker nu en tekniker med installationsfokus till ett stabilt och långsiktigt bolag i Sollentuna. Företaget befinner sig i ett generationsskifte och söker nu personer som vill växa in i en teknisk roll med stort ansvar och goda utvecklingsmöjligheter. Tjänsten passar dig som har en bra teknisk grund, trivs med praktiskt arbete och vill arbeta mer med installation och uppbyggnad än traditionell service.

I rollen arbetar du främst med installation, montering och driftsättning av tekniska lösningar ute hos kund. Arbetet sker ofta i projektform och innebär att du är med från start till färdig installation. Du planerar delar av ditt arbete själv och samarbetar nära med kollegor och projektledning. Resor förekommer i tjänsten, både inom Sverige och internationellt, vilket ger variation i vardagen och möjlighet att arbeta i olika miljöer och projekt.

Uppdraget är ett bemanningsuppdrag på 6 månader, där du initialt blir anställd av Cleverex Bemanning och uthyrd till vår kund. Ambitionen är att anställningen övergår till en tillsvidareanställning hos kund efter uppdragets slut, förutsatt att alla parter är nöjda.


Du erbjuds


•    En praktisk och varierad roll med tydligt installationsfokus
•    God introduktion och intern upplärning
•    Möjlighet att utvecklas tekniskt och ta mer ansvar över tid
•    Arbete i projekt där du får följa installationen från start till mål
•    En vardag som kombinerar teknik, problemlösning och resor
•    Samarbete med erfarna och engagerade kollegor



Arbetsuppgifter


Som installationstekniker arbetar du med uppbyggnad och driftsättning av tekniska lösningar. Rollen är praktisk och passar dig som trivs med att arbeta hands-on, ta ansvar och lösa tekniska utmaningar i vardagen.

Dina arbetsuppgifter innefattar bland annat:
•    Installation och montering av teknisk utrustning
•    Driftsättning och funktionskontroller
•    Mekaniskt och tekniskt arbete
•    Felsökning i samband med installation
•    Samarbete med kollegor och projektledning
•    Dokumentation av genomfört arbete



Din profil


Vi söker dig som har rätt inställning och teknisk grund, snarare än en specifik bakgrund. Du är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och gillar att arbeta praktiskt. Du trivs i en roll där du får arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra.

Vi tror att du:
•    Har teknisk bakgrund, exempelvis inom mekanik, fordon, industri eller installation
•    Har god teknisk förståelse och ett praktiskt handlag
•    Är noggrann, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad
•    Trivs med varierande arbetsmiljöer och resor
•    Är serviceinriktad och har lätt för samarbete
•    Har B-körkort



Övrigt


•    Placering: Sollentuna
•    Omfattning: Heltid, dagtid

Tjänsten är ett konsultuppdrag via Cleverex Bemanning, där du initialt är anställd av Cleverex. För rätt person finns mycket goda möjligheter till övergång till kund efter cirka 6 månader, förutsatt att alla parter är nöjda med samarbetet.



Om oss


På Cleverex Bemanning är vi specialiserade på att rekrytera och placera rätt medarbetare hos rätt kunder. Vårt främsta fokus är på våra kunder, konsulter och kandidater, med målet att säkerställa att du som kandidat känner att du har landat på rätt plats!

title: Laseroperatör till kund i Älmhult
description:
TopWork är ett auktoriserat företag som arbetar med bemanning och rekrytering. Våra kunder finns inom branscher som industri, lager, logistik, bygg och administration. Vi är din trygga, professionella partner oavsett om du söker nya medarbetare eller nya utmaningar. TopWork - vi hittar rätt medarbetare till rätt arbetsgivare och arbetsplats.

title: Automationsingenjör till Assemblin i Nyköping
description:
Assemblin El är ett av Sveriges ledande elinstallationsföretag. Assemblin El erbjuder heltäckande och hållbara lösningar för allt inom el – projektering, installation och service. Bolaget erbjuder även spetskompetens inom fastighets- och industriautomation, säkerhet, kraft samt data och telekom. Vi finns nu på närmare 80 orter i Sverige.

Vill du arbeta med automation hela vägen från programmering och konstruktion till driftsättning av färdig anläggning? Assemblin söker dig som vill ta ett stort tekniskt ansvar i projekten och arbeta nära både kund och teknik. Här får du en bred roll där du får möjlighet att påverka automationslösningarna från start och utvecklas vidare inom området.

Information om tjänsten

Professionals Nord söker i samarbete med Assemblin en Automationsingenjör till verksamheten i Nyköping. Här blir du en del av ett team som utvecklar och levererar automationslösningar till Assemblins kunder.

Som Automationsingenjör arbetar du med PLC och styrsystem genom projektens olika faser. Rollen kombinerar tekniskt arbete med praktisk problemlösning och nära samarbete med kunder, projektledare och andra tekniska kompetenser. Du får möjlighet att ta ett stort eget ansvar och vara med och påverka de tekniska lösningarna utifrån projektets och kundens behov.

För dig som vill fortsätta utvecklas inom automation finns goda möjligheter att fördjupa din kompetens inom specifika system och teknikområden samt på sikt ta ett större ansvar i projekten.

Tjänsten är en direktrekrytering, vilket innebär att rekryteringsprocessen sker genom Professionals Nord och att du anställs direkt hos Assemblin. Önskemål är att alla frågor kring tjänsten går till marija.biletic@pn.se (mailto:marija.biletic@pn.se)

Du erbjuds

    En bred automationsroll med programmering, konstruktion, felsökning och driftsättning
    Möjlighet att följa projekt från teknisk lösning till färdig och driftsatt anläggning
    Nära samarbete med kunder, projektledare och andra tekniska kompetenser
    Interna och externa utbildningar utifrån din utveckling och dina intresseområden
    Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter inom Assemblin

Arbetsuppgifter

    Programmering av PLC, styrsystem och andra automationslösningar
    Konstruktion och framtagande av tekniska lösningar
    Driftsättning och funktionstest av automationsanläggningar
    Felsökning, optimering och teknisk support
    Arbete med HMI, SCADA och kommunikation mellan olika system
    Tekniska genomgångar och dialog med kunder och beställare
    Samarbete med projektledare, leverantörer och kollegor genom projektens olika faser
    Planering av den egna tekniska insatsen utifrån projektets tidplan och mål

Vi söker dig som

Har minst två års erfarenhet inom automation och känner dig bekväm med att självständigt arbeta med programmering, felsökning och driftsättning av automationssystem. Du kan exempelvis ha arbetat som automationsingenjör, PLC-programmerare, styr- och regleringenjör eller i en liknande teknisk roll. Vi ser gärna att du har:

    Relevant utbildning inom automation, el, styr- och reglerteknik eller motsvarande erfarenhet från arbetslivet
    Erfarenhet av PLC-programmering och styrsystem
    Erfarenhet av felsökning och driftsättning
    Erfarenhet av något etablerat automationssystem, exempelvis Siemens, Schneider, ABB, Mitsubishi eller Saia
    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska
    B-körkort

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av SCADA, HMI, RTU, kommunikationsprotokoll, elkonstruktion eller maskinsäkerhet.

Vi tror framför allt att du är en tekniskt nyfiken och lösningsorienterad person som tycker om att förstå hur saker fungerar och hitta lösningar när de inte gör det. Du trivs med att ta ansvar för ditt eget arbete men uppskattar samtidigt att lösa tekniska utmaningar tillsammans med kollegor och kunder.

START: Enligt överenskommelse

OMFATTNING: Heltid

URVAL: Sker löpande

title: Servicemedarbetare
description:
Arbetsbeskrivning

Gillar du ett fysiskt och rörligt jobb där ingen dag är den andra lik? Har du B-körkort och en blick för praktiska lösningar? Kassoe Housing växer och söker nu en självständig problemlösare till sitt team i Gävle. Start omgående!

Om Kassoe Housing

Kassoe Housing erbjuder fullt möblerade och servade lägenheter i Gävle – ett viktigt ekonomiskt och logistiskt nav i mellersta Sverige. Beläget längs Östersjökusten, med goda tåg- och vägförbindelser till Stockholm och norra Sverige, är Gävle hem för stora aktörer inom energi, skogsbruk, tillverkningsindustri och offentlig förvaltning.

Oavsett om du leder ett projekt inom hamnlogistik, arbetar som konsult för en myndighet eller stödjer verksamheter inom industriell teknik, erbjuder våra lägenheter ett bekvämare och mer kostnadseffektivt alternativ till hotell. Varje bostad har ett fullt utrustat kök, snabbt Wi-Fi och en dedikerad arbetsplats – perfekt för både kortare och längre affärsresor i Gävle.

Som servicepersonal blir du en nyckelperson i att se till att våra bostäder är i perfekt skick inför in- och utflytt. Du utgår från vårt lager på Kryddstigen i Gävle och dagarna varierar stort. Ena dagen är det lugnare, för att nästa dag innebära ett mycket högt tempo. Det kräver att du är flexibel och gillar när det händer grejer!

Vi letar efter dig som är en riktig problemlösare. Du hugger i där det behövs och du tar eget ansvar för att lösa saker som dyker upp längs vägen. Du är extremt självständig i ditt arbete men fungerar också bra ihop med kollegor när ni åker ut tillsammans.

I den här rekryteringen samarbetar Kassoe Housing med Randstad. Om du har frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Amanda Lindström på amanda.lindstrom@randstad.se.

Skicka in din ansökan via länken så snart som möjligt, dock senast den 9 oktober 2026. Vi utvärderar ansökningarna löpande så tveka inte att höra av dig med din ansökan. Ladda upp ditt personliga brev och ditt CV som ett dokument.

title: Serviceteamare i Västerort - Hemfrid
description:
We are looking for new home cleaners to join our Service Team in the area Västerort. Are you our next star? 🌟

We love making our customers’ everyday lives easier – and so should you. We are looking for someone who lives and breathes customer service. You should:

    

Have previous experience from a service profession.

    

Have worked as a home cleaner, housekeeper, or equivalent.

    

Speak and understand basic Swedish or English.

    

Be able to work flexible hours, Monday – Friday, between 8 – 17.  

We offer

Our goal is clear – we want to be the best employer in the industry. We believe our employees are the heart of the company, and we are dedicated to providing good working conditions.  

Among others, we offer:

    

A permanent position of a 85% employment rate.  

    

Collective agreement and favorable terms of employment.

    

Liability insurance, health insurance, and pension insurance.

    

Wellness allowance.

    

Training in home cleaning, with a focus on your development.

    

Great career opportunities and growth within Hemfrid.

    

Free mobile subscription.  

    

One of Sweden’s greatest teams of colleagues from all over the world. 🙌

About the role

As a home cleaner in the service team, you are responsible for cleaning our customers’ homes with the highest quality. Your main tasks will include covering for absent colleagues, performing deep cleans (which make up a large part of the role), and managing keys.

You will often work alongside your colleagues and be responsible for ensuring the quality of these assignments. In addition, as part of the service team, you are expected to lead and coordinate the work during deep cleaning assignments.

To thrive in this role, you should enjoy working at a fast pace and be adaptable to different situations.

About us

Hemfrid is Sweden's leading provider of home services. We help our customers with cleaning, laundry, ironing, moving, gardening, and more. By working as a team and providing easy access to first-class home services, we unlock people's quality of life.  

Our process

After completing the application, you will be contacted by the HR department regarding the recruitment process for your application.

As part of our recruitment process, we always do a background check. You need to have a Swedish personal number or a coordination number to be eligible for this position.  

Are you ready to unlock people's quality of life? Great! So are we. We look forward to your application.

Welcome to Hemfrid



Vi letar efter nya hemstädare till vårt serviceteam i området Västerort. Är du vår nästa stjärna? 🌟

Din profil

Vi älskar att göra våra kunders vardag enklare – det borde du också göra. Vi söker efter någon som brinner för kundservice. Du är punktlig och ansvarstagande, med ett öga för detaljer och en positiv inställning. Självklart är du en lagspelare som tycker om att arbeta nära dina kollegor.

Du bör:

    

Ha tidigare erfarenhet från ett serviceyrke.

    

Ha arbetat som hemstädare, hushållerska eller motsvarande.

    

Tala och förstå grundläggande svenska eller engelska.

    

Kunna arbeta flexibla timmar, måndag – fredag, mellan 8 – 17.

Vi erbjuder

Vårt mål är tydligt – vi vill vara branschens bästa arbetsgivare. Vi tror att våra anställda är företagets hjärta, och vi är dedikerade till att erbjuda bra arbetsförhållanden.

Bland annat erbjuder vi:

    

En tillsvidareanställning på 85% sysselsättningsgrad.

    

Kollektivavtal och bra anställningsvillkor

    

Ansvarsförsäkring, sjukförsäkring och pensionsförsäkring.

    

Friskvårdsbidrag.

    

Utbildning inom hemstädning, med fokus på din utveckling.

    

Goda möjligheter att utvecklas och växa inom Hemfrid.

    

Gratis mobilabonnemang.

    

Ett av Sveriges härligaste team med kollegor från hela världen. 🙌

Om rollen

Som hemstädare i serviceteamet ansvarar du för att städa våra kunders hem med högsta kvalitet. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kommer vara att täcka upp vid frånvaro, utföra storstädningar (vilket är en stor del av uppdraget), samt hjälpa att hantera nycklar.

Du kommer ofta att arbeta tillsammans med dina kollegor och ha ansvar för kvalitetssäkring av uppdragen. Inom serviceteamet förväntas du även kunna leda och fördela arbetet vid storstädningar.

För att trivas i den här rollen bör du gilla att arbeta i ett högt tempo och vara flexibel samt anpassningsbar.

Om oss

Hemfrid är Sveriges ledande aktör för tjänster i hemmet. Vi hjälper våra kunder med städning, tvätt, strykning, flytt, trädgårdsarbete och mycket mer. Genom att arbeta som ett team och ge våra kunder enkel tillgång till våra toppklassiga tjänster förbättrar vi deras livskvalitet.

Vår process

Efter genomförd ansökan kommer du att bli kontaktad av HR- avdelningen angående rekryteringsprocessen för din ansökan.

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi bakgrundskontroller. För att vara kvalificerad för den här tjänsten behöver du ha ett svenskt personnummer eller ett samordningsnummer.

Är du redo att förbättra människors livskvalitet? Bra! Det är vi också. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.

Välkommen till Hemfrid!

title: Senior .NET Developer
description:
What will you do?

As a Senior .NET Developer who not only loves solving complex problems but is passionate about code quality, and building scalable and testable solutions.

You’ll be adequately self going, contribute to technical discussions, and aspire to deliver clean, robust code. You have a sharp eye for simplicity amidst complexity and pride yourself on thorough, thoughtful development, including writing tests for critical components. Whether working closely within your team or leading a project area independently, you’re confident, collaborative, and proactive.

Areas of ownership:

    

Take part the design, development, and deployment of complex, high-throughput backend services and APIs, ensuring best-in-class performance and maintainability.

    

Establish and articulate a clear, ambitious long-term vision and technical roadmap for the evolution of the BE systems.

    

This includes planning for future growth, anticipating technological shifts, and driving the adoption of new technologies and patterns to maintain a competitive edge.

    

Proactively identify and resolve technical debt before they impact the business.

    

Mentor engineers, elevating the technical expertise and quality of engineering output across the organization.

    

Influence engineering standards and best practices for testing, performance tuning, and security across different development teams.

Requirements

    

Exceptional and proven proficiency in the .NET area, including extensive experience with C#, .NET Core/5+, and related frameworks (e.g., ASP. NET Core, Entity Framework Core).

    

Demonstrable architecting skills with a strong background in designing and implementing large-scale, distributed systems (e.g., microservices, event-driven architectures, serverless).

    

Expert knowledge of design patterns, domain-driven design (DDD), and SOLID principles.

    

Extensive experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and related services (e.g., managed databases, message queues, containerization).

    

Deep understanding of various database technologies (SQL and NoSQL) and data modeling best practices for scalable applications.

    

System-Level Thinking: Ability to decompose complex problems into manageable components and evaluate trade-offs between different technical solutions (e.g., speed vs. stability, buy vs. build).

    

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, driving consensus on critical architectural decisions.

Why Rebtel?

Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. As we enter our next phase, we’re building an organisation designed for speed, ownership, and real impact, where every role contributes directly to shaping what comes next.

This is a place with global ambition and a strong foundation, where ideas move quickly and decisions matter. You won’t get lost in layers of process or slow-moving structures. Instead, you’ll find the space to take ownership, collaborate across teams, and make meaningful contributions from day one. Based in Stockholm, we bring together a diverse, international team united by a shared purpose: to simplify the way people connect worldwide.

At Rebtel, you are the most important asset and we strive to provide a comprehensive package of benefits and perks that enhance your well-being and work experience. Here are some of the things you can expect from us:

    

Pension Plan

    

Health Checkups, Influenza shots and Private Medical Insurance

    

Dental Insurance

    

Occupational insurance

    

Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)

    

Discount on gym memberships

    

Bonus program

    

Extra parental pay

    

30 days annual vacation

    

Monday breakfasts

    

Relocation Support, if you're joining us from afar, we'll assist you in making a smooth transition.

We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Cashier - Part-time -Malmö
description:
Ria Money Transfer is a business arm of Euronet Worldwide, Inc. (NASDAQ: EEFT) and a leading financial services player. We offer fast, secure and affordable global money transfers to millions of customers worldwide. In addition to this, we also provide currency exchange services. With over 600,000 agents in almost 200 countries, our goal is to create opportunities for a better everyday life.

We believe in a world where everyone is empowered to shape the life they dream of, regardless of their background or location.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Ria Financial Services is looking for a driven and service-oriented employee for the role of Sales Cashier/Store Employee. We are a global leader in money transfers and currency exchange with an extensive network of our own offices and branches.

This is a part-time position located in Stockholm, starting around mid-December. As a Sales Cashier/Store Employee, you will be a central part of our team and the face of our business. You are responsible for providing an outstanding customer experience while contributing to achieving our sales goals.

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

    Carry out transactions for money transfers and currency exchange with high precision and efficiency.
    Actively engage customers to understand their needs and offer appropriate financial services.
    Provide personalized and professional service by answering questions and providing clear guidance.
    Manage cash flow carefully and ensure accurate accounting according to company guidelines.
    Help achieve and exceed sales goals by building trust and customer loyalty.
    Be flexible with working hours and be able to work evenings, weekends and holidays when needed.



We are looking for you who

    Has experience in sales and customer service (meritorious).
    Fluent in Swedish and English – additional language skills are a plus (e.g. Russian, Ukrainian, Thai or Arabic, Farsi, Dari).
    Is self-motivated, goal-oriented and thrives in a dynamic work environment.
    Have a strong customer focus and the ability to create a positive experience for our customers.
    Has experience in cashier work and handling of cash (meritorious).
    Is flexible and can adapt to different tasks and shifts. Weekend work occurs.
    Have basic computer skills (Word, Excel).



PERKS & BENEFITS

    An exciting and dynamic work environment in an international company.
    Opportunity to develop in sales and financial services.
    An inclusive and multicultural team where we value diversity.

We look forward to hearing from you and welcoming you to our team at Ria Financial Services!

Please note that for security reasons, we request an extract from the criminal record before employment can be carried out.

Ria Money Transfer is an employer that promotes equal opportunities. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all employees.

Read more about us here: www.riamoneytransfer.com

title: IT Support to Paradox Interactive!

Paradox Interactive is one of the premier game developers and publishers of strategy and management games on PC and consoles! In this position, you'll play a crucial role in providing day-to-day technical support to your colleagues in the organization. You together with a team of 10 will provide seamless support to 800 colleagues in multiple global offices.

Responsible for day-to-day technical support, your role includes troubleshooting hardware and software issues both on-site and remotely. You play a vital role in the smooth onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring the seamless integration of hardware, software, and other services.     A great role to deepen your knowledge within tech
    A dedicated consultant manager from Academic Work who will support and coach you in your future career

    Configure and troubleshoot software for seamless operations both on site and remote  
    Install and set up new computers, addressing hardware issues  
    Provide remote support to offices globally, contributing to a smooth tech environment  
    Collaborate with the support team on projects for infrastructure scaling and updates  
    Ensure the functionality of conference rooms and office IT equipment

We are looking for

    Work experience in IT support/IT related customer service
    Has an interest in hardware and technology
    Good knowledge of English in both speech and writing as it is used in daily work

● Worked in onsite experience in IT support previously

    Service-minded
    Curious nature

title: Lead Project Leader - Operational Stability & Resilience Transformation
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description:
Job ID: 6457

Core Technology Change & Delivery is seeking an experienced Lead Project Leader to support the execution of Nordea’s operational stability and resilience transformation. Functionally reporting to the appointed Programme Manager, you will lead selected projects and initiatives within the programme while also providing structured programme management support.

You will work across technology and business domains to turn programme priorities into executable plans, coordinate delivery activities and dependencies, and ensure transparent reporting of progress, risks, issues and outcomes.

The role combines hands-on project leadership with programme coordination and governance support, contributing to initiatives focused on preventing service disruptions, detecting incidents earlier, restoring services faster and addressing the structural causes of recurring incidents.

About our team

Core Technology Change & Delivery is responsible for project and programme management, execution and governance of technology change initiatives. We work across business and technology teams to ensure that strategic commitments are delivered predictably, transparently and in line with the Core Technology Operating Model and Nordea Delivery Guide.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Lead selected operational stability and resilience projects and initiatives from planning through execution and implementation, in alignment with priorities set by the Programme Manager.
    Support the Programme Manager in maintaining a consolidated view of programme initiatives, including objectives, ownership, milestones, funding, risks, dependencies and expected outcomes.
    Translate programme objectives and priorities into clear project plans, milestones, deliverables and measurable success criteria.
    Coordinate delivery of assigned initiatives focused on incident prevention, monitoring and observability, problem management, service recovery, automation and application resilience.
    Drive alignment and execution across the technology, service management and business teams involved in assigned initiatives.
    Support programme governance by preparing decision materials, coordinating reporting cycles and meetings, and following up actions, decisions and escalations.
    Produce clear, outcome-based project and programme reporting that provides transparency on progress, risks, dependencies, decisions and expected benefits.
    Identify cross-initiative dependencies, gaps and overlaps, and support the Programme Manager in driving prioritisation and resolution across organisational boundaries.
    Manage assigned project scope, plans, milestones, budgets, resources, risks, issues and dependencies.
    Maintain programme management artefacts such as integrated plans, RAID and decision logs, action tracking and delivery dashboards.
    Ensure that root-cause analysis and incident trends are translated into actionable remediation initiatives and measurable stability improvements.
    Ensure delivery complies with enterprise architecture, security, regulatory, resilience and operational requirements.
    Proactively identify delivery obstacles, manage escalations and enable timely decisions, working closely with the Programme Manager.
    Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, accountability and continuous improvement.

Who you are

This is the right role for you if: you are a delivery-oriented leader who can combine hands-on project execution with disciplined programme management support. You create structure and momentum in a complex environment, work effectively under the direction of an appointed Programme Manager, and take ownership of initiatives from planning through implementation. You communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, coordinate across organisational boundaries and turn programme priorities into practical delivery outcomes.

Your background and skills include:

    Proven track record of leading complex technology projects and strategic initiatives in large organisations.
    Experience supporting multi-workstream programmes through integrated planning, governance coordination, reporting, RAID management, action tracking and decision support.
    Strong experience in operational stability, service reliability, operational resilience or enterprise technology transformation.
    Experience coordinating delivery across technology, service management and business domains.
    Strong understanding of incident, problem and change management, monitoring and observability, service recovery and root-cause remediation.
    Ability to translate programme priorities and operational trends into executable project plans and measurable outcomes.
    Experience preparing high-quality materials for governance forums, steering committees and senior stakeholders.
    Experience managing complex dependencies, risks, issues, delivery commitments, budgets and resources.
    Strong ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across organisational units and technology domains.
    Experience defining and tracking outcome-based metrics, benefits and performance indicators.
    Understanding of technology resilience, application reliability, operational readiness, security and regulatory requirements.
    Proven ability to proactively identify delivery risks, resolve impediments and drive successful outcomes in complex environments.
    Very good financial and resource management skills.
    Very good analytical skills and attention to detail.
    Advanced presentation skills, especially PowerPoint and Excel.
    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
    Excellent English skills, both spoken and written.
    Can-do attitude.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 28/09/2026.

For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

title: Group Accountant needed!
description:
Are you a detail-oriented and analytical finance professional looking to develop your experience within group accounting? We are now looking for a Group Accountant to join an exciting company in the automotive industry. In this role, you will be part of the Group Accounting team and contribute to high-quality financial reporting, closing processes and continuous improvements across the Group.

About the position

We at Perido are now looking for a Group Accountant for our client, an exciting and forward-thinking company in the automotive industry. The company is based in Gothenburg where this position is located. As part of the Group Accounting team, you will support monthly, quarterly, and annual closings, and contribute to the delivery of high-quality financial data to internal and external stakeholders. You will ensure consistent application of accounting principles across the Group and assist with financial analysis, adjustments, and reporting processes.

Your daily tasks

The consultant will support the Group Accounting team with the following responsibilities:

    Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual group closing processes, including preparation and validation of consolidation entries
    Collaborate with subsidiaries and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate financial submissions
    Perform financial analysis and prepare supporting documentation for internal and external reporting
    Assist in the preparation of external IFRS financial reports, including notes and disclosures for quarterly and annual filings
    Maintain consolidation system data and ensure consistency and accuracy across group entities
    Contribute to the development and documentation of group accounting policies and processes
    Participate in projects related to group accounting, reporting improvements, and system enhancements
    Coordinate with auditors and assist in delivering required audit evidence and explanation.
    Proactively identify and suggest improvements to group accounting procedures and controls

Your characteristics

We are looking for a structured, analytical and thorough person with a strong attention to detail and an ability to see the bigger picture. You are self-motivated and driven, take ownership of your work and proactively look for solutions when challenges arise. You have excellent communication skills and feel comfortable collaborating with and communicating with multiple stakeholders across the organization. As the role involves working in a fast-paced environment, you are solution-oriented, adaptable and able to manage several tasks while maintaining a high level of accuracy. You are also curious and proactive in identifying opportunities to improve processes, procedures and controls, while working effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!

Qualifications:

    5–7 years of experience in finance, preferably within a global corporate accounting function or from an audit firm of which 2-3 years of specific Group accounting experience with Financial reporting

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description:
About agentmama

We build AI agents that audit and optimize e-commerce advertising. Our platform syncs live data from Google Ads, Meta, Merchant Center, and Google Analytics, runs it through a rule engine, LLM-powered audit agents, and our own prediction models, and turns the findings into concrete actions marketers can apply with one click.

We're a small team shipping fast on a modern, strictly-typed stack. You'd be one of a handful of engineers reporting directly to the CTO, which means real ownership: features you design end-to-end, from the Prisma schema to the React component, ship to customers within days.

What you'll do

    

Design and build features across our TypeScript monorepo — tRPC procedures and NestJS services on the backend, React on the frontend.

    

Extend our integration workers that sync campaign, product, and analytics data from the Google and Meta APIs via Cloud Pub/Sub pipelines.

    

Work on the AI audit agent: prompt design, rule evaluation, and the plumbing that turns LLM output into reliable, deduplicated actions — across multiple model providers, not just one.

    

Help productionize our in-house prediction models: wiring their output into the rule engine and keeping training data and evaluation pipelines healthy.

    

Evolve the data model in PostgreSQL/Prisma and keep migrations, multi-tenancy, and role-based access clean as the product grows.

    

Own quality: write Jest tests alongside your code, review PRs, and help keep our CI/CD pipeline to Cloud Run fast and boring.

Our stackBackend

TypeScript · Node.js NestJS + Fastify tRPC · Zod Prisma · PostgreSQL

Frontend

React · Vite End-to-end types via tRPC

Infrastructure

Google Cloud Run · Pub/Sub Docker · GitHub Actions pnpm workspaces · Turborepo

AI & integrations

Multiple LLM providers In-house prediction models Google Ads · Meta Merchant Center · GA4

What we're looking for

    

5+ years building production web applications, with strong TypeScript on both server and client.

    

Solid relational database instincts — schema design, migrations, and query performance in PostgreSQL (Prisma experience is a plus).

    

Experience with event-driven or queue-based architectures (Pub/Sub, SQS, Kafka, or similar) and the failure modes that come with them.

    

A habit of testing: you write tests because they let you move faster, not because someone told you to.

    

Pragmatic product sense — you ask why before how, and you'd rather ship a focused feature than a perfect abstraction.

Nice to have

    

Hands-on work with LLM APIs in production — prompting, evals, structured output, cost control, and switching between providers.

    

Applied ML experience: training, evaluating, or serving prediction models alongside product code.

    

Familiarity with the Google Ads, Meta, or Merchant Center APIs, or ad-tech / e-commerce domain experience.

    

NestJS, tRPC, or GCP (Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Workload Identity) in a previous role.

How we work

Small team, short feedback loops, no ceremony for ceremony's sake. Strict TypeScript, code review on everything, CI that deploys to Cloud Run on merge. We optimize for shipping value to customers weekly and keeping the codebase a place people enjoy working in.

Our team collaborates across all Volvo Group organizations and brands in Sweden, impacting over 26,000 employees. In this role, you will report directly to the Head of Total Reward Sweden.

     What You Will Do  





As a Total Reward Expert you will collaborate closely with our compensation and benefits team and other functions within People & Culture Sweden. Your responsibilities will include:








    Developing reward and recognition models, policies, tools, and guidelines.
    Managing and reviewing benefits and salary structures.
    Leading projects related to employee value propositions, salary reviews, pensions, and international mobility.
    Staying ahead of research and trends to ensure our total reward strategies align with business needs.
    Coaching and advising People & Culture Partners on total reward matters.







Key Responsibilities








    Drive and oversee various total reward projects to enhance awareness and improve processes.
    Initiate and support annual activities such as salary reviews and equal pay analyses.
    Collaborate with your colleagues to lead compensation and benefits negotiations at the national level.
    Provide expert advice on compliance and interpretation of national laws and collective agreements.
    Translate business needs into impactful total reward initiatives.

    Profile description:

What We’re Looking For











A Master’s degree in Human Resources or a related field.



Proven senior experience in People & Culture and/or Compensation & Benefits.



Training or experience in leadership, communication, and project management is valuable.



A results-oriented mindset with a strong focus on business and customer needs.



Professional understanding of country laws, regulations, and collective agreements.



Excellent communication skills and the confidence to challenge the status quo.



Proficiency in Excel and/or PowerBI is a plus.



Previous experience in production or industry is advantageous.







The position is based in Gothenburg.











Language Skills: Fluency in both Swedish and English is essential.







Why Join Us?











At Volvo Group, you will be part of a forward-thinking organization that values innovation and collaboration. If you are ready to make a significant impact and grow your career in a supportive environment, we want to hear from you!







For more information, please contact:



Emma Jensen, Head of Total Reward Sweden, phone +46 765 533873



Martin Svensson, Total Reward SME Sweden +46 739 025305



Cecilia Celestian, People & Culture Partner, phone: +46 739 023615















Last application date is October 4th but please send your application as soon as possible as we will review applications continuously.















As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.







We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.















Who we are and what we believe in











Our focus on Inclusion, Diversity, and Equity allows each of us the opportunity to bring our full authentic self to work and thrive by providing a safe and supportive environment, free of harassment and discrimination. We are committed to removing the barriers to entry, which is why we ask that even if you feel you may not meet every qualification on the job description, please apply and let us decide.

title: VAT Specialist, Financial Control & Accounting, Volvo Group
description:
Company description:

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.





Job description:



Financial Control & Accounting (FCA) is a part of Group Finance with the responsibility to secure that financial performance is correctly reflected for Business Areas, Truck Divisions, Group Functions and legal entities. FCA also provides local tax administration and compliance as well as global shared services through delivery centers in Accounting Services with quality focused and process efficient service deliveries. We are approximately 1.400 employees with a global footprint in 50+ countries closely integrated with local business operations.

Are you looking to grow your career in tax and take your next professional step in a global environment? You could be our next VAT Specialist, joining our team in Gothenburg.

   What you will do in your new role  





As a VAT Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring accurate and compliant VAT reporting for Swedish Volvo legal entities. Your main responsibilities will include preparing VAT returns and reports, supporting foreign VAT registrations, and handling excise duties. You will work closely with colleagues across the organization, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing.







In this role, you will ensure that all VAT reporting meets Swedish regulations, Swedish GAAP, and internal AB Volvo guidelines and quality standards. You will also actively contribute to the ongoing improvement and digitalization of our VAT compliance processes, helping to drive efficiency and innovation within the department.







If you are passionate about tax compliance, eager to work in a dynamic team, and ready to make a real impact, we look forward to your application!







Your future team



You will be joining the FCA Group & Sweden team of VAT Specialists reporting to the Manager of Tax and VAT Specialists. You will have a broad network of colleagues within FCA and the Volvo Group. You will have a fantastic opportunity to broaden your skills and competencies together with a team of highly skilled and dedicated colleagues. The VAT team is responsible for overall high quality and compliant VAT accounting and reporting. As of today, our team consists of six VAT specialists.

    Profile description:   Who are you?  





To thrive in this role, you bring a professional mindset and a genuine passion for VAT and accounting. You are a person of integrity who can work independently, yet you value collaboration and enjoy being part of a dedicated team. Your strong communication and interpersonal skills enable you to build effective relationships and drive positive change.







You are highly organized and approach challenges with a problem-solving attitude. With your analytical skills, you actively seek opportunities to improve processes and embrace digital solutions, leveraging tax technologies such as Alteryx and Power BI. Your commitment to excellence and team spirit makes you a valuable contributor to our ongoing success.



Qualifications required for the position








    A university degree in Business Administration or a related field.
    At least 3 years of professional experience in accounting, or relevant experience from the Swedish Tax Authorities.
    Strong grasp of financial processes and systems.
    Excellent command of both written and spoken Swedish and English.
    Proficient in Microsoft Office 365 applications.
    Experience with SAP Master Finance is beneficial, but not mandatory.
    Experience or knowledge of excise duties is an asset, though not required.

      We offer:

What’s in it for you?











You will join a team of highly skilled and professional colleagues with the opportunity to build an extensive network within Volvo Group with the possibility to learn, develop and grow. Being part of the Volvo Group will also give you multiple career opportunities. You will become a part of a company culture based on our values Customer Success, Trust, Passion, Change and Performance.















Every day, Volvo Group products and services ensure that people have food on the table, children arrive safely at school and roads and buildings can be constructed. Looking ahead, we are committed to driving the transition to sustainable and safe transport, mobility and infrastructure solutions toward a net-zero society.







Ready for the next move?











This position is based in Gothenburg, Sweden and requires occasional travel.











Last application date is 2026-10-04 but please send your application as soon as possible as we will review applications continuously.











For further information or questions, please contact:



Anna Brorsson, Manager of Tax & VAT Specialists, anna.brorsson@volvo.com



Christina Hagberg, People and Culture Partner, christina.hagberg@volvo.com















We look forward to your application!















As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.

title: Hepatologist
description:
At Sahlgrenska University Hospital, we work together to provide the highest quality of care with the patient at the center. Our great commitment and continuous learning make us one of the country's leading university hospitals. We provide everything from county healthcare to national highly specialized care. We focus on the future of healthcare through exciting research. We care about digital skills and everyone's contribution to the digital development. Our work is about using our collected knowledge and experiences together with you – to create value for our patients.

We are transforming healthcare with the ambition of becoming Europe’s leading university hospital by 2032. In partnership with our patients, we work to ensure quality, accessibility, patient safety, research, education, and innovation within an integrated healthcare system across the Västra Götaland Region in Sweden.

Sahlgrenska University Hospital is one of Northern Europe's largest hospitals with over 17,000 colleagues who have different experience and backgrounds.

About us

The Department of Gastroenterology and Hepatology at Sahlgrenska University Hospital (SU) is one of the largest in the Nordic region. We provide emergency and scheduled outpatient care, and have close collaboration with other departments including upper and lower GI surgery, and transplantation surgery.

The department is organized into teams focusing on hepatologic outpatient care, gastroenterologic outpatient care, endoscopy, intestinal failure unit, and an inpatient ward. The department is actively involved in ongoing research across several fields and has a strong emphasis on education, continuing professional development, and the ongoing advancement of clinical services.

What can we offer?

As a Specialist Physician/Senior Consultant at the Department of Gastroenterology and Hepatolgy at Sahlgrenska university Hospital, you will have excellent opportunities for professional development and research. You will work within our subspecialty teams alongside ambitious and friendly colleagues, with close collaboration with the transplantation unit.

The department has a high patient volume, providing extensive opportunities for both clinical practice and research.

Our goal is to provide the highest possible standard of care for our patients. We place great importance on supporting each individual's professional development according to their interests, strengths, and career goals, while also enabling them to influence their working environment.

About the Role

You will work with the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of patients requiring specialized care in hepatology in both emergency and elective settings. Your duties will include working in the outpatient clinic, inpatient ward, and at the liver transplant unit, as well as participation during office hours and on-call duties.

Teaching and supervising less experienced colleagues, medical students, and healthcare professionals is an integral part of the role. You will also be expected to take an active part in the department’s quality improvement, development, and change initiatives, as well as in research activities.

About You

We are looking for a board-certified senior consultant in Gastroenterology and Hepatology with a high level of expertise in hepatology. You should be interested in both your own professional development and contributing to the advancement of care at one of the largest university hospitals in the Nordic region. You work well within a team and have a strong interest in liver disease.

We value strong communication and collaboration skills. You are able to apply newly acquired knowledge in your clinical practice, make sound clinical judgments, and thrive in a fast-paced work environment. We are seeking a motivated and independent individual with the ability and interest to take overall responsibility and place the patient's needs at the center of care.

Ongoing research activities and/or a doctoral degree (PhD) are considered meritorious.

Great emphasis will be placed on personal suitability.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis throughout the recruitment period.

We warmly welcome your application!

Together for the patient - Sahlgrenska Universitetssjukhuset

In the event of recruiting a physician or nurse with a foreign medical license and/or specialist certification, the appointment will be preceded by the necessary process to fulfill the requirements for Swedish licensure and/or specialist recognition.

About Region Västra Götaland

Region Västra Götaland is there for the people of Västra Götaland. We ensure good quality healthcare for everyone. We work towards a sustainable development and growth, a clean environment, an improved public health, a rich cultural life and good communications throughout Västra Götaland.

Region Västra Götaland is actively working to digitize more ways of working. To be part of the digital transformation, you need to have basic skills and be able to use digital tools and services. You know how to search for information, how to communicate and interact digitally, you are also risk-aware and motivated to be part of the development to learn new things.

If you want to know more about Region Västra Götaland, you can visit our introduction to new employees at www.vgregion.se/introduction.  You can also read more in the presentation on Salary, remuneration and benefits – what you will receive as an employee in VGR.

All permanent employees of Region Västra Götaland are assigned wartime postings.

Application

Region Västra Götaland would like you to register your application through the recruitment system. If you have any questions about the advertised job, or if you are unable to register your information in a public system for any reason, please contact the person who advertised the job.

For employment agencies, intermediaries, recruitment agencies and salespeople:

We kindly refrain from direct contact with employment agencies, intermediaries, recruitment agencies and other external actors and sellers of additional job advertisements. Region Västra Götaland has tendered contracts.

title: Logistics Manager to Beyond Gravity Linköping
description:
🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​



About Beyond Gravity



Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2024, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 359 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com



Your crew

Beyond Gravity is in a strong growth and transformation phase. At our Linköping site, one of Beyond Gravity's key manufacturing operations, we are moving from a project-oriented way of working to a scalable and volume-oriented delivery model, with high demands for precision, pace and quality.



The Supply Chain function consists of logistics, planning and procurement, where the logistics function is currently in a development and transformation phase with a need for clearer structure, processes and control.



In this role, you report to the Senior Manager Supply Chain and have personnel responsibility for approximately 18 employees working across warehouse and logistics operations.

Your mission



The role as Logistics Manager in Linköping is a central and critical position within the Supply Chain function. Here you will have the opportunity to lead and develop the logistics function in an environment characterized by high technical complexity, an international environment and a clear focus on transformation. The assignment involves creating structure, stability and long-term sustainable ways of working in an environment where the pace is high and where logistics is crucial to production.



You will combine strategic development work with close operational leadership. The role initially requires you to be hands-on in the development of improved processes, efficient material flows and high delivery reliability. The role as Logistics Manager is therefore a key role in succeeding with the work to improve logistics flows. This challenge is suitable for you who thrive in transformation environments and are motivated by building, improving and developing operations together with your team.



Responsibilities:

    Lead and develop the logistics and warehouse team in the daily operation
    Develop and implement logistics strategy, processes and guidelines
    Act as process owner for all logistics processes and related documentation
    Responsible for the daily management of logistics personnel and ensuring an organizationally efficient structure adapted to the needs of the business
    Responsible for a correctly managed warehouse and its processes, including audit-safe inventory, as well as warehouse analyses
    Lead the team within the cost center budget, including necessary asset and investment planning
    Develop and establish key performance indicators to measure and manage all logistics processes
    Drive continuous process optimization within the area of responsibility

Your story



We are looking for you who are a confident, experienced and present leader with the ability to create structure and stability in a complex operation. You thrive in environments where change is a natural part of everyday work and have a solution-oriented approach with the ability to combine operational action with long-term improvement work.



You are a person who is motivated by developing both people and processes and who creates engagement through clarity, collaboration and a coaching leadership style. The role requires a high level of presence in the operation, good prioritization skills and a good ability to handle a high pace.



Must-haves:

    Post-secondary education in logistics or a similar field – or equivalent experience
    Solid background and understanding of logistics within manufacturing industry, as well as experience of cross-functional collaboration between logistics, production, planning and procurement
    Solid formal management experience with experience in developing teams
    Experience in driving and developing transformation and improvement work within logistics
    Experience of warehouse responsibility and material management
    Experience in creating structure, processes and ways of working in operations with a high pace and change
    Fluent knowledge of Swedish and English, spoken and written
    Good system knowledge, preferably SAP, as well as good experience working in a data-driven and process-oriented manner



Why Beyond Gravity



    To work in a growing high technology company with career opportunities within the site or internationally.
    You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!
    We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with!



🌌Are you ready for lift-off?​



Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.​



For questions regarding the position, please contact: ​Joakim Käll | joakim.kaell@beyondgravity.com

​

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact: ​Breno Silva | breno.silva@beyondgravity.com

​

Beyond Gravity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected categories.​

​

Applications by e-mail cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruitment agencies for this position.

title: Legal Counsel to company in Southern Sweden
description:
About the Company

You will be proivided with more information regarding the company during the recruitment process.

Asta Agency is partnering with the company in this recruitment process. The recruitment is managed by Asta Agency, and you will be employed by Asta Agency – with the possibility of being directly recruited by the company over time.

About the role

As Legal Counsel, you will be the legal anchor for the entire Group, the person who holds the threads together across commercial, corporate, capital-markets and regulatory matters. Reporting directly to the Group CEO, this is a broad and genuinely independent role with real autonomy to shape the legal function from the ground up. You will engage and coordinate a network of external advisers, including patent portfolio agents, legal counsel and the company's certified adviser, acting as the internal hub through which all external legal relationships are channelled and directed. Day to day, you will draft, review and negotiate commercial contracts, oversee capital-markets compliance and disclosure obligations, and support the ongoing corporate transformation alongside the CEO, Managing Directors and the board. With operations spanning two countries and a listed environment with both equity and debt instruments in play, the legal agenda is varied, consequential and genuinely yours to own.

Key responsibilities include:

    

Supporting the board with meeting preparation and acting as keeper of minutes.

    

Managing corporate governance and company-law matters across the Group.

    

Overseeing capital-markets compliance, insider logs, press releases and Nasdaq regulatory requirements.

    

Managing IP matters including applications, renewals and licensing agreements across jurisdictions.

    

Supporting management on GMP compliance, manufacturing authorisations and engagement with regulatory authorities such as the Swedish Medical Products Agency and EMA.

    

Drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements, research agreements, clinical trial agreements and NDAs.

    

Building and maintaining a contract management framework, including a standard template library and contract register.

    

Ensuring Group-wide compliance with data protection legislation.

Qualifications and personal attributes

You are a commercially minded, structured and self-driven lawyer who thrives in an environment where no days look the same, and where your judgement and initiative genuinely matter. You are comfortable managing complexity across multiple disciplines, and you bring both the legal rigour and the interpersonal confidence to serve as the go-to person for all things legal across a listed group. You communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, know when to escalate and when to act, and take real ownership of your agenda.

In addition, you have:

    

A law degree and qualification as an attorney or equivalent.

    

5–8 years of post-qualification experience, ideally from a combination of private practice and in-house.

    

Solid experience across commercial contracts, corporate governance and capital-markets or listed-company compliance.

    

Experience coordinating or managing external legal advisers.

    

Fluency in English and Swedish; Danish is a strong advantage.

Meritorious experience:

    

Background in the pharmaceutical, life sciences or regulated manufacturing sector.

    

Familiarity with Nasdaq First North rules and disclosure obligations.

    

Experience with IP management and licensing.

    

Knowledge of GMP regulatory frameworks or pharmaceutical regulatory compliance.

Additional information

    

Start: As soon as possible - according to agreement.

    

Location: Malmö, with occasional travel to Denmark.

    

Scope: Full-time.

    

Salary: By agreement.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and will continuously provide updates throughout the recruitment process.

If you have any questions regarding Asta Agency’s recruitment process, please do not hesitate to contact us at ellen@astaagency.se.

About Asta Agency

Asta Agency is a recruitment and staffing company helping businesses across Sweden find the right professionals, with a primary focus on Stockholm, Gothenburg, and Malmö.

We recruit and provide consultants within sales, marketing, HR, customer service, finance, administration, IT, and tech – both specialists and generalists. With a strong focus on quality, long-term partnerships, and smart solutions, we support both companies and candidates in taking the next step.

Learn more about how we work with recruitment, staffing, and temp-to-perm solutions at astaagency.se.

title: Lead Planner to Megaprojekt i Luleå (Northern Sweden)
description:
About NCC Green Industry Transformation

Sweden is facing a historic industrial transformation. Heavy industry is transitioning towards a fossil-free future, creating significant value in terms of economic growth, technological innovation, and environmental sustainability. As a key contributor to the development of society in northern Sweden, where some of the most important industrial investments are taking place, we are now looking for the right person to take on the important role of Lead Planner in one of our complex projects.

The Role of Lead Planner

As a Lead Planner, you will be at the centre of the project's planning activities. You will support the project and site management teams in developing clear and realistic construction schedules that ensure strong progress, high quality, and efficient use of resources.

You will be responsible for coordinating project schedules, monitoring deviations, and driving the planning process in close collaboration with production, procurement, project management, and other specialist functions.

This is a role where you will have a genuine opportunity to influence both project outcomes and the future development of our planning practices.

You will report to the Head of Planning and be part of the Project Planning team.

Key Responsibilities

    Lead and structure the project's planning process.
    Develop, maintain, and update project schedules and construction plans in accordance with the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).
    Coordinate planning activities across contracts, construction operations, procurement, and deliveries.
    Report project status and communicate schedule progress to stakeholders.
    Identify deviations and ensure schedules are updated to reflect changes.
    Document delays and disruptions, and support the project with analysis and forecasting.
    Contribute to cost monitoring and resource planning.
    Provide recommendations for improvement and participate in the development of working methods, tools, and systems support.

Your Profile

We are looking for someone with experience in leading and driving planning activities in complex environments, preferably within large-scale construction and/or infrastructure projects. You understand how project scheduling impacts project finances, resource planning, procurement, design, and construction activities.

You possess strong analytical skills and are able to translate detailed information into well-founded decisions that support the organization's overall objectives. At the same time, you have the ability to maintain a holistic perspective, identify interdependencies, and anticipate the consequences of different courses of action.

You are an effective communicator who can engage others in the planning process, foster alignment across different functions, and convey complex information in a clear and pedagogical manner.

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

    Experience working with project planning and scheduling tools such as Primavera P6 or ASTA Powerproject.
    A higher education qualification in a technical discipline and at least five years of experience in project planning.
    Proven experience managing large and complex projects. Experience within the construction industry and construction delivery is considered advantageous.
    Strong communication skills and the ability to engage effectively with both internal and external stakeholders, which is essential for successful collaboration and project delivery.
    Experience using planning and scheduling tools, combined with a solid understanding of construction and production workflows.
    Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Swedish and English.

Location

This position is based in Luleå. Candidates residing elsewhere are also welcome to apply, provided they can be present in Luleå for at least 50-70% of their working time, which is considered essential for success in the role.

The remaining time can preferably be spent at a location where NCC has offices and/or where there are good travel connections to Luleå, such as Stockholm, Uppsala, Piteå, Boden, Skellefteå, and other suitable locations.

In line with NCC's safety culture and recruitment process, a background check will be conducted.

What NCC Offers

NCC strives to be an attractive employer where employees enjoy their work, develop professionally, and maintain a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer a comprehensive range of employee benefits and internal training and development opportunities.

All NCC employees are covered by collective bargaining agreements, providing a strong foundation of employment security and clear terms and conditions. We also offer insurance coverage, reduced working hours, a wellness allowance, and a lunch benefit. Additional offers and discounts are available through our employee benefits portal, Benify.

Recruitment Specialist

wuendy.cardenas@ncc.se
