title: Quality Manager for a Mega Project in Luleå, Northern Sweden
description:
Do you want to play a key role in ensuring structure, quality, and efficient ways of working in a complex construction project? If so, this could be the opportunity for you!

NCC Green Industry Transformation – SSAB Project, Luleå

We are facing a historic transformation. Heavy industry is undergoing significant change and paving the way for a fossil-free future that creates substantial value in terms of economic growth, technological development, and environmental sustainability.

As an important part of the societal and industrial development taking place in northern Sweden—where some of the most significant investments are currently underway—we are now looking for the right person to take on the important role of Quality Manager in one of our complex projects.

About the Role – Quality Manager

As our Quality Manager, you will be a key member of the project team and serve as the daily point of contact for all quality-related matters. You will work closely with the production organization and ensure that our management system is used effectively to create value and improve project performance.

You will play a central role in translating quality requirements into practical actions, supporting colleagues, and creating an understanding of how quality management contributes to project success.

Key Responsibilities

    Serve as the project's Quality Manager and the primary point of contact for all quality-related matters.
    Support and guide project teams and stakeholders in applying NCC's management system, quality processes, and governing documents.
    Ensure effective collaboration between internal teams, clients, subcontractors, and external stakeholders.
    Coach colleagues in stakeholder management, project requirements, and quality-related best practices.
    Promote a culture of quality and continuous improvement throughout the project.
    Develop, maintain, and implement quality documentation, procedures, and supporting materials.
    Prepare and execute internal and external quality audits, including follow-up actions and reporting.
    Maintain and develop the project's quality management system in line with NCC policies, standards, and objectives.
    Ensure compliance with the business management system and drive awareness across the organization.
    Communicate quality requirements, standards, procedures, and lessons learned throughout the project.
    Deliver quality-related training and knowledge sharing to project teams and stakeholders.
    Prepare and manage quality reporting to meet project and business requirements.

Your Profile as a Quality Manager

We are looking for someone with a strong background in both construction and quality management:

    Minimum 8–10 years of experience in the construction industry, including several years in a leadership role such as Quality Manager, Project Manager, Construction Manager, or a similar position.
    Proven experience in quality management within construction projects, including the implementation and monitoring of quality management systems.
    In-depth knowledge of the entire construction process, including design, construction, commissioning, and handover.
    Extensive experience conducting and managing internal and external quality audits.
    Experience working in accordance with standards such as ISO 9001 or equivalent quality management frameworks.
    Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain and train others on complex topics.
    Experience working in large-scale projects or organizations is considered a strong advantage.

Personal Attributes

    Business-oriented with a solution-focused mindset.
    Strong communicator and educator, capable of translating requirements into practical actions.
    Structured, persistent, and highly execution-oriented.
    Confident leader with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of an organization.
    Relationship-builder with excellent collaboration and interpersonal skills.

You communicate clearly and effectively with both internal and external stakeholders, which is essential for successful collaboration and, ultimately, a successful project.

You have professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Swedish language skills are considered an advantage but are not required, and we welcome applications from candidates who are not fluent in Swedish.

To become part of our team, we expect you to embrace our values and understand the importance of working with inclusion and diversity within the organization.

Location

On-site presence in the city of Luleå (North of Sweden) is set to at least 50% of working hours—and at certain periods, the role will require close to full-time presence on site in Luleå. This is a prerequisite for succeeding in the role. However, it is possible to take on this exciting opportunity even if you are based elsewhere in Sweden, provided you have good travel options to Luleå (ex. Boden, Piteå, Skellefteå, Stockholm, Uppsala, etc.). NCC will arrange travel and accommodation within Sweden.

For this position, background checks are conducted in accordance with NCC’s security culture.

Swedish Work Permit

Candidates must have the legal right to work in Sweden. The role requires regular on-site presence in Sweden and limited relocation support is available.

The Role of Lead Planner

As a Lead Planner, you will be at the centre of the project's planning activities. You will support the project and site management teams in developing clear and realistic construction schedules that ensure strong progress, high quality, and efficient use of resources.

You will be responsible for coordinating project schedules, monitoring deviations, and driving the planning process in close collaboration with production, procurement, project management, and other specialist functions.

This is a role where you will have a genuine opportunity to influence both project outcomes and the future development of our planning practices.

You will report to the Head of Planning and be part of the Project Planning team.

Key Responsibilities

    Lead and structure the project's planning process.
    Develop, maintain, and update project schedules and construction plans in accordance with the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).
    Coordinate planning activities across contracts, construction operations, procurement, and deliveries.
    Report project status and communicate schedule progress to stakeholders.
    Identify deviations and ensure schedules are updated to reflect changes.
    Document delays and disruptions, and support the project with analysis and forecasting.
    Contribute to cost monitoring and resource planning.
    Provide recommendations for improvement and participate in the development of working methods, tools, and systems support.

Your Profile

We are looking for someone with experience in leading and driving planning activities in complex environments, preferably within large-scale construction and/or infrastructure projects. You understand how project scheduling impacts project finances, resource planning, procurement, design, and construction activities.

You possess strong analytical skills and are able to translate detailed information into well-founded decisions that support the organization's overall objectives. At the same time, you have the ability to maintain a holistic perspective, identify interdependencies, and anticipate the consequences of different courses of action.

You are an effective communicator who can engage others in the planning process, foster alignment across different functions, and convey complex information in a clear and pedagogical manner.

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

    Experience working with project planning and scheduling tools such as Primavera P6 or ASTA Powerproject.
    A higher education qualification in a technical discipline and at least five years of experience in project planning.
    Proven experience managing large and complex projects. Experience within the construction industry and construction delivery is considered advantageous.

    Experience using planning and scheduling tools, combined with a solid understanding of construction and production workflows.

Location

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:

In this role, you will analyze and normalize complex software data into structured application information, including manufacturers, license types, product families, and other key metadata. Analyze and normalize complex software data into accurate application information

    

Review data and maintain high standards for quality and consistency

    

Research and resolve complex software and data-related cases

    

Support customer cases and provide clear technical guidance

    

Support onboarding and mentor other analysts through knowledge sharing and feedback

    

Contribute to projects that improve workflows, documentation, and data quality

    

Identify opportunities to improve internal tools and ways of working

    

Collaborate with Product and other teams on improvements and development initiatives

Strong experience in data analysis, data normalization, or a similar analytical role

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

    

Structured and detail-oriented, with a strong focus on quality

title: Senior Associate - Manager | Strategy&
description:
By joining Strategy&, you will become part of a global team of practical strategists, committed to helping our Clients seize key opportunities by working alongside them to solve their toughest problems. A career at Strategy& will provide you with the opportunity to work with some of the world’s largest and most complex companies to understand their unique business issues and opportunities in an ever-changing environment. We work on strategically important and intellectually challenging projects with C-suite Clients. More specifically, we work with leading corporations and Private Equity firms on strategic topics, focused on our core platforms Capabilities-Driven Strategy, Fit for Growth and Deals Strategy. Example assignments with corporate Clients include strategic review, growth strategy, market expansion, profit/margin improvement, and operating model design. For Private Equity firms, we support with commercial due diligence, market study and PortCo value creation strategy and business plan.

What we offer

Strategy& supports your career growth by encouraging continuous learning and by providing a framework for you to acquire new skills at the right time. At Strategy&, we offer mentoring, tailored training programs, and a variety of fun and challenging learning opportunities. You will work on the most strategic topics across a wide range of different industries and have the ability to influence your staffing to align with your passion and interests. You will be surrounded with people who will not only challenge you intellectually, but also inspire and guide you, drive your ambition, and care about your personal and professional development. Our offering includes, but is not limited to the following:

    Pure play strategy consulting work within a wide range of industries
    Part of a top-tier strategy consultancy, both locally and globally
    Access to the resources and capabilities of the global PwC network
    Ability to influence Strategy&’s exciting growth journey
    Humble, friendly and open team atmosphere

    Generous employee benefits including parental leave policies

Responsibilities

We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent and are currently seeking experienced professionals of varying seniority to join our team and become part of our local growth journey.

Senior Associate – 2-5 years of relevant work experience

Senior Associates work with Clients through all stages of consulting projects by identifying major challenges, generating improvement hypotheses, structuring and performing analyses, drawing insights and identifying pragmatic solutions, and making strategic recommendations.

Senior Associates are often end-to-end responsible for a work stream within the project working as a valued and trusted contributor in both internal and Client settings. You will get the opportunity to manage Client team members and/or a team of junior consultants and you will work across a variety of industries and functional areas in a dynamic international setting.

Manager – 5 - 8 years of relevant work experience

Managers directly manage teams as engagement leaders, demonstrating strong project and people management skills. Managers are responsible for driving overall project progress, solving complex Client and business issues, and handling stakeholder communication both internally and externally. They hone their Client management skills as the day-to-day relationship owner, and have the opportunity to coach junior consultants on projects, learning to lead high performing teams

Preferred skills across Senior Associate and Manager candidates

    Strong business acumen and ability to quickly grasp complex problems in a diverse range of industries
    Advanced analytical capabilities with both quantitative and qualitative problem-solving skills
    Exceptional leadership qualities in managing teams, driving change, and collaboratively achieving ambitious goals
    High professional integrity and good relationship builder
    Highly motivated, with a strong personal drive and ambition
    Excellent communication and presentation skills
    Entrepreneurial spirit and a keen interest in contributing to a growing team
    Outstanding academic record from a top-tier academic institution

Application instructions

To apply, please submit a complete application with:

    Cover letter
    Academic grade transcripts

The interview process usually consists of multiple stages and various types of interviews, where you get to meet multiple members of the Strategy& Stockholm team.

We invite candidates to interviews continuously, and we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Junior R&D ingenjör
description:
Integration Diagnostics and its core products, Penguin RFA and Osseo100 measures dental implant stability to enable clinicians to decide when to load an implant. The technique has been developed in close cooperation with clinicians and experts in the field of dental implantology.

Resonance Frequency Analysis (RFA) and the measurement unit Implant Stability Quotient (ISQ) were introduced into the dental implant industry in 2001 and are now established methods of measuring implant stability and osseointegration.

In 2015, in response to the dental community’s need for an accessible ISQ measuring system, Integration Diagnostics Sweden AB (IDSAB) was founded. Sales have developed rapidly with clients today in + 70 countries globally.

In 2018, Integration Diagnostics became part of the Japanese company Nakanishi Inc. Nakanishi Inc., is a world-leading company of professional dental instruments with the world’s top-share brand “NSK”. All its products are developed and manufactured in Japan and distributed to 135 countries around the globe. The NSK Group has 14 subsidiaries worldwide and has established a strong global sales network.

We are currently looking for a,

Junior R&D Engineer – Medtech

As a Junior R&D Engineer, you will be part of a small and agile R&D team, working closely with the R&D Director, who is also the founder of the company. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience across the entire product lifecycle, from concept development and testing to technical documentation and production support.

You will play an active role in maintaining and improving existing products while supporting the development of future innovations within IDSAB's medical device portfolio.

Key responsibilities:

    Contribute to the maintenance, optimization, and continuous improvement of commercially available products.
    Support the development and refinement of R&D methodologies, development processes, verification activities, and testing procedures in collaboration with the R&D team.
    Manage existing technical documentation and prepare new technical documentation when required.
    Work cross-functionally with colleagues in R&D, Quality Assurance, Production, and Product Management.



In this position, your daily work has a wide scope and is conducted in a dynamic, innovative international working environment.



Qualifications

•     Master of Science in Engineering (M.Sc.) or Bachelor of Science in Engineering (B.Sc.) in Electronics, Engineering Physics, Medical Engineering, or a related field.

•     Good knowledge about medical device development

•     Fluent in Swedish and English



Preferred Experience

The following experience is considered an advantage:

    Hands-on experience from experimental work, laboratory environments, or workshop activities.
    Practical experience gained through master's thesis projects, personal side projects, student competitions, or involvement in student organizations focused on engineering, electronics, robotics, or product development.
    Experience in prototyping, CAD, testing, troubleshooting, or building technical systems.
    Previous experience within the medical device industry is highly valued.



To succeed in this role, you are a user- and patient centric person with a strong drive to provide innovative products. You have a broad technical interest, and you can navigate in both hardware and software development.



You will be part of an exciting and challenging journey shaping the company’s future and taking the business to new heights. In this role you will have a great opportunity to make an impact and improve the products and solutions we supply to the market, and you will have a big variation in activities.



Application

To apply, please send your CV to career@idsab.com



By submitting your application, you also consent to us storing your personal data, including CV & cover letter. You can revoke the consent whenever you want.

title: LOGISTIKANSVARIG - LÖVSTJÄRNAN FABRIKS AB
description:
Lövstjärnan Fabriks AB (LöFAB) is a Swedish defence manufacturing company established to support Nordic and NATO security-of-supply requirements through manufacturing, co-production, and lifecycle sustainment through partnerships and sub-contracts with global OEMs. LöFAB provides an EU-based industrial solution that enables compliant production, long-term support, and scalable capacity within Europe.

Trivs du i en bred roll där du kombinerar intern och extern logistik, riskhantering och verksamhetsutveckling samtidigt som du får stort eget ansvar?

Vill du vara med och skapa effektiva, robusta och framtidssäkra materialflöden som bidrar till företagets fortsatta utveckling? Då kan detta vara rätt möjlighet för dig.

Lövstjärnan Fabriks AB är ett företag i stark utveckling där kvalitet, innovation och långsiktigt tänkande är viktiga delar av verksamheten. För att möta framtidens krav och fortsätta vår tillväxt söker vi nu en Logistikansvarig som vill ta en nyckelroll i att utveckla, säkra och effektivisera våra logistik- och materialflöden.

Om rollen

Som Logistikansvarig har du det övergripande ansvaret för att säkerställa stabila, effektiva och motståndskraftiga material- och produktionsflöden genom hela värdekedjan. Rollen omfattar lagerstyrning/optimering, produktionslogistik och transportoptimering med målet att säkerställa hög leveransprecision, stabil produktion och god kostnadskontroll.

Du arbetar nära inköp, produktion, kvalitet, transportpartners, kunder och leverantörer för att säkerställa att rätt material finns på rätt plats vid rätt tidpunkt. En viktig del av uppdraget är också att identifiera risker och utveckla beredskapsplaner för att minimera störningar i försörjningskedjan. Du driver arbetet med alternativa transportlösningar, lagerstrategier och andra initiativ som stärker verksamhetens robusthet och leveransförmåga.

I rollen ansvarar du även för kapacitetsanalyser, prognoser, uppföljning av nyckeltal samt utveckling av logistikprocesser i företagets affärssystem och planeringsverktyg. Du blir en nyckelperson i arbetet med att kontinuerligt förbättra, utveckla och framtidssäkra företagets logistikfunktion.

Efter hand som funktionen utvecklas kommer rollen att innefatta även personalansvar.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som har eftergymnasial utbildning inom logistik, industriell ekonomi, supply chain management eller motsvarande. Du har erfarenhet från tillverkande industri och har arbetat med transportlogistik, lagerstyrning, materialplanering eller produktionsplanering. Erfarenhet av Monitor ERP och digitala planeringsverktyg är meriterande.

Du har en stark analytisk förmåga och god förståelse för hur olika delar av värdekedjan samverkar. Vi tror att du är van vid att prioritera, fatta beslut och agera proaktivt även när tempot är högt och förutsättningarna förändras snabbt.

Som person är du strukturerad, ansvarstagande och lösningsorienterad. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med olika funktioner och bygger förtroendefulla relationer såväl internt som externt. Samtidigt trivs du med att ta eget ansvar, driva förbättringsarbete och skapa resultat som gör skillnad för verksamheten.

Vi erbjuder

En attraktiv tjänst i ett växande industriföretag där du får stort inflytande över utvecklingen av företagets logistik- och försörjningsflöden. Du blir en del av en entreprenöriell verksamhet med korta beslutsvägar, högt engagemang och goda möjligheter att påverka. Här får du chansen att ta en central roll i arbetet med att stärka verksamhetens leveransförmåga, effektivitet och konkurrenskraft samtidigt som du utvecklas tillsammans med företaget.

Ansökan

Vill du vara med och utveckla Lövstjärnan Fabriks logistikfunktion och säkerställa en robust och effektiv försörjningskedja för framtiden? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig. Urval sker löpande.

Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs en säkerhetsprövning. För att kunna erbjudas anställning krävs att en godkänd säkerhetsprövning.

I denna rekrytering samarbetar Lövstjärnan med FSK Group.

Om FSK

Vi är FSK, The Generator – ett bolag som driver utveckling och tillväxt genom våra tre affärsområden:

Talent – Vi hjälper framåtlutade företag att hitta rätt människor, främst inom Management, Specialists, Sales och Marketing.

Brand – Vi stärker varumärken genom Employer Branding och Business Branding.

Growth – Vi skapar inspirerande och utmanande utbildningar som utvecklar företag för framtiden.

title: Teknisk Säljare till ProvideU

Vi arbetar med kunder inom flera olika segment, bland annat traditionell industri, grön teknik och marin verksamhet.

description:

Has a strong background in marketing technology and experience leading architecture and delivery projects. You possess excellent communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively.

Qualifications:

Desirable qualifications:

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Role Description

As a Senior Product Designer at Instabee you will play a hands-on role in shaping the digital experiences that power our services. You will work side-by-side with engineers, product managers, and cross-functional teams to solve consumer, operations and merchant challenges and craft world-class product experiences.

Your responsibilities will include

    

Drive the end-to-end design process: Take ideas from initial discovery, wireframing, and user testing through to high-fidelity UI design and interactive prototyping.

    

Collaborate closely with tech and product: Partner with engineers and product managers from day one—working together continuously rather than throwing designs over the fence, ensuring feasibility and seamless implementation.

    

Leverage data and insights: perform user research, usability testing, and work with analytics to gain deep insights into consumer pain points, continuously iterating on your designs based on feedback.

    

Elevate the craft: Raise the bar for execution across our digital touchpoints. Maintain and evolve Instabee's design to ensure visual cohesion, efficiency, and exceptional UX quality—delivering "brilliant basics" alongside signature "wow moments."

    

Advocate for the consumer: Act as a strong voice for the user, ensuring the consumer experience remains intuitive, accessible, and front-and-center in every feature we build.

About you

    

Proven experience for a minimum of 5 years in hands-on Product Design or UX/UI roles within a fast-paced product or tech environment.

    

Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end product design projects, demonstrating practical problem-solving, intuitive workflows, and high-quality UI execution.

    

Highly proficient in modern design and prototyping tools.

    

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a track record of articulating design rationale clearly and building consensus across cross-functional teams.

    

A systems-thinking mindset, allowing you to see how your design work impacts the wider consumer journey while maintaining meticulous attention to detail.

    

Experience working in agile design and development setups with a strong focus on user-centered design principles.

If this is you then we can’t wait to meet you!

What you’ll get

We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!

Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:

    

🌇 Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm.

    

🐶 Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work - we've got a whole floor for our furry friends!

    

🏓 Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.

    

👶 Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.

    

🎂 A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!

    

⏰ Hybrid setup and flexible working hours

Get to know us

In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.

We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.

This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.

title: Senior Credit Investment Manager
description:
About Gilion

At Gilion, we’re transforming the world of growth financing with technology and data. Our platform provides modern, non-dilutive capital to Europe’s most ambitious tech companies - helping them grow without giving up equity. Backed by world-class investors and a rapidly growing customer base, we’re building something unique - and we’re just getting started.

Senior Credit Investment Professional

As a Senior Credit Investment Professional at Gilion, you will lead and structure innovative credit transactions with some of Northern Europe’s most ambitious technology companies - including tomorrow’s category leaders and potential unicorns. You will get exposure to multiple markets, business models and financing structures. You will take ownership of the full deal process - from credit assessment and modelling to structuring, negotiation and underwriting of tailored, non-dilutive loans for a diverse customer base.

At your support, you will have a commercially driven origination team, a very experienced and professional credit investment team (which you will be part of), a highly experienced legal team and last but not least, the Gilion Analytics Platform and our best-in-class data scientists.

As Gilion itself is a fast-growing fintech company and lending is at the core of what you do, you will also be expected to work on improving Gilion’s credit products, underwriting models, including AI models, and internal processes as we scale our lending platform.

Key responsibilities include

    

Lead end-to-end deal execution including analysis, structuring, negotiation and underwriting.

    

Project-lead internal teams and ensure smooth coordination across Origination, Analytics and Legal.

    

Present and discuss investment cases at investment committees.

    

Contribute to the development of Gilion’s credit products, AI-driven analysis tools and underwriting processes.

About you

You have a strong background in credit and structuring and enjoy working on complex transactions in a fast-moving environment.

Must-have

    

Experience in debt structuring and credit analysis - typically 3+ years (e.g. Leveraged Finance, Private Debt, Venture Debt, or similar).

    

Experience evaluating risk, structuring deals and helping drive transactions to completion.

    

Comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders (founders, CFOs, boards).

    

A commercial, analytical, and collaborative mindset, thriving in a fast-paced fintech environment.

    

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

    

Eager to learn and to question old beliefs

    

A solid team player

If you don’t tick every single box but believe you would thrive in this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

At Gilion, we’re all about Growth - of our customers, our platform and our people. We believe that diverse perspectives lead to better investment decisions and stronger outcomes, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and develop. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.

Are you ready to shape the future of growth financing? We look forward to your application.

title: Flödesledare montering, Borrmaskinsaffären
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Vill du ta en nyckelroll i vår produktion och bidra till en säker, effektiv och välfungerande verksamhet? Vi söker nu en flödesledare för vår montering som tillsammans med teamet driver det dagliga arbetet framåt och skapar förutsättningar för säkerhet, kvalitet och hög produktivitet.

Välkommen till Epiroc och Borrmaskinsaffären!

Inom Borrmaskinsaffären ser vi att allt börjar med oss som jobbar här. Vi är idag ca 170 personer som jobbar tvärfunktionellt för att nå våra mål. Vi har ett strukturerat och fokuserat värderingsarbete b la inom inkludering och mångfald som är vägledande i våra beslut och hur vi agerar.

Ditt teamSom flödesledare blir du en viktig del i ett engagerat team som tillsammans strävar efter en trygg och inkluderande arbetsplats. Vi samarbetar och stöttar varandra för att nå mål och att ständigt förbättras inom alla områden såsom säkerhet, kvalitet, leverans och total kostnad. Genom att involvera, engagera och utveckla dina medarbetare, skapar du effektiva team som självständigt bidrar till målen. Du kommer leda ett team/flöde mellan 15- 25 personer och ingå i ledninggruppen för produktionen. Du är direkt underställd Produktionschefen.

Ditt uppdragI din roll som flödesledare ansvarar du för att leda och organisera vår montering och slutprovning av kompletta borrmaskiner.  Vi har en taktad montering (mix-model-line) som du kommer har helhetsansvar för, dvs verksamhetsutveckling kopplad till LEAN är centralt i din roll.

Våra flöden totalt i produktionen är bearbetning, värmebehandling och montering. Därtill har vi alla supporterande flöden som materialhantering, mätrum, underhåll osv. Rollen innebär att strukturera och fördela arbetet inom ditt område, coacha och engagera dina medarbetare och tillsammans med teamet driva ständiga förbättringar. Du är en nyckelperson inom produktionsledningen för borrmaskinsaffären och del av både den dagliga styrningen och det strategiska utvecklingsarbetet. Samarbete och helhetstänk mellan olika funktioner t ex R&D, Lab, Kvalitet och Produktion är också mycket viktigt för verksamheten. Vi ser att det finns stora möjligheter att driva utveckling av vår verksamhet som Flödesledare, dvs för att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha ett stort intresse, driv och förmåga inom förändringsledning.  

Ansvarsområden

Säkerhet och arbetsmiljö• Fånga upp, dokumentera och driva åtgärder kopplade till riskobservationer, tillbud och olyckor.• Vara ett stöd i arbetsmiljö- och TIA-relaterade frågor.• Ta ett delegerat arbetsmiljöansvar inom produktionen.

Personalansvar• Personalansvar för medarbetare vid monteringen.• Ansvara för rekrytering, introduktion, kompetensutveckling, medarbetarsamtal, lönesättning, coachning och rehabiliteringsärenden.• Bidra till att skapa engagemang, utveckling och trivsel i teamet.

Operativ ledning• Leda pulsmöten och förbättringsaktiviteter samt säkerställa effektiva skiftöverlämningar.• Driva kvalitetsarbete och hantera avvikelser tillsammans med verksamheten.• Stödja montörerna i det dagliga arbetet samtidigt som du arbetar med förbättringar och kapacitetsutveckling på längre sikt.• Följa upp produktivitet och analysera produktionsdata för att säkerställa ett faktabaserat förbättringsarbete.• Säkerställa att resurser och arbetssätt används effektivt under skiftet.

Placering och resorTjänsten är placerad i Örebro och rollen är dagtid.

Ansökan och kontaktVälkommen med din ansökan innehållande CV och ett personligt brev.  Ansökningar hanteras löpande, men senast den 2026-09-30 vill vi ha din ansökan.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef eller rekryterare:Åsa Eliasson, Produktionchef Rock Drills Product Line, tel 073-337 80 26, asa.eliasson@epiroc.comMaria Tedsjö, Recruitment Specialist, maria.tedsjo@external.epiroc.com





Profile description:

Din profilVi söker dig som är en naturlig och trygg ledare med stor engagemang för säkerhet och kvalitet. Kommunikationsförmåga och genuint intresse i dina medarbetare med en stor empatisk förmåga är avgörande i denna roll. Det är även viktigt att du är kundorienterad och är öppen, serviceinriktad och har lätt för att samarbeta med olika människor och olika roller inom organisationen.



Du har goda erfarenheter av liknande roll och är van att leda medarbetare inom en teknisk miljö. Goda kunskaper och erfarenhet inom systematiskt arbetsmiljöarbete och förbättringsarbete är centrala. Du behärskar svenska och engelska obehindrat i både tal och skift.

title: Payroll Accountant
description:
One of Nordic Investin’s partner companies is looking for a Payroll Accountant, with Nordic Investin leading the recruitment process. You know that payroll accounting must be both technically correct and explainable when employees, auditors or finance leaders ask what changed.

The partner needs stronger ownership of payroll accounting, reconciliations and interfaces between HR, payroll providers and the general ledger. You will ensure accurate postings, investigate differences and improve controls across the monthly cycle.

The finance environment values accuracy, traceability and practical improvement. Work should withstand review, make ownership clear and reduce the recurring manual effort or uncertainty that weakens later reporting and decisions.

How you will work

You will collaborate across entity finance, shared services and business teams while owning defined parts of the financial cycle. The partner expects issues to be investigated to root cause, conclusions to be documented and improvements to remain workable at the next close.

As a specialist, you will own a defined professional area and be trusted to move work forward independently. You are expected to recognise when a question requires wider expertise, explain recommendations clearly and improve the methods or tools used by colleagues around you.

What you will do

    

Reconcile payroll files, accounts and payment information.

    

Review payroll postings and allocate costs correctly.

    

Investigate differences across HR, payroll and finance systems.

    

Prepare accruals, provisions and reporting schedules.

    

Maintain payroll accounting controls and documentation.

    

Coordinate payroll providers, HR and entity finance teams.

What you will bring

    

Experience in payroll accounting or finance with substantial payroll responsibility.

    

Strong reconciliation and general ledger knowledge.

    

Understanding of payroll related taxes and provisions.

    

Ability to handle sensitive information securely.

    

Advanced spreadsheet and systems capability.

    

Professional English; Swedish payroll knowledge is valuable.

Experience that would add value

    

Multi country or multi entity payroll.

    

Outsourced payroll provider governance.

    

ERP or payroll system implementation.

A background that can succeed here

Your background may sit in payroll, accounting, finance operations or audit. The partner is looking for someone who can trace a difference across systems, understand the accounting consequence and improve the control rather than relying on manual correction.

What makes the opportunity interesting

You will own an area with high visibility and little tolerance for ambiguity. The role offers cross functional exposure and the opportunity to create a more predictable, well controlled payroll accounting process.

The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the context, expectations and decision path before you are asked to commit significant time.

The recruitment conversation

During the process, Nordic Investin will focus on concrete decisions you have made: the context you received, the alternatives you considered, the result you observed and what you would change today. You do not need every optional credential if your core experience transfers and you can explain how you would close the gap.

How to apply

Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant organisation, service, project or financial process you have helped improve. Nordic Investin welcomes candidates with different routes into the profession and assesses applicants on relevant capability, judgement and potential.

title: ERP Implementation Project Manager

-
Aime travailler en équipe tout en étant capable de gagner en autonomie.

-L'assistance et au support des utilisateurs.
-L'installation et la configuration de postes de travail.
-Les interventions sur site chez nos clients.

-Les projets d'infrastructure informatique et de cybersécurité.
-L'accompagnement et la formation des utilisateurs.

-Contrat CDI.

La rémunération sera adaptée au niveau de connaissances et d'expérience du candidat, avec une progression liée à l'acquisition des compétences tout au long du parcours de formation de 12 mois.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Langzeitpflege 80-100% für die Region Grabs gesucht
description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Grabs sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Langzeitpflege.

### Ihr Überblick zur Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Grabs

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Langzeitpflege

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Grabs

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Grabs liegt im Rheintal des Kantons St. Gallen und bietet Sie mit einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung an. Die Region ist durch die Bahnlinie und das Autobahnnetz gut erreichbar. Als Arbeitsort überzeugt Grabs Sie mit einer starken Industrie- und Gewerbebase, günstigen Bodenpreisen und einer hohen Lebensqualität in unmittelbarer Nähe zum Bodensee und Liechtenstein.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

title: Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment
description:
Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen, Switzerland is part of the Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine (J\&J IM) Supply Chain organization and is currently recruiting for a  
Senior Project Manager Construction Pharma  
The Senior Project Manager serves as a senior technical leader on capital projects, ensuring alignment to J\&J standards and regulatory requirements. This role leads large capital projects, partnering with Quality, EHS, Operations, and external A\&E/CM firms.  
Key Responsibilities  
Strategic Project Leadership \& Delivery  
Lead large capital projects across all project phases (planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning).  
Coordinate multi\-functional engineering strategies to meet schedule, budget, quality, and regulatory requirements.  
Technical Authority \& Governance  
Act as the senior technical authority, review and approve engineering design changes, and technical submittals.  
Ensure engineering solutions align with J\&J standards, industry codes, and regulatory expectations.  
Budget \& Cost Management  
Lead multi‑million‑dollar capital budgets for assigned projects, monitor costs, and support procurement and contractor selection and evaluation.  
Participate in contractor bid reviews and support value\-engineering decisions.  
Scheduling, Risk \& Performance Management  
Lead schedule development and integration with program timelines; identify critical path items and drive mitigation.  
Maintain a proactive risk register, recommend mitigations, and track performance metrics.  
Construction Management \& Field Leadership  
Provide senior owner\-side engineering oversight during construction and commissioning; ensure contractor performance aligns with design intent and J\&J EHS standards.  
Promote a strong safety culture and ensure EHS compliance on site.  
Documentation \& Reporting  
Maintain detailed engineering records, design documentation, and as\-built information.  
Prepare and present executive\-level status updates, technical summaries, and risk briefings.  
Education \& Experience  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management required; Master’s degree preferred.  
10\+ years of experience leading capital projects, preferably in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or similar).  
Demonstrated owner\-side engineering leadership and experience working with A\&E and Construction Management firms.  
Experience leading multi\-discipline teams and collaborating with quality, EHS, operations, and external consultants.  
Skills \& Competencies  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving skills.  
Excellent communication and leadership skills for multi\-functional and executive interactions.  
Proven track record to lead budgets, schedules, and complex contractor relationships.  
Familiarity with regulatory expectations for facilities in regulated industries.  
Proficiency with project management and engineering documentation tools.  
Additional Requirements  
Location of Role: Primary Location: Schaffhausen, Switzerland  
Language Requirements: Proficiency: English \& German  
Travel Requirements: This position will require limited travel (less than 10%) domestic and international travel jpidfb0434cjm jit0729jm jiy26jm

description:
Collaborateur Sécurité, Santé et Hygiène (H/F/D) à 60%  
Les Usines Métallurgiques de Vallorbe SA (UMV) sont reconnues au niveau international comme le partenaire préféré des professionnels les plus exigeants pour ses outils de précision. Disposant de grandes capacités d’innovation, la société, forte de près de 200 collaborateurs, commercialise ses produits dans plus de 80 pays via un réseau de distribution.  
Dans le cadre d’une création de poste suite au développement de nos activités, nous sommes à la recherche d’un/e  
Collaborateur Sécurité, Santé et Hygiène (H/F/D) à 60%  
Vos missions  
Il ou elle assure une présence terrain régulière et contribue à la mise en œuvre et au suivi opérationnel des mesures de santé, sécurité \& hygiène définies par le Responsable SSH. Il ou elle appuie les équipes de production, de maintenance et d’infrastructure dans l’application quotidienne des règles de sécurité.  
Cette fonction est distincte du rôle de spécialiste MSST reconnu selon l’Ordonnance sur les qualifications des spécialistes de la sécurité au travail, qui reste porté exclusivement par le Responsable SSH.  
Vos activités :  
Réaliser des tournées de sécurité régulières sur le terrain et contrôler l’application de la politique SSH et des points sécurité \& santé (feu, gaz, matériel de sécurité, matériel de secours, EPI),  
Participer à l’élaboration des documents opérationnels de sécurité, en appui du Responsable SSH,  
Travailler en collaboration avec le Responsable SSH à la réduction des risques du site,  
Gérer les équipements de protection individuelle (attribution, contrôle, renouvellement, traçabilité),  
Mettre à jour la documentation relative aux contrôles et aux mesures terrain,  
Remonter les points sécurité au Responsable SSH et participer à l’amélioration des statistiques incidents, presqu’accidents et accidents,  
Analyser les événements terrain, proposer des plans d’actions correctifs et en assurer le suivi,  
Participer aux projets et actions en lien avec le secteur SSH et les différents secteurs de production,  
Participer à l’organisation des exercices d’évacuation pour le personnel,  
Assurer un appui administratif au groupe des Samaritains, en soutien du Responsable SSH,  
Assurer un soutien opérationnel dans le suivi des accès (clés, logiciels de contrôle d’accès),  
Gérer les vêtements de travail, les vestiaires, l’infirmerie et le matériel d’urgence,  
Instruire les collaborateurs aux exigences SSH,  
Planifier et coordonner les formations terrain (quart d’heure sécurité, causeries, exercices pratiques),  
Communiquer au Responsable SSH le suivi des indicateurs et constats terrain,  
Collaborer avec les prestataires externes pour les aspects opérationnels et remonter les informations au Responsable SSH pour la prise de décision.  
Compétences professionnelles et personnelles  
Faire preuve de discernement et de confiance en soi  
Être apte à gérer des situations de conflit  
Être doté d’une capacité d’observation, d’analyse et de synthèse  
Être à l’aise dans les contacts humains et l’expression en public  
Être à l’écoute et avoir la capacité à conserver distance et lucidité  
Force de proposition  
Respecter les valeurs de l’entreprise  
Gestion du stress  
Discrétion.  
Formation base et continue  
Formation de base en sécurité au travail (PERCO STPS ou Assistant de sécurité STPS)  
Expérience de min. 2 à 3 ans, idéalement dans le domaine HSE  
Expérience avec les logiciels de contrôle d’accès Sipass et Salto un atout  
Chargé de sécurité en protection incendie AEAI un atout  
Formation en premiers secours/samaritain un atout  
Maîtriser des outils MS office  
De langue maternelle française ou niveau minimum C1, toutes autres langues constituent un atout.

title: Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval
description:
Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.

Freuen Sie sich auf eine Arbeit in einer traumhaften alpinen Lage, die Ihnen zahlreiche attraktive Freizeitaktivitäten bietet.

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

- Die ärztliche Leitung des Bereichs, bestehend aus einer Kriseninterventionsstation, einer Tagesklinik und einem Ambulatorium in Absprache mit der Bereichsleitung
- Sie sind Verantwortlich für die Pflege aller psychiatrischen Angelegenheiten und bilden die Schnittstelle zwischen niedergelassenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, der Somatik und anderen Kooperationspartnern.
- Zudem unterstützen Sie Ihre Kollegen, wobei Ihnen dabei kompetente und engagierte Teams zur Seite stehen, die sich auf Verstärkung freuen.

Qualifikationen / Anforderungen

- Abgeschlossene Facharztweiterbildung für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie sowie erfüllte Voraussetzungen für die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen (EU-Facharzttitel,
EU-Approbation und EU-Staatsbürgerschaft)
- Freude an interprofessioneller und interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit sowie an der Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung des Behandlungs- und Therapieangebotes

description:
Du wünschst dir bessere Arbeitsbedingungen, ein spürbar höheres Gehalt und die Berggipfel direkt vor der Haustür? Für verschiedene renommierte Akutkliniken, Rehabilitationseinrichtungen und Pflegezentren in den Schweizer Alpen suchen wir motivierte Pflegekräfte aus Deutschland und der EU.

Wir von SWISSMEDICAL sind dein persönliches Sprungbrett über die Grenze. Als spezialisierter Partner begleiten wir dich Schritt für Schritt bei deinem Wechsel in die Schweiz. Wir vermitteln dich direkt in erstklassige Schweizer Gesundheitseinrichtungen – absolut kostenfrei und perfekt auf deine Wünsche abgestimmt.

**Einsatzbereiche:** Akutkliniken, Ambulatorien oder soziale Einrichtungen
**Ort:** Schweizer Alpen (z. B. Graubünden, Wallis, Berner Oberland)
**Anstellungsart:** Vollzeit (Festanstellung)

Gutes Gehalt, ein hervorragender Betreuungsschlüssel und die Alpen direkt vor der Haustür? Die Schweiz bietet dir genau die Wertschätzung und Lebensqualität, die du in deinem Pflegealltag oft vermisst.

„Weniger Stress, mehr Zeit für den Patienten und eine Lebensqualität, die ihresgleichen sucht. Der Wechsel in die Schweiz war die beste Entscheidung meines Lebens.“

Deine Vorteile im Überblick

- **Top-Vergütung:** Attraktives Jahresgehalt (ca. 75.000 bis 95.000 CHF je nach Erfahrung) mit im Vergleich zu Deutschland moderaten Steuerabzügen.
- **Entspannter Pflegealltag:** Ein deutlich besserer Pflegeschlüssel sorgt für mehr Zeit pro Patient und nachhaltig weniger Belastung im Schichtdienst.
- **Höchste Lebensqualität:** Leben, wo andere Urlaub machen – Skifahren, Biken und Wandern direkt vor der Haustür.
- **Rundum-Sorglos-Relocation:** Volle Unterstützung bei der Diplom-Anerkennung (SRK), den Behördengängen für die Aufenthaltsbewilligung sowie der Wohnungssuche.
- **Moderne Arbeitsumgebung:** Erstklassig ausgestattete Häuser, strukturierte Einarbeitung und ein wertschätzendes, kollegiales Team.
- **Weiterbildung:** Großzügige Budgets und Freistellungen für deine berufliche Entwicklung.

Deine Aufgaben:

- Empathische und fachgerechte Grund- und Behandlungspflege in deinem Fachbereich.
- Planung, Durchführung und digitale Dokumentation der Pflegeprozesse.
- Konstruktive Zusammenarbeit im interdisziplinären Team aus Ärzten, Therapeuten und Pflegekräften.

Das bringst du mit:

- Freude am Beruf, hohe Fachkompetenz und Lust auf eine neue Herausforderung in den Schweizer Alpen.
- Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger, Krankenschwester oder Pflegefachkraft (m/w/d).
- Zuverlässigkeit, Teamgeist und Bereitschaft zum Wohnortwechsel in die Schweiz.

Das bieten wir dir (Dein Rundum-Sorglos-Paket):

- **Attraktives Schweizer Gehalt:** Profitiere von sehr guten Verdienstmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Sozialleistungen.
- Behörden-Support: Wir übernehmen die komplette Organisation und Dir bei deiner SRK-Diplomanerkennung (Schweizerisches Rotes Kreuz).
- **Starthilfe:** Wir unterstützen dich aktiv bei der Wohnungssuche, Steuerfragen, Grenzgänger-Themen und allen Behördengängen.
- **Individuelles Matching:** Wir offerieren Dir die Klinik, die wirklich zu deinen Karrierewünschen und deiner Persönlichkeit passt.
- **Persönliche Begleitung:** Unser Team ist vor, während und auch nach deinem Start in der Schweiz immer für dich da.

title: Oberärztin, Oberarzt in der Gynäkologie und Geburtshilfe am Vierwaldstättersee (Facharzt/-ärztin - Frauenheilkunde und Geburtshilfe)
description:
Das Spital am Vierwaldstättersee ist ein modernes Akutspital mit rund 100 Betten, rund 650 engagierten Beschäftigten und ist für die erweiterte Grundversorgung der Bevölkerung in der Region verantwortlich. Als Teil eines leistungsstarken Netzwerks, gehört die Frauenklinik im Verbund zu den führenden Einrichtungen in der Schweiz. Gemeinsam sorgen wir rund um die Uhr mit Leidenschaft und Engagement für eine koordinierte, digital vernetzte und für alle zugängliche Gesundheitsversorgung.

Für diesen äußerst interessanten Arbeitgeber suchen wir per sofort oder Vereinbarung eine fachlich qualifizierte und engagierte Person als

Oberärztin oder Oberarzt in der Gynäkologie und Geburtshilfe für die Region südl. von Luzern am Vierwaldstättersee

Diese Klinik legt großen Wert auf die individuelle familienorientierte Geburtshilfe. Die Patientin steht im Vordergrund und Sie haben die Zeit, auf sie einzugehen.

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

- Sie stellen die ärztliche Versorgung von geburtshilflichen und gynäkologischen Patientinnen sicher und übernehmen die Verantwortung im Bereich der nicht operativen und operativen Gynäkologie/Geburtshilfe
- Sie führen gynäkologisch/geburtshilfliche Sprechstunden und leisten Notfalldienste
- Sie arbeiten in einem interdisziplinären Team mit Beleghebammen zusammen

- Sie haben Freude an der interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit und an der natürlichen, klinischen Geburtshilfe
- Sie bevorzugen selbständiges Arbeiten und haben Interesse, Ihr Wissen und Können weiterzugeben
- Sie sind eine motivierte und teamfähige Persönlichkeit mit hoher Sozial- und Fachkompetenz
- Die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen müssen bei Bewerbungsbeginn nicht vorhanden sein, jedoch beim Stellenantritt. Bei der Einreichung der Unterlagen kann auf unsere Erfahrung zurückgegriffen werden.

- Fixgehalt zwischen CHF 160.000 (frisch mit Facharzt Titel) brutto pro Jahr bei Vollzeit bis CHF 170.000. Hinzu kommen Dienstzulagen (Nacht-/Wochenende von CHF 120 pro Dienst)

- Flache Hierarchien und wertschätzender kollegialer Umgang
- Sie haben die Möglichkeit in einer innovativen Gemeinschaft mit großem Wachstumspotential einen wertvollen Beitrag zu leisten
- Sie profitieren von finanzierten Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten und von flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen

title: 🌟 Stellenangebot: Medizinisch-technische/r Radiologieassistent/in (MTR / MTRA) - Basel, Schweiz (Medizinische/r Technologe/Technologin - Radiologie)
employer: Personal Spezial Personalservice & Vermittlung Hansjürgen Mathiak
description:
🌟 Stellenangebot: Medizinisch-technische/r Radiologieassistent/in (MTR / MTRA) - Basel, Schweiz

Ihre Perspektive in Basel
Möchten Sie Ihre Fachkompetenz in einem hochmodernen medizinischen Umfeld einbringen und von den attraktiven Rahmenbedingungen des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens profitieren?
Im Auftrag einer renommierten Radiologie-Praxis bzw. Klinik im Raum Basel suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Expertise im Bereich der Mammographie sowie Vielseitigkeit in der allgemeinen Bildgebung.
Ihre Aufgaben
Schwerpunkt Mammographie: Eigenverantwortliche und empathische Durchführung von Mammographien auf höchstem technischem Niveau sowie Betreuung der Patientinnen während des gesamten Untersuchungsablaufs.
Allgemeine Radiologische Diagnostik: Kompetente Durchführung von Routine- und Spezialuntersuchungen in den Bereichen Röntgen, Computertomographie (CT) und Magnetresonanztomographie (MRT).
Prozess- & Qualitätsmanagement: Einhaltung und Sicherstellung höchster Qualitäts-, Strahlenschutz- und Hygienestandards.
Patientenorientierung: Professionelle, einfühlsame Vorbereitung und Betreuung der Patienten in einer vertrauensvollen Atmosphäre.
Das bringen Sie mit
Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als MTR / MTRA (Medizinisch-technische/r Radiologieassistent/in) oder eine vergleichbare, in der Schweiz anerkannte Qualifikation.
Fachkompetenz: Nachweisbare, vertiefte Erfahrung und hohe Routine in der Mammographie.
Vielseitigkeit: Gute Praxiskenntnisse und Sicherheit im Umgang mit Geräten der Sparten Röntgen, CT und MRT.
Persönlichkeit: Hohe Sozialkompetenz, Empathie im Umgang mit Patienten sowie eine zuverlässige, selbstständige und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise.
Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Das erwartet Sie
Attraktive Vergütung: Schweizer Gehaltsstandard inklusive hervorragender Sozialleistungen und Vorsorgekonzepte.
Modernste Technologie: Arbeiten mit Geräten der neuesten Generation in einem dynamischen und professionellen Team.
Umfassender Relocation-Support: Als Deutsch-Schweizer Vermittlungsverbund begleiten wir Sie persönlich beim Übergang nach Basel (Anerkennung der Diplome, Behördengänge, Wohnungssuche, steuerliche Orientierung).
Work-Life-Balance: Geregelte Arbeitszeiten, planbare Schichten und die hohe Lebensqualität der Dreiländereck-Region Basel.

title: Power System Physicist/Engineer for the CMS HGCAL
description:
What you'll do
As Power System Physicist/Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL), you will play a key role in the development, integration, testing and commissioning of the power systems for one of the most innovative particle detectors ever conceived.

Working within a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will contribute to the procurement and testing of power supplies for HGCAL detector modules, including low-voltage, high-current supplies for the readout electronics and medium-voltage supplies of up to 800 V for sensor biasing.

You will also contribute to the integration of power systems with the detector's safety, control and monitoring systems, as well as the testing and implementation of power components such as DC-DC converters, voltage regulation and cabling.

A key aspect of the role will be to assess the impact of the power system on HGCAL performance and to develop and implement strategies to minimise noise effects such as interference, coupling and ripple.

This role offers the opportunity to combine strong electrical engineering and detector-physics skills with hands-on involvement in the construction, testing and commissioning of a large-scale, state-of-the-art particle detector.

Your responsibilities
Follow the procurement of the power supplies (Low Voltage and Bias Voltage, totalling several MCHF), including carrying out acceptance and stress tests on the delivered units.
Support the commissioning of these power systems during the mass assembly and testing phases of HGCAL.
Work with physicists and engineers to evaluate the performance of HGCAL in relation to its power systems and to develop and implement mitigation strategies where possible and necessary, first on the surface and subsequently when HGCAL is installed in CMS, 100 metres underground.
Work with the HGCAL and central CMS Technical Coordination teams to oversee the installation and testing of the power systems underground in the "Service" and "Experimental" caverns. This will include overseeing cable installation, in-situ connectorisation where needed, testing and commissioning, and the integration of the power system into the HGCAL and CMS safety and monitoring systems.

Your profile
Strong track record in testing, operating and debugging power systems for complex devices, such as particle detectors used in high-energy physics experiments.
Experience with silicon- and/or scintillator-based particle detectors would be an advantage.
Experience with large-scale procurement of electronic systems, such as power supplies.
Ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multicultural teams of engineers, scientists and technicians would be an advantage.
Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
Construction, test and installation of power electronic components and systems.
Specification and follow-up of technical aspects of a contract.
Testing and validation of detector components.
Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
Assimilates large quantities of information, identifies key issues and formulates conclusions clearly and concisely.
Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Solution Ownership & Operations

- Take ownership of solutions beyond the prototype stage, including testing, deployment, monitoring, documentation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
- Maintain and further develop existing automation and AI solutions across the organization.
- Establish reusable standards for integrations, access controls, testing, monitoring, error handling, documentation, and human review.

AI Enablement & Governance

- Work closely with IT, Security, Privacy, Quality Management, Regulatory, Legal, and other relevant experts to translate agreed requirements into practical technical controls.

We are a fast-growing telemedicine company focused on improving access to dermatological care. Our platform uses technology to connect patients with dermatologists, enabling them to receive diagnoses and treatment plans remotely and asynchronously.

Were looking for an AI Enablement & Automation Engineer to help us improve and automate internal processes across OnlineDoctor. You will work closely with teams across the organization to understand their workflows, and identify opportunities for automation, turning them into reliable technical solutions.

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on solving real operational problems. You will build and maintain automations, integrations, internal tools, and AI-enabled workflows, while ensuring that solutions are reliable, maintainable, secure, and appropriate for a regulated healthcare environment.

You will work closely with the responsible compliance, security, privacy, quality, AI, and regulatory experts. You are not expected to make governance or regulatory decisions independently; your responsibility is to understand agreed requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions and operational controls.

- Learning culture: We offer you a steep learning curve in your daily work and support you in your personal and professional development through regular retro and inspiration sessions as well as advanced training. We are open for ideas and impulses and help you with the implementation.
- Team events: Skiing in Switzerland, white water rafting in Vienna - we regularly get together with our entire team and thus increase our teamwork.
- Fair salary: An attractive salary is a matter of course for us.
- Additional benefits: Free choice of laptop, home office allowance, additional vacation day, etc.
- Our Values: Respect and tolerance are part of our DNA. We actively support diversity and inclusion, believing they are the keys to a successful and healthy company culture.

Work Location & Relocation:
Due to current legal and regulatory reasons, we can only hire team members who live in Germany or Switzerland. If youre based elsewhere but excited to join OnlineDoctor, were happy to discuss and support your relocation to either country.
